en.name: Actors
en.summary: Actors build a character through speech, movement and interaction, then adjust their performance in response to direction. Consider preparation, auditions, rehearsals and performances separately.

zh.name: 演员
zh.summary: 演员通过台词、动作和对手互动呈现角色，按导演反馈调整演法。了解这份工作时，把准备、试镜、排练和正式演出分别看。

en.name: Actuaries
en.summary: Actuaries use data and models to estimate uncertain costs in insurance and other settings. Pricing compares claim frequency, severity and rating assumptions; reserving estimates unpaid claims and explains changes. Start by trying a reviewable calculation, then verify exams, responsibilities and signing authority separately.

zh.name: 精算师
zh.summary: 精算师用数据和模型估计保险等业务的不确定成本。定价常比较出险频率、损失严重度和费率假设；准备金工作会估计未决赔款并解释变动。入行先看你愿不愿意复算和说明限制，再分开核考试、岗位职责与签署权限。

en.name: Acupuncturists
en.summary: Acupuncturists assess patients, decide whether care can proceed within their licensed scope, document treatment and refer when appropriate. Start with the requirements for your jurisdiction and workplace, then try the fictional documentation exercise.

zh.name: 针灸师
zh.summary: 针灸师在获准执业范围内评估患者、决定能否继续、完成操作和记录，并在超出范围时转交。想入行，先确认当地资格、注册范围和机构岗位，再用虚构材料试做事实与交接记录。

en.name: Acute care nurses
en.summary: Acute care nurses monitor changes, document care and hand over information when patients’ needs can change quickly. In mainland China, compare emergency, intensive care and monitoring roles with their registration, training and employer requirements.

zh.name: 急症护理护士
zh.summary: 急症护理护士在病情变化快的场景中观察、记录、沟通和协助照护。大陆可对照急诊、重症和监护岗位，按护士执业注册、科室训练与单位授权核对。

en.name: Adapted physical education specialists
en.summary: Adapted physical education specialists adjust activities, rules and equipment to help students participate, document learning and collaborate with PE teachers and special education teams. Teaching, support-plan decisions and clinical care each have their own authorization.

zh.name: 适应性体育教育专家
zh.summary: 适应性体育教育专家根据学生的参与条件调整体育活动、规则和器材，记录学习表现，并与体育教师和特殊教育团队协作。真实教学、支持计划和临床处置各有相应责任人。

en.name: Adhesive bonding machine operators and tenders
en.summary: Adhesive bonding machine operators prepare parts, monitor equipment, check bonds and log deviations against the work order. Check job authority for adjustments, repairs and chemical handling.

zh.name: 胶粘/粘合设备操作员与看护员
zh.summary: 胶粘设备操作员按工单准备工件、监看设备，检查粘接结果并记录偏差。调参、维修和处置化学品按设备及岗位授权核对。

en.name: Administrative services managers
en.summary: Administrative services managers coordinate office support, budgets and records. They handle late deliveries or missing documentation and send decisions to the right approver. Check authority over facilities, payments and personnel separately.

zh.name: 行政服务经理
zh.summary: 行政服务经理协调办公支持、预算执行与记录管理，处理供应商迟交和资料缺项，并把需批准的事项交给相应负责人。设施运维、付款和人事决定要另核岗位授权。

en.name: Adult basic and secondary education and ESL teachers
en.summary: Adult literacy and high-school-equivalency teachers help learners practice reading, writing, basic math or exam skills. Program rules govern formal scores and credentials.

zh.name: 成人基础与中等教育及ESL教师
zh.summary: 成人读写与高中同等学历课程教师帮助学习者练读写、基础数学或备考。职责随班型变化，课程反馈与正式成绩或资格认定按机构规定办理。

en.name: Advertising and promotions managers
en.summary: Advertising and promotions managers bring audience research, messaging, creative work, budgets and placements into a campaign. They define who reviews the material, who approves it and what success looks like.

zh.name: 广告与促销经理
zh.summary: 广告与促销经理把受众、信息、创意、预算和投放安排组合成可执行的活动，明确谁审材料、谁批准投放以及怎样判断结果。

en.name: Advertising, promotions, and marketing managers
en.summary: Advertising, promotions and marketing managers may own positioning and pricing or focus on creative work, channels and placements. Ask who chooses the audience, sets the budget and owns the results.

zh.name: 广告、促销与市场经理
zh.summary: 广告、促销与市场管理可能包括定位和定价，也可能集中在创意、渠道和投放。看岗位时先问谁决定卖给谁、用什么预算、对什么结果负责。

en.name: Advertising sales agents
en.summary: Advertising sales agents find clients, turn goals, audiences and budgets into priced advertising placements, then follow proofs, schedules and payments. Media owners, agencies and platforms differ in sales targets, discount authority and commission terms.

zh.name: 广告销售代表
zh.summary: 广告销售代表开发客户，把推广目标、受众和预算换成可报价的广告位或媒体方案，并跟进素材确认、排期和回款。媒体方直营、广告代理和平台销售的指标、折扣权限及提成条件常不同。

en.name: Aerospace Engineering and Operations Technologists and Technicians
en.summary: Aerospace engineering and operations technologists and technicians turn a test plan into traceable instruments, equipment checks and original records. Test support, measurement and assembly quality have different outputs. When a certificate or version does not match, keep the original record and refer the decision to authorized staff.

zh.name: 航空航天工程与运行技术员
zh.summary: 航空航天工程与运行技术员把试验方案落实成可追溯的仪器、设备状态和原始记录。试验支持、测量校准和装配质检的交付不同；遇到证书或版本不匹配，保留原记录并请有授权的人员判定。

en.name: Aerospace Engineers
en.summary: Aerospace engineers turn aircraft and spacecraft requirements into designs that can be analyzed and verified. Structures, aerodynamics, systems and testing produce different work: analysis explains assumptions and units; verification links requirements to evidence. Check design, manufacturing, maintenance and certification responsibilities separately.

zh.name: 航空航天工程师
zh.summary: 航空航天工程师把飞行器或航天器的要求变成可分析、可验证的设计。结构、气动、系统和试验岗位的交付不同；例如分析岗位提交有假设和单位的计算，验证岗位把要求和原始证据连起来。设计、制造、维修及适航批准的职责要分开核。

en.name: Agents and business managers of artists, performers and athletes
en.summary: Agents and business managers find opportunities, negotiate terms and coordinate agreements for clients. Authority to promise dates, fees or sign depends on the client’s instructions and applicable rules.

zh.name: 艺术家、演艺人员与运动员经纪及业务经理
zh.summary: 经纪与业务经理代表客户寻找机会、沟通合作条件并协调合同事项。是否可以承诺档期、费用或签约，由客户授权与适用规则决定。

en.name: Agricultural engineers
en.summary: Agricultural engineers turn irrigation, equipment, soil or facility needs into designs they can calculate and test. Concept design, field verification and permission to implement are separate steps.

zh.name: 农业工程师
zh.summary: 农业工程师把灌溉、设备、土壤或设施的问题变成可计算和验证的方案。概念设计、现场校验与实施批准分别处理。

en.name: Agricultural equipment operators
en.summary: Agricultural equipment operators drive or tend machines for field work, check coverage and record anomalies. Operation, repair and safety actions follow the assigned equipment and procedures.

zh.name: 农业操作员
zh.summary: 农业设备操作员按田间任务驾驶或看护机具，检查作业覆盖并记录异常。实际操作、维修和安全处置按设备与岗位规程核对。

en.name: Agricultural inspectors
en.summary: Agricultural inspectors check products, facilities or activities against applicable rules, record evidence and flag corrective action. Inspection records and formal decisions follow separate authority.

zh.name: 农业检查员
zh.summary: 农业检查员按适用规则检查农产品、设施或作业，记录证据和异常，并把纠正建议交给相应责任人。检查记录与正式处置决定按授权分开。

en.name: Agricultural sciences teachers, postsecondary
en.summary: Postsecondary agricultural science teachers teach crop, soil or production topics through courses, labs and fieldwork. Some roles also include research or supervising placements.

zh.name: 农业教师
zh.summary: 高校农业科学教师把作物、土壤或农业生产问题带进课程、实验与田间教学，指导学生用数据解释结果。岗位也可能包含科研和实习指导。

en.name: Air traffic controllers
en.summary: Air traffic controllers monitor and coordinate aircraft at towers, approach facilities and en route centres. They issue clearances and hand off responsibility within their assigned authority. Entry depends on the jurisdiction, facility and training route.

zh.name: 空中交通管制员
zh.summary: 空中交通管制员在塔台、进近设施或区域管制中心监视和协调航空器，按岗位权限发布许可并交接责任。入行要核目标法域、设施和训练要求。

en.name: Aircraft and Avionics Equipment Mechanics and Technicians
en.summary: This profile covers both aircraft maintenance and avionics equipment work. Mechanics focus on airframes, powerplants and mechanical systems. Avionics technicians focus on electronics, signals and fault records. Both preserve work-card evidence, with separate limits for performing, reviewing and releasing work.

zh.name: 飞机及航电设备维修机械员与技术员
zh.summary: 这是飞机机械维修与航电设备维修的合组职业页。机械岗位重点是机体、动力装置和机械系统，航电岗位重点是电子设备、信号和故障记录。两边都需留工卡证据；独立作业、复核和签放各按适用权限。

en.name: Aircraft Cargo Handling Supervisors
en.summary: Aircraft cargo handling supervisors coordinate crews, check the loading plan against handling records and escalate discrepancies to the appropriate load-control or review staff. Ramp supervision, cargo station management and onboard load duties have different responsibilities and authority.

zh.name: 飞机货物装卸主管
zh.summary: 飞机货物装卸主管安排班组，核对装卸计划与现场记录，发现货物、位置或单据不一致时交接给负责配载或复核的人员。机坪监装、货运站管理和随飞装载任务各有职责与授权。

en.name: Aircraft Mechanics and Service Technicians
en.summary: Aircraft mechanics and service technicians inspect, troubleshoot and maintain aircraft under applicable manuals and work cards. Line, base and engine maintenance have different work rhythms. Completing a work card, having it reviewed and authorizing return to service are separate decisions.

zh.name: 飞机维修机械员与技术员
zh.summary: 飞机维修机械员与技术员按获准的手册和工卡检查、排故、维护飞机并记录结果。航线、定检和发动机维修的节奏不同；做完工卡、完成复核与获准签署放行须分别确认。

en.name: Aircraft Service Attendants
en.summary: Aircraft service attendants fuel aircraft and record the work. Some assignments include deicing, replenishment, waste servicing, exterior cleaning, marshalling or towing. Check the employer’s scope and authorization; cabin cleaning and maintenance signoff are separate work.

zh.name: 飞机地面勤务员
zh.summary: 飞机地面勤务员为飞机加油并记录作业。有些岗位还做除冰、补给、排污、外部清洁或飞机引导与牵引。具体任务分工以雇主和岗位授权为准，不能把客舱保洁或维修放行算作同一工作。

en.name: Aircraft Structure, Surfaces, Rigging, and Systems Assemblers
en.summary: Aircraft structure and systems assemblers position, fit and fasten components using controlled drawings, then measure, document and hand off their work. Structural riveting, control system installation and final assembly can involve different stations and authorizations.

zh.name: 飞机结构与系统装配工
zh.summary: 飞机结构与系统装配工按受控图纸定位、配合和紧固部件，装好后测量、记录并交接。结构铆装、操纵系统安装与总装对接在不同工位，需分别核工序和授权。

en.name: Airfield Operations Specialists
en.summary: Airfield operations specialists inspect airfield areas, record problems with pavement or markings, and hand findings to the people responsible for correction and reporting. Inspection, coordination and safety management have different outputs. Check the job’s access, reporting and decision authority.

zh.name: 飞行区运行专员
zh.summary: 飞行区运行专员巡查机场飞行区、记录道面或标志异常，并向负责处置和通报的人交接。场务巡查、运行协调和安全管理的交付不同；先查岗位的通行、报告及处置权限。

en.name: Airline and Commercial Pilots
en.summary: Airline pilots usually fly fixed-wing aircraft on scheduled passenger or cargo routes. Commercial pilots may fly charter or other missions. U.S. BLS groups both under 53-2010. The occupation Commercial Pilots (53-2012) is distinct from a commercial pilot certificate. Verify licensing, ratings, operating rules, and operator training for the jurisdiction and role.

zh.name: 航空公司与商业飞行员
zh.summary: 航空公司飞行员通常执行定期固定翼客货运输，商业飞行员可承担包机、空中作业等不同任务。美国 BLS 把两项归入 53-2010；53-2012 是职业分类，不能直接当作一张商用驾驶员执照。实际飞行须按所在法域的执照等级、运行和运营人训练要求核对。

en.name: Airline Pilots, Copilots, and Flight Engineers
en.summary: Airline pilots and copilots share flight, communication, monitoring and recordkeeping duties. The US category also covers flight engineers; Chinese pilot roles have their own classifications.

zh.name: 航空公司飞行员、副驾驶与飞行工程师
zh.summary: 民航飞行员和副驾驶根据机组分工执行飞行、通信、监控和记录；包含飞行工程师的美国统计类别需与中国驾驶岗位分别理解。

en.name: Allergists and Immunologists
en.summary: Allergists and immunologists combine history, examination and follow-up to evaluate allergic and immune disorders and manage treatment within their scope.

zh.name: 过敏专科医师免疫学医师
zh.summary: 过敏与免疫专科医师结合病史、检查和随访评估过敏及免疫系统疾病，并在其执业范围内制定和调整治疗。

en.name: Ambulance Drivers and Attendants (Except EMTs)
en.summary: This role drives or assists on an ambulance and helps prepare the vehicle, restock supplies and hand over information. U.S. occupation 53-3011 excludes EMTs. Duties depend on training, local rules and employer authorization. Mainland driving, stretcher support and medical rescue roles have separate requirements.

zh.name: 救护车驾驶员与随车服务员（不含急救医疗技术员）
zh.summary: 这份工作负责驾驶或协助驾驶、按岗位分工准备车辆、补给与交接。美国 53-3011 排除 EMT；具体可协助的任务按培训、当地要求与机构授权核对。大陆另分救护车驾驶、担架协助和医疗救护岗位。

en.name: Amusement and Recreation Attendants
en.summary: Recreation attendants check tickets, guide visitors, manage lines and help with facilities. Ask whether the job gives visitor information or operates equipment. In mainland China, requirements for operating regulated large rides depend on the equipment and task.

zh.name: 娱乐与休闲服务员
zh.summary: 游乐与休闲服务包括检票、游客引导、场地秩序和部分设施服务。先问岗位负责向游客说明，还是实际操作设备。中国大陆大型游乐设施的操作资质只适用于对应设备与任务，不能从普通服务岗位名推定。

en.name: Anesthesiologist Assistants
en.summary: Anesthesiologist assistants support perioperative monitoring, preparation and documentation under physician anesthesiologist supervision. US authority varies by state; mainland China has a different role structure.

zh.name: 麻醉医师助理
zh.summary: 麻醉医师助理在麻醉医师监督下参与围术期监测、设备准备及记录。美国可执业的范围随州而异，中国大陆麻醉团队有自己的岗位划分。

en.name: Anesthesiologists
en.summary: Anesthesiologists assess perioperative risk, plan anesthesia, monitor and respond to changes, and hand over care for recovery.

zh.name: 麻醉医师
zh.summary: 麻醉科医师评估围术期风险，拟定麻醉计划，监测患者并处理情况变化，再将恢复观察和风险交接给下一环节。

en.name: Animal Breeders
en.summary: Animal breeders use pedigree, trait and health records to make breeding selections and track animals. Veterinary duties and permits depend on the operation and jurisdiction.

zh.name: 动物饲养员
zh.summary: 动物繁育人员依据谱系、性状和健康记录选择繁育对象，并安排照料和跟踪。诊疗和许可另按业务及所在地规定核对。

en.name: Animal Care and Service Workers
en.summary: At a boarding or exhibit handover, identify who takes intake, who records observations and who follows up. The U.S. statistics here cover animal caretakers, SOC 39-2021. Training and veterinary treatment have separate duties.

zh.name: 动物照护与服务人员
zh.summary: 寄养或展区服务交班时，先分清谁接收、谁记观察、谁跟进。美国统计采用动物照护员 39-2021 单项；驯养师和动物诊疗另核。

en.name: Animal Caretakers
en.summary: Daily animal care starts with feeding, cleaning, observation and handover. Ask which animals you would care for and who takes over if something changes. U.S. data use SOC 39-2021. Check actual duties and treatment authority separately in mainland China.

zh.name: 动物照护员
zh.summary: 日常动物照护从喂养、清洁、观察和交接开始。查看岗位时，先问服务哪些动物、遇到异常由谁接手。美国数据对应 39-2021；中国大陆不同场所的职责和诊疗权限按实际岗位另核。

en.name: Animal Control Workers
en.summary: Start with a report: who logs it, who verifies it, and who can accept a handover? U.S. SOC 33-9011 can involve animal control, shelter intake, investigations and enforcement. In mainland China, check local responsibilities, the job and its authority.

zh.name: 动物管理与收容工作人员
zh.summary: 接到一条涉犬报告后，先分清谁记录、谁核实、谁能接收。美国 33-9011 的岗位可涉及动物管理、收容、调查与执法；在中国大陆，养犬管理与收容服务看当地分工、实际岗位和授权。

en.name: Animal Scientists
en.summary: Animal scientists study livestock nutrition, genetics or reproduction. They design studies, analyze data and explain when their findings apply.

zh.name: 动物科学家
zh.summary: 动物科学家研究家畜营养、遗传或繁殖问题，设计试验、分析数据，并解释结果在什么条件下可以应用。

en.name: Animal Trainers
en.summary: Animal trainers observe, record and develop animal behavior, track practice and hand over findings to caretakers, owners or specialist organizations. Pet, horse, guide dog and animal facility work differ in goals and authority.

zh.name: 动物训练师
zh.summary: 动物训练师按方案观察、记录和培养动物行为，跟进练习结果，并与饲养员、主人或专项机构交接。宠物、马匹、导盲犬和动物场馆的训练目标与现场权限各不相同。

en.name: Anthropologists and Archeologists
en.summary: Anthropologists and archaeologists study human societies and material remains. Compare the work of interviewing and observing, using archives, and documenting sites or objects.

zh.name: 人类学家与考古学家
zh.summary: 人类学家与考古学家研究人类社会及物质遗存。选方向时先区分访谈和观察、档案研究、遗址与实物记录等证据工作。

en.name: Anthropology and Archeology Teachers, Postsecondary
en.summary: Postsecondary anthropology and archaeology teachers design courses, evaluate how students use evidence and may supervise fieldwork, labs or research.

zh.name: 高校人类学和考古学教师
zh.summary: 高校人类学与考古学教师设计课程、评价学生的证据使用，并可能指导田野、实验或独立研究。授课与研究的比重由院系岗位决定。

en.name: Appraisers and Assessors of Real Estate
en.summary: Real estate appraisers and assessors examine property and market records. Individual valuation reports and jurisdiction-wide tax assessments have different purposes and authority.

zh.name: 房地产估价师与评估员
zh.summary: 房地产估价和税务评估都要核对房产资料和市场证据；估价报告与辖区税务认定面向不同用途，各自按制度和权限办理。

en.name: Appraisers of Personal and Business Property
en.summary: Personal and business property appraisers examine condition and provenance, find comparable transactions and document their valuation assumptions. Evidence differs across jewelry, equipment and collectibles.

zh.name: 个人与商业财产评估师
zh.summary: 动产与企业财产估价人员核对标的状态与来源，寻找可比交易，并说明所用方法和价值假设。珠宝、设备和收藏品的证据各不相同。

en.name: Arbitrators, Mediators, and Conciliators
en.summary: Arbitrators hear evidence and issue decisions under the applicable procedure. Mediators help parties negotiate, and conciliators’ authority depends on the process and agreement.

zh.name: 仲裁员、调解员与和解员
zh.summary: 仲裁员按适用程序听取证据并作出裁决；调解员帮助当事人协商；和解角色的权限取决于程序和约定。

en.name: Architects, Except Landscape and Naval
en.summary: Architects turn site conditions, client needs and technical constraints into building designs, coordinate consultants and communicate through drawings and site work.

zh.name: 建筑师（不含景观与船舶）
zh.summary: 建筑师把场地条件、业主需求和工程约束转化为空间方案，协调顾问并组织图纸和现场沟通。辅助设计与专业签章分属不同责任。

en.name: Architect
en.summary: Building architects coordinate plans, construction details and consultant interfaces. Drawings and records communicate design decisions; authority to sign depends on registration and project responsibility.

zh.name: 建筑师
zh.summary: 建筑设计师围绕建筑物本身组织平面、构造和专业接口，把设计决定传达到图纸和协作记录；具体签章权限取决于注册和项目职责。

en.name: Architectural and civil drafter
en.summary: Architectural and civil drafters turn sketches and survey data into drawings, check dimensions and elevations, and flag conflicts to the responsible designer.

zh.name: 建筑土木制图员
zh.summary: 建筑与土木制图员把设计草图和测量数据转成工程图纸，核对尺寸、标高和版本，并将冲突交设计责任人确认。

en.name: Architectural and Engineering Managers
en.summary: Architectural and engineering managers translate technical goals into budgets, schedules, staffing and reviews. They coordinate changes across disciplines and track who can approve them.

zh.name: 建筑与工程经理
zh.summary: 建筑与工程经理把技术目标拆成预算、进度、人员和评审安排，并协调跨专业变更。项目管理授权与各专业的签署责任需分别确认。

en.name: Architecture Teachers (Postsecondary)
en.summary: Postsecondary architecture teachers prepare courses, lead studio critiques and assess design work. Research and advising may also be part of the role.

zh.name: 建筑学教师（高等教育）
zh.summary: 高校建筑学教师备课、组织工作室评图并评价学生设计，岗位也可能包括研究和学生指导。教学职责和工程执业权限分别核对。

en.name: Archivists
en.summary: Archivists appraise and describe records, document provenance, preserve material and make it discoverable within access rules.

zh.name: 档案管理员
zh.summary: 档案管理员判断材料的保存价值，记录来源和保管关系，组织描述与检索，并按开放规则提供利用。纸质与数字材料的保存方式各异。

en.name: Area, Ethnic, and Cultural Studies Teachers, Postsecondary
en.summary: Postsecondary area, ethnic and cultural studies teachers use regional history, cultural material and social research to build courses and discussions.

zh.name: 高校地区、民族和文化研究教师
zh.summary: 高校地区、民族和文化研究教师用地区史、文化材料或社会研究组织课程和讨论，考查学生能否把主张与来源连起来。

en.name: Art Directors
en.summary: Art directors turn a project brief into visual direction, give design and production teams clear standards, review drafts and guide delivery. Brand, publishing, film and digital projects differ in approval roles, budgets and asset rights.

zh.name: 艺术总监
zh.summary: 艺术总监把项目目标转成视觉方向，给设计、摄影或制作团队明确标准，审稿并管理交付。品牌、出版、影视或数字产品的审批人、预算和素材使用条件不同。

en.name: Art Therapists
en.summary: Art therapists use visual art-making in a professional care relationship, communicate with clients and document what happened, consent and follow-up. Mainland psychiatric and rehabilitation services offer related examples. In the U.S., compare graduate preparation, ATCB credentials and state licensure separately.

zh.name: 艺术治疗师
zh.summary: 艺术治疗师在专业照护关系中使用视觉艺术创作，与来访者沟通，并记录过程、同意与后续安排。大陆精神心理科和精神康复项目可见相关做法；先核岗位实际职责和资质。美国艺术治疗硕士、ATCB 认证与州执照需分开看。

en.name: Astronomers
en.summary: Astronomers observe, research and interpret astronomical phenomena, turn observational or simulated data into reviewable conclusions, and keep the data, code, papers and conclusions consistent with one another. In the United States this corresponds to O*NET 19-2011.00 (Astronomers), usually entered with doctoral-level training; O*NET lists this occupation as Job Zone Five (SVP 8.0 and above). China’s 2022 occupational classification includes astronomy research professionals (2-01-06-04), providing a reference for comparing duties rather than a verified one-to-one O*NET crosswalk. The NBS 2025 wage release reviewed here reports industry and broad job-category averages, not a separate wage distribution for astronomers.

zh.name: 天文学家
zh.summary: 天文学家观测、研究并解释天文现象，把观测或模拟数据变成可复核的结论，并让数据、代码、论文与结论彼此一致。美国侧对应 O*NET 19-2011.00（Astronomers），通常以博士层级训练入门；O*NET 把该职业列为 Job Zone Five（SVP 8.0 以上）。中国《职业分类大典（2022年版）》列有“天文学研究人员”（2-01-06-04），可作职责对照，不能直接视为O*NET的一对一映射。本页所核国家统计局2025年工资公告按行业和宽岗位类别汇总，未提供天文学家单列工资分布。

en.name: Athletes and sports competitors
en.summary: Athletes train and compete under their sport’s rules, while tracking workload, recovery and equipment. Work arrangements vary by sport and level.

zh.name: 运动员与体育竞赛选手
zh.summary: 运动员按项目规则训练、备赛和比赛，同时跟踪训练负荷、恢复和器材。职业条件随项目、赛事等级和用人方式变化。

en.name: Athletic trainers
en.summary: Athletic trainers work in health care, focusing on injury prevention, assessment, emergency coordination and rehabilitation support. Related mainland roles include sports injury protection and team rehabilitation. Fitness coaching is a different job with different training and responsibilities.

zh.name: 运动训练师
zh.summary: 这里的运动训练师指美国 Athletic Trainer，关注运动损伤预防、评估、急救协作与康复支持。大陆更接近运动防护师或随队运动康复岗位，和健身教练的日常、资格与责任不同。

en.name: Atmospheric and Space Scientists
en.summary: Atmospheric and space scientists interpret observations from stations, instruments, satellites or radar. Roles may emphasize research, forecasting or reports.

zh.name: 大气与空间科学家
zh.summary: 大气与空间科学家用地面观测、探空、卫星或雷达资料解释大气现象。岗位可能侧重资料研究、预测或服务报告。

en.name: Audio and Video Technicians
en.summary: Audio and video technicians set up, test, run and strike equipment for events or recordings. They trace inputs and outputs against the run sheet and document faults. Unclear power, rigging or authorization goes to the responsible person.

zh.name: 音频视频技术员
zh.summary: 音频视频技术员为活动或录制搭建、测试、运行并撤收设备。按节目单追踪输入与输出，记录声音和画面异常；供电、吊挂或授权有疑问时，把受影响的环节交给有权限的人处理。

en.name: Audiologists
en.summary: Audiologists assess and manage hearing, balance and related problems. Their work includes checking test conditions, explaining results and following up. Mainland employers may advertise audiology or hearing-test technician roles; check the actual duties and authorization for each job.

zh.name: 听力学家
zh.summary: 听力学家评估和管理听力、平衡及相关问题，工作包括核查检测条件、解释结果与随访。大陆医疗机构招聘可称听力师或电测听技师；岗位权限要逐项核。

en.name: Audiovisual Equipment Installers and Repairers
en.summary: Audiovisual equipment installers and repairers install, adjust and service televisions, audio equipment or video systems. They verify the fault, record open items and hand off the result. Home service, meeting room integration and event work differ.

zh.name: 视听设备安装与维修人员
zh.summary: 视听设备安装与维修人员按工单安装、调校和检修电视、音响或视频系统，核对故障是否消失，记录未决项并交接。家庭售后、会议室集成与活动技术岗位的日常不同。

en.name: Automotive and Watercraft Service Attendants
en.summary: These attendants provide fuel, supplies, simple checks or payment services, depending on the job. Roadside filling stations, marine fueling, auto repair and boat repair have different equipment, rules and authorizations.

zh.name: 汽车与船艇服务员
zh.summary: 汽车与船艇服务员按岗位分工提供燃油、补给、简单检查或收款。公路加油站、船舶燃料供应、汽车维修和船艇维修适用的设备、规则与授权不同。

en.name: Automotive Body and Glass Repairers
en.summary: Body repairers assess structural and panel damage, record measurements, plan repairs or replacements and check work against manufacturer requirements. Glass repair is an adjacent role. The main U.S. figures here are for body and related repairers (49-3021), with glass and combined figures shown separately.

zh.name: 汽车车身与玻璃维修工
zh.summary: 车身维修人员按车损工单评估结构和外板，记录尺寸，安排整形、零件修复或更换，并按制造商要求复检。玻璃修复是相邻岗位。下列美国主要数字采用车身及相关维修 49-3021，玻璃与合并组另列。

en.name: Automotive Engineering Technicians
en.summary: Automotive engineering technicians help engineers prepare tests, verify instruments and test conditions, record performance or durability data, and flag anomalies. O*NET 17-3027.01 is the detailed role. U.S. pay and employment figures here use the broader mechanical engineering technician group (17-3027).

zh.name: 汽车工程技术员
zh.summary: 汽车工程技术员协助工程师搭建试验、核量具和测试条件，记录性能或耐久数据并报告异常。美国 O*NET 17-3027.01 是细分角色；页面美国工资和就业引用机械工程技术人员 17-3027 的上级统计。

en.name: Automotive Engineers
en.summary: Automotive engineers define vehicle or component requirements, compare design options, plan verification and track cross-team changes and open risks. O*NET 17-2141.02 is the automotive specialization. U.S. wages and employment use the broader mechanical engineer group (17-2141).

zh.name: 汽车工程师
zh.summary: 汽车工程师定义整车或部件的需求，比较设计方案，组织验证，并跟踪跨团队的变更与待核风险。O*NET 17-2141.02 是汽车细项；美国工资和就业引用上级机械工程师 17-2141。

en.name: Automotive Glass Installers and Repairers
en.summary: Automotive glass installers check vehicle and glass specifications, assess whether to repair or replace the glass, and document fitting and inspection. A vehicle with a camera or other equipment may also require a calibration check or handoff. U.S. occupation 49-3022 is separate from body repair.

zh.name: 汽车玻璃安装工
zh.summary: 汽车玻璃安装维修工核对车辆与玻璃规格、评估修复还是更换，并记录装配和检验。带摄像头等配置的车辆，还要核对是否另有校准或交接要求。美国细项 49-3022 与车身钣喷分列。

en.name: Automotive Service Technicians and Mechanics
en.summary: Automotive service technicians check vehicle condition and work orders, diagnose mechanical and electrical faults, and verify authorized repairs against manufacturer information. Mechanical work, body repair, commercial vehicles and high-voltage EV work have different requirements.

zh.name: 汽车维修技师与机械师
zh.summary: 汽车维修技师核对车况和工单，诊断机械与电气问题，按厂商资料和授权维修并复检。机修、车身修复、商用车及新能源高压工作各有不同职责和培训要求。

en.name: Aviation Inspectors
en.summary: Aviation inspectors compare maintenance records and inspection evidence with applicable standards, identify defects and document what can be verified. Employer quality checks, maintenance release and regulatory enforcement carry different authority. Check what the role delivers and who signs it.

zh.name: 航空检查员
zh.summary: 航空检查员对照维修记录、检查证据与适用标准，识别缺陷并留下可复核报告。单位内部质检、维修放行和监管执法是不同权限；先辨认岗位交付什么、由谁签字。

en.name: Avionics Technicians
en.summary: Avionics technicians install, inspect and troubleshoot aircraft electronics, including communications and navigation equipment. Line work centers on systems and work cards; bench repair centers on serial numbers, test records and fault reproduction. Verify maintenance, inspection and return-to-service authority separately.

zh.name: 航空电子技术员
zh.summary: 航空电子技术员安装、检查和排查航空器的通信、导航等电子设备。航线作业关注系统与工卡；部件维修更看重台架记录、序列号和故障复现条件。维修作业、检查和签署放行的权限分别核对。

en.name: Baggage Porters and Bellhops
en.summary: Baggage porters and bellhops receive, tag and move luggage and verify handoffs. Hotel bell staff may also guide guests. U.S. occupation 39-6011 groups those duties; compare concierge and other terminal jobs separately.

zh.name: 行李员
zh.summary: 酒店和交通场站行李员接收、标记、搬运行李并核对交接。酒店礼宾行李岗位还可能引导宾客。美国 39-6011 将这些任务归入同一职业；礼宾咨询及其他站场岗位需分别核对。

en.name: Bailiffs
en.summary: U.S. bailiffs maintain courtroom order, support safety and hand off people or materials under agency procedures. Mainland Chinese judicial police, contract judicial police assistants and court clerks have distinct roles. Recruitment notices provide examples of related work.

zh.name: 法警
zh.summary: 美国 Bailiffs 在法院维持庭审秩序、协助保障安全，并按机构授权交接人员或物品。司法警察、聘用制司法警务辅助人员和书记员在中国大陆职责不同；公开招聘可作相邻岗位参考。

en.name: Bakers
en.summary: Bakers weigh, mix and shape ingredients, monitor proofing and baking, and record batch quality. Shops may make smaller runs of several products, while factories emphasize consistency and handover. Ask about shifts, standing, heat and who can release finished goods.

zh.name: 面包师
zh.summary: 面包师按配方称量、搅拌和成型，跟进发酵与烘烤，记录批次和质量。门店常做少量多款，工厂更看重批次一致性与交班。求职先核班次、站立高温及谁能放行成品。

en.name: Barbers
en.summary: Barbers confirm the length, shape and service before cutting, trimming or styling. They follow the shop’s hygiene rules for tools. Compare quick-cut shops, full-service salons and shop management by workload, skills, hygiene duties and pay arrangement.

zh.name: 理发师
zh.summary: 理发师先确认顾客想保留的长度、轮廓和服务范围，再剪修、造型并按门店规程处理用具。求职时分清快剪、综合美发和店务管理，各岗位的客流、手艺、卫生责任和计酬方式不同。

en.name: Hairdressers, Hairstylists, and Cosmetologists
en.summary: Hairdressers and hairstylists discuss client needs, provide haircuts, styling and applicable care, and document services and hygiene requirements. This page uses U.S. occupation 39-5012. Barbers (39-5011) are separate. Check Mainland hairdressing, beauty services, shop hygiene and medical aesthetics separately.

zh.name: 美发师、发型师与美容师
zh.summary: 美发师与发型师和顾客确认需求，提供修剪、造型和适用的护理，并记录服务和卫生要求。此页美国统计采用 39-5012；理发师 39-5011 另列。中国大陆美发师、美容师、门店卫生和医疗美容各按适用范围核对。

en.name: Baristas
en.summary: Baristas take orders, prepare and serve drinks, check ingredient information, clean their station and hand over open issues. O*NET 35-3023.01 describes barista duties. U.S. wage and outlook figures use the parent occupation, fast food and counter workers (35-3023). The two Mainland examples are historical listings from a Shenzhen chain and a Beijing campus kitchen.

zh.name: 咖啡师
zh.summary: 咖啡师接单、制作与交付饮品，也要核对配料、做好清洁和交接。美国 O*NET 的 35-3023.01 对应咖啡师任务；公开薪酬和预测采用上位快餐与柜台服务 35-3023。大陆两则招聘分别是深圳连锁门店和北京高校食堂的历史岗位。

en.name: Bartenders
en.summary: Bartenders take orders, prepare drinks to recipes and guest requests, check applicable service requirements, and keep tickets and handovers clear. Hotel bars, restaurants and banquets differ in pace, stock duties and shifts.

zh.name: 调酒师
zh.summary: 调酒师接单、按配方与客人要求配饮、检查适用服务条件，记录账单并交班。酒店吧台、餐厅和宴会的客流、备货及夜班安排不同。

en.name: Bicycle Repairers
en.summary: Bicycle repairers check the customer’s description, bike and parts, inspect brakes, gears and wheels, and document work and rechecks. U.S. statistics use 49-3091. The Mainland category also covers e-bikes. This page presents Jining’s historical wage table and public fleet service examples separately.

zh.name: 自行车修理工
zh.summary: 自行车维修工核对顾客描述、车辆和零件，检查刹车、变速、轮组等，记录修前和复核状态。美国统计采用 49-3091。大陆职业分类包括电动自行车，本页分开列济宁历史工资和公共车队服务项目。

en.name: Bill and Account Collectors
en.summary: Bill and account collectors review overdue balances, contact history and dispute records, and communicate or hand off within their authority. U.S. statistics use 43-3011. Consumer debt rules have defined coverage. Mainland agency management and asset recovery examples describe related roles and do not establish comparable wages.

zh.name: 账单与账款催收员
zh.summary: 账款催收员核对逾期账款、联系记录和争议资料，按机构授权沟通或转交。美国统计采用 43-3011；消费者债务规则看适用范围。大陆的委外管理和资产保全是相邻岗位，招聘样本不用于估计同岗工资。

en.name: Biochemists and biophysicists
en.summary: Biochemists and biophysicists use experiments or models to study molecules and cells. Typical work includes designing controls, recording batches, analyzing results and explaining limitations. Bench roles focus on samples and records; computational roles focus on data, models and versions. Duties depend on the project and assigned authority. BLS Table 1.2 projects U.S. occupation 19-1021 to grow from about 35,200 jobs in 2025 to 39,500 in 2035, up 12.3%, with about 2,900 annual openings from growth and replacement.

zh.name: 生物化学家与生物物理学家
zh.summary: 生物化学与生物物理学家用实验或模型研究分子和细胞。典型工作是设计对照、记录批次、分析结果并说明限制。偏实验的岗位关注样品和记录；偏计算的岗位关注数据、模型和版本。实际职责看课题和授权。 美国 BLS 表 1.2 对本职业 19-1021 的 2025 年基期约为 35,200 个岗位，2035 年预计 39,500 个，增长 12.3%，年均空缺约 2,900 个，包含增长与替补。

en.name: Biofuels/biodiesel technology and product development managers
en.summary: Biofuels and biodiesel development managers lead applied work on feedstocks and processes and judge which results warrant trials or commercial evaluation.

zh.name: 生物燃料/生物柴油技术与产品开发经理
zh.summary: 生物燃料与生物柴油技术开发经理组织原料和工艺的应用研究，判断实验结果是否支持试制或后续商业化评估。

en.name: Biofuels Processing Technicians
en.summary: Biofuels processing technicians log materials, monitor fermentation or reactions and check equipment and batch records. Procedures define who responds to alarms or makes repairs.

zh.name: 生物燃料加工技术员
zh.summary: 生物燃料加工技术员按规程记录投料、监看发酵或反应过程，并检查设备和批次记录。报警与维修按岗位授权处置。

en.name: Biofuels Production Managers
en.summary: Biofuels production managers coordinate staffing, output, safety and plant operations. They investigate deviations and track corrective work.

zh.name: 生物燃料生产经理
zh.summary: 生物燃料生产经理组织班次、产量、安全和设备运行，分析生产偏差并安排纠正与复核。与工艺研发岗位相比，重点在稳定生产。

en.name: Bioinformatics Scientists
en.summary: Bioinformatics scientists use computational and statistical methods to study biological data such as genomes and transcriptomes. They define questions, choose data and methods, review anomalies, record versions and explain results and limits. Scientists often focus on design and interpretation, while support roles may focus on running and maintaining workflows. Check the actual position. BLS projects the U.S. parent group Biological Scientists, All Other (19-1029) from about 59,600 jobs in 2025 to 62,400 in 2035, up 4.7%, a net gain of about 2,800, with about 4,300 annual openings from growth and replacement. The baseline includes 1.5% self-employment and does not isolate bioinformatics scientists.

zh.name: 生物信息学科学家
zh.summary: 生物信息学科学家用计算和统计方法研究基因组、转录组等生物数据。日常工作包括定义问题、选择数据和方法、复核异常、记录版本、解释结果与限制。科学家通常更侧重研究设计与解释；技术支持岗可能更侧重运行与维护，具体看招聘。 美国 BLS 上位组其他生物科学家 19-1029：2025 年就业约 59,600，2035 年预计 62,400，增长 4.7%，净增约 2,800，预计年均约 4,300 个空缺（含增长和替补）。基期含 1.5% 自雇，未单列生物信息学科学家。

en.name: Bioinformatics technicians
en.summary: Bioinformatics technicians help organize biological data, run analysis workflows and check quality. They document inputs, settings, outputs and exceptions so results can be reproduced.

zh.name: 生物信息技术员
zh.summary: 生物信息技术员协助研究人员整理生物数据、运行分析流程并做质量检查，记录输入、参数、输出和异常以便复现。

en.name: Biological technicians
en.summary: Biological technicians help prepare materials, check equipment, record work and flag deviations under the direction of researchers or team leads. Research support and manufacturing have different requirements. Check the actual duties and institutional procedures. BLS projects U.S. biological technicians (19-4021) from about 74,400 jobs in 2025 to 79,900 in 2035, up 7.4%, a net gain of about 5,500, with about 9,400 annual openings from growth and replacement. The 2025 baseline includes 0.1% self-employment.

zh.name: 生物技术员
zh.summary: 生物技术员在研究人员或团队负责人指导下准备材料、检查设备、记录实验和异常，交可复核的工作记录。研究支持与生产现场的条件不同；按实际岗位及机构程序核对职责。 美国 BLS 生物技术员 19-4021：2025 年就业约 74,400，2035 年预计 79,900，增长 7.4%，净增约 5,500，预计年均约 9,400 个空缺，含增长和替补。2025 基期含 0.1% 自雇。

en.name: Biologists
en.summary: Biologists study the structure, functions and relationships of organisms such as plants and animals. Depending on the job, they may design comparisons, observe organisms in the field or lab, organize samples and data, and report findings and limits. Check the actual role for research design, technical support and collection authority. BLS projects the U.S. parent group Biological Scientists, All Other (19-1029) from about 59,600 jobs in 2025 to 62,400 in 2035, up 4.7%, a net gain of about 2,800, with about 4,300 annual openings from growth and replacement. The baseline includes 1.5% self-employment. The data do not isolate biologists.

zh.name: 生物学家
zh.summary: 生物学家研究植物、动物等生物的结构、功能和相互关系。按岗位不同，工作可能包括设计对照、做野外或实验室观察、整理样本和数据，并写出结论与限制。研究设计、技术协助和现场采集权限分别看实际岗位。 美国 BLS 其他生物科学家上位组 19-1029：2025 年约 59,600，2035 年预计 62,400，增长 4.7%，净增约 2,800，年均空缺约 4,300，含增长和替补。2025 基期含 1.5% 自雇；未单列生物学家。

en.name: Biomass plant technicians
en.summary: Biomass plant technicians monitor units and auxiliary systems, inspect equipment, record readings, report anomalies and perform routine maintenance within their assigned authority. Fuel receiving, boiler operation and instrument maintenance may be separate jobs. Ask about the unit type, shift duties and who takes over abnormal conditions. BLS projects the U.S. Power Plant Operators parent group (51-8013) from about 29,800 jobs in 2025 to 28,300 in 2035, down 5.1%, a net decrease of about 1,500, with about 2,300 annual openings from growth and replacement. The baseline includes 0.3% self-employment. It does not isolate biomass technicians.

zh.name: 生物质电厂技术员
zh.summary: 生物质电厂技术员监测机组和辅助系统，按岗位授权巡检、记录参数、报告异常并做日常维护。燃料验收、锅炉运行和仪控检修可能分岗。判断岗位时，先问机组类型、值班范围和异常交接对象。 美国 BLS 电厂操作员上位组 51-8013：2025 年约 29,800 人，2035 年预计 28,300 人，净减约 1,500 人，下降 5.1%，年均约 2,300 个空缺，含增长和替补。基期含 0.3% 自雇，未单列生物质技术员。

en.name: Biomass power plant managers
en.summary: Biomass power plant managers coordinate operations, maintenance and safety. They review operating records, staffing, fuel supply and budgets and track who owns unresolved problems. A position may cover one specialty or an entire plant. Operating and approval authority depends on the role, equipment and plant procedures. BLS projects the U.S. Industrial Production Managers parent group (11-3051) from about 252,100 jobs in 2025 to 258,600 in 2035, up 2.6%, a net gain of about 6,500, with about 17,000 annual openings from growth and replacement. The baseline includes 2.4% self-employment. It does not isolate biomass power plant managers.

zh.name: 生物质电厂经理
zh.summary: 生物质发电厂经理组织电厂运行、检修与安全工作，核对运行记录、人员安排、燃料供应和预算，并跟踪异常由谁处理。职位可能主管某一专业或全厂。具体指挥和审批权限以实际岗位、设备与制度为准。 美国 BLS 工业生产经理上位组 11-3051：2025 年约 252,100 人，2035 年预计 258,600 人，净增约 6,500 人，增长 2.6%，年均约 17,000 个空缺，含增长和替补。基期含 2.4% 自雇，未单列生物质发电厂经理。

en.name: Bioengineers and biomedical engineers
en.summary: Device development turns clinical needs into designs that can be tested. Hospital engineering more often focuses on evaluating equipment, maintenance, quality checks and measurement. Choose a setting first, then check the role’s education, project experience and responsibilities.

zh.name: 生物工程师与生物医学工程师
zh.summary: 器械研发要把临床需求变成可验证的设计。医院医学工程更常围绕设备论证、维护、质量检测和计量。申请时先分清这两类工作，再查具体岗位学历、项目经历和职责。

en.name: Biostatisticians
en.summary: Biostatisticians (O*NET 15-2041.01) work with clinicians and life science or public health teams to turn questions into reviewable study designs and analysis plans, check inputs, and report results and limits. Qualified, authorized clinicians make medical judgments.

zh.name: 生物统计学家
zh.summary: 生物统计学家（岗位也常称生物统计师，O*NET 15-2041.01）与医生、生命科学或公共卫生团队协作，把问题写成可复核的研究设计和分析计划，核对输入、报告结果与限制。医学判断由具备资格并获授权的人员负责。

en.name: Blockchain engineers
en.summary: Blockchain engineers design, implement and test distributed ledgers, nodes, smart contracts or applications that connect on-chain and off-chain work. They document permissions, failure handling, tests and release evidence. Roles may focus on protocols, integration or platform operations. BLS projects the U.S. parent group Computer Occupations, All Other (15-1299) from about 471,200 jobs in 2025 to 495,300 in 2035. The published net gain is about 24,200 (5.1%), with about 27,000 annual openings from growth and replacement. The baseline includes 4.9% self-employment. The data do not isolate blockchain engineers.

zh.name: 区块链工程师
zh.summary: 区块链工程师设计、实现和测试分布式账本、节点、智能合约或链上链下应用。他们需要把权限、失败处理、测试和发布证据写清楚。不同岗位可能偏协议、应用集成或平台运维。 美国 BLS 其他计算机职业上位组 15-1299：2025 年约 471,200 人，2035 年预计 495,300 人，原表净增约 24,200 人，增长 5.1%，年均约 27,000 个空缺，含增长和替补。基期含 4.9% 自雇，不单列区块链工程师。

en.name: Bookkeeping, Accounting, and Auditing Clerks
en.summary: Bookkeeping, accounting and auditing clerks classify, post and check financial records. They reconcile entries and document differences; formal audit opinions require separate authority.

zh.name: 簿记、会计与审计文员
zh.summary: 簿记、会计与审计文员根据凭证分类、录入并核对财务交易，处理对账和记录差异。正式审计意见另有专业和授权要求。

en.name: Brickmasons and Blockmasons
en.summary: Brickmasons and blockmasons lay brick, block or structural tile from drawings and check courses, joints, alignment and corners.

zh.name: 砖石与砌块工
zh.summary: 砖瓦和砌块工按图纸铺砌砖、砌块或结构瓦，检查灰缝、皮数及垂直度，并处理转角与收边。

en.name: Bridge and Lock Tenders
en.summary: Bridge and lock tenders operate or monitor facilities, check passage conditions, communicate signals and record events. Movable bridges, locks, ship lifts, vessel navigation and equipment maintenance have different duties and authorities.

zh.name: 活动桥与船闸运行员
zh.summary: 活动桥与船闸运行员按设施分工操作或值守，核对通行条件，沟通信号并记录事件。活动桥、船闸、升船机、船舶驾驶和设施维修的职责及授权各不相同。

en.name: Broadcast Announcers and Radio Disc Jockeys
en.summary: Broadcast announcers and radio DJs combine scripts, interviews, music and cues into a program and maintain required logs. Programming authority varies by station.

zh.name: 广播播音员与电台唱片骑师
zh.summary: 广播播音员与电台 DJ 把稿件、访谈、音乐和节目提示接成连续播出，并维护必要的节目记录。具体选曲和制作权限按台站分工。

en.name: Broadcast Technicians
en.summary: Broadcast technicians monitor and maintain equipment used to capture, transmit or air audio and video. They check signal quality and document faults and responses.

zh.name: 广播技术员
zh.summary: 广播技术员监看和维护音视频采集、传输或播出设备，检查信号质量并记录异常与处置。岗位通常按播出链路环节分工。

en.name: Brokerage Clerks
en.summary: Brokerage clerks check trade, instruction and position records and reconcile fees or dividends. Investment decisions and approvals follow separate authority.

zh.name: 经纪文员
zh.summary: 证券经纪文员核对交易、指令和持仓记录，处理费用、股息或对账差异。客户投资决定和交易批准按职责与权限另行处理。

en.name: Brownfield redevelopment specialists and site managers
en.summary: Brownfield redevelopment specialists and site managers coordinate investigation, cleanup and reuse of contaminated sites. Reuse depends on evidence and approvals.

zh.name: 棕地再开发专家与场地经理
zh.summary: 棕地再开发专家与场地经理组织受污染地块的调查、清理及再利用计划，协调技术、监管和建设参与方。地块可用性须看证据和审批。

en.name: Budget Analysts
en.summary: Budget analysts review revenue and cost estimates, compare actual spending with plans, and explain assumptions and constraints for resource decisions.

zh.name: 预算分析师
zh.summary: 预算分析师审查收入和支出估算、比较执行差异，并解释成本假设和合规限制，为资源分配提供可复核的依据。

en.name: Bus and Truck Mechanics and Diesel Engine Specialists
en.summary: Bus and truck mechanics diagnose and repair commercial vehicles and diesel engines, then document what the repair resolved.

zh.name: 公交卡车机械师与柴油机专员
zh.summary: 公交与卡车机械师检查故障、定位原因并维修商用车及柴油机。工单需记录验证结果与未解决问题。

en.name: Business continuity planners
en.summary: Business continuity planners map critical services, dependencies and disruption impacts. They define recovery priorities and test handoffs in exercises.

zh.name: 业务连续性规划师
zh.summary: 业务连续性规划师梳理关键服务、依赖和中断影响，制定恢复顺序并通过演练验证交接。

en.name: Business intelligence analysts
en.summary: Business intelligence analysts query data, define metrics and build reports. They explain changes and how metric definitions affect them.

zh.name: 分析师商业
zh.summary: 商业智能分析师从数据仓库取数、定义指标并生成报表，解释数字变化与口径限制。

en.name: Butchers and meat cutters
en.summary: Butchers and meat cutters prepare consumer-sized portions of meat for retail sale, including cuts requested by customers. Work may include weighing and labeling, displaying products, checking deliveries, keeping stock records and cleaning equipment. This U.S. retail occupation is distinct from other meat-processing and slaughter occupations; compare the actual duties of a specific job.

zh.name: 屠宰工肉类切割工
zh.summary: 本页条目对应屠宰工肉类切割工（O*NET-SOC 51-3021.00，Butchers and Meat Cutters）：在零售场所切割、修整或准备供使用或销售的消费规格份量肉类——按规格分割、修整、去骨、捆扎与绞碎，按顾客要求处理特殊切法，包裹、称重、贴标签并定价，陈列与补货、估算需求并订货，收货检验与储存，清洁消毒肉柜与切割设备并完成交接记录；工作以长时间站立的手工作业为主（86% 持续站立、93% 持续用手操作、82% 每天接触危险设备、86% 每天佩戴防护装备），其职责不等于检验检疫与食品安全监管，也不替代设备维修与门店经营决策。

en.name: Cabinetmakers and Bench Carpenters
en.summary: Cabinetmakers and bench carpenters cut, join and finish parts from drawings and check fit during assembly.

zh.name: 橱柜制造工台架木工
zh.summary: 橱柜制造与台架木工把图纸转成裁切、接合、装配和表面处理工作，核对尺寸与配合。

en.name: Calibration Technologists and Technicians
en.summary: Calibration technicians compare instruments with reference standards, record deviations and conditions, and follow procedures for out-of-tolerance readings.

zh.name: 校准技术员
zh.summary: 校准技术员把仪器读数与参考标准对比，记录偏差、条件和可追溯信息，并按规程处理超差。

en.name: Camera and Photographic Equipment Repairers
en.summary: Camera repairers inspect optical, mechanical or electronic components, make repairs and verify whether the reported fault recurs.

zh.name: 摄影摄像设备修理工
zh.summary: 摄影设备修理工依据故障描述检查光学、机械或电子部件，完成维修并复测故障是否复现。

en.name: Captains, Mates, and Pilots of Water Vessels
en.summary: Captains, mates and vessel pilots support navigation through distinct command, watchkeeping and local pilotage duties.

zh.name: 船长、大副与船舶引航员
zh.summary: 船长、大副和引航员参与船舶航行与值班协作，分别承担指挥、船上值守或当地引航等职责。

en.name: Cardiovascular Technologists and Technicians
en.summary: Cardiovascular technologists and technicians prepare tests, collect or monitor data and document quality under clinical protocols.

zh.name: 心血管技师与技术员
zh.summary: 心血管技师与技术员按临床流程准备检查、采集或监测数据并记录质量。检查项目和可承担的操作依岗位授权。

en.name: Career/technical education teachers, middle school
en.summary: Middle-school career and technical education teachers introduce tools, materials and occupations through age-appropriate activities.

zh.name: 初中职业技术教育教师
zh.summary: 初中职业技术教师让学生用适龄活动认识工具、材料和职业任务，重点是基本操作、安全和探索。

en.name: Career/technical education teachers, secondary school
en.summary: Secondary career and technical education teachers teach specialized courses and supervise project work and equipment use.

zh.name: 高中职业技术教育教师
zh.summary: 高中职业技术教师组织专业课程、示范和项目实践，监督学生使用设备，并记录技能进展。

en.name: Cargo and Freight Agents
en.summary: Cargo and freight agents book transport, arrange pickup, check shipping documents, track milestones and hand off exceptions. Find out what the role can promise, who can release a shipment, and who handles customs or dangerous goods.

zh.name: 货运代理与单证操作员
zh.summary: 货运代理与单证操作员安排订舱和提货、核对运输单证、跟踪节点并交接异常。先核拟任岗位能承诺什么、由谁确认放行，以及报关、危险品等业务由谁负责。

en.name: Carpenters
en.summary: Carpenters measure, cut, install or repair wood components, check dimensions and flag discrepancies at the site.

zh.name: 木工
zh.summary: 木工依图纸测量、切配、安装或维修木质构件，核对位置与尺寸，并把现场偏差交给负责人。

en.name: Carpet installers
en.summary: Carpet installers measure floors, plan cuts and seams, lay underlay and finish edges. Batch and pile direction affect the result.

zh.name: 地毯安装工
zh.summary: 地毯安装工测量基层、规划裁切及拼缝、铺设衬垫并处理边缘。材料批次和纹向会影响交付效果。

en.name: Cartographers and Photogrammetrists
en.summary: Cartographers and photogrammetrists turn imagery and survey data into mapped features and document accuracy, coordinates and versions.

zh.name: 制图师与摄影测量师
zh.summary: 制图师和摄影测量师从影像、测量及空间数据提取地物并制作地图，记录精度、坐标和版本。

en.name: Cashiers
en.summary: Cashiers verify items, prices and payment status, issue receipts and balance the till. They keep a record and escalate duplicate payments, refunds outside their authority and cash discrepancies.

zh.name: 收银员
zh.summary: 收银员核对商品、价格和付款状态，开具凭证，并在班末对账。遇到重复扣款、退款权限或钱箱差异，先保存凭证，再请有权限的同事处理。

en.name: Cement Masons and Concrete Finishers
en.summary: Cement masons and concrete finishers level and finish surfaces, check slopes and elevations and document issues for the next crew.

zh.name: 水泥泥瓦工混凝土修整工
zh.summary: 混凝土修整工按要求整平、收面并检查标高、坡度和表面，交接缺陷和养护要求。

en.name: Chefs and Head Cooks
en.summary: Chefs and head cooks plan menus and prep, coordinate stations and supervise food quality and safety.

zh.name: 主厨与厨师长
zh.summary: 主厨与厨师长组织菜单、备料与出餐，分配厨房岗位并监督成品和食品安全。

en.name: Chemical Engineers
en.summary: Chemical engineers turn material, energy and safety requirements into process designs and specify equipment, controls and verification.

zh.name: 化学工程师
zh.summary: 化学工程师把物料、能量和安全要求转化为可运行的工艺设计，说明设备选择、控制策略和验证条件。

en.name: Chemical Equipment Operators and Tenders
en.summary: Chemical equipment operators monitor assigned equipment, record readings and report anomalies under procedures that define authorized actions.

zh.name: 化工设备操作与看护员
zh.summary: 化工设备操作员按规程看护指定设备、监测记录并通报异常。开阀、投料和参数调整以岗位授权为准。

en.name: Chemical Technicians
en.summary: Chemical technicians prepare samples, run instruments, check quality controls and document results for research or quality teams.

zh.name: 化学技术员
zh.summary: 化学技术员准备样品、操作检测仪器、核对质量控制结果并记录数据，为研发或质量团队提供可追溯记录。

en.name: Chemistry Teachers, Postsecondary
en.summary: Postsecondary chemistry teachers teach chemical concepts and analytical methods, supervise lab learning and assess students’ interpretation of data.

zh.name: 高校化学教师
zh.summary: 高校化学教师把化学概念和分析方法转成课堂与实验活动，监督实验教学并评价学生的数据解释。

en.name: Chemists
en.summary: Chemists design or run experiments and analyses, interpret material or compound data and document methods and reproducibility conditions.

zh.name: 化学家
zh.summary: 化学家设计或执行实验和分析，解释化合物或材料数据，说明方法、结果和可重复性条件。

en.name: Chief sustainability officers
en.summary: Chief sustainability officers coordinate targets, metrics, projects and reporting evidence across leadership and operating teams.

zh.name: 首席可持续发展官
zh.summary: 可持续发展负责人协调管理层与业务部门设定目标、定义指标并追踪项目和披露证据。

en.name: Child, Family, and School Social Workers
en.summary: Child, family and school social workers assess needs, coordinate services and referrals, and document follow-up under applicable privacy and safeguarding rules.

zh.name: 儿童、家庭与学校社会工作者
zh.summary: 儿童、家庭与学校社工评估需求、协调服务和转介，并持续记录个案。隐私、保护职责和信息共享按适用要求处理。

en.name: Childcare workers
en.summary: Childcare workers supervise activities and document meals, rest and concerns for colleagues or families. Health tasks follow center procedures.

zh.name: 儿童照护人员
zh.summary: 儿童照护人员监督日常活动，记录用餐、休息和异常，与家长和同事交接；健康和用药依机构规定。

en.name: Chiropractors
en.summary: Chiropractors assess musculoskeletal concerns, document risks and track responses. Scope, referral and permitted procedures depend on jurisdiction.

zh.name: 整脊医师
zh.summary: 脊椎手法治疗相关临床岗位评估肌肉骨骼问题、记录风险与治疗反应。执业范围、转诊和可做操作按当地规则核对。

en.name: Choreographers
en.summary: Create new dance works and rehearse the production: study the music and text, generate and record movement material, lead rehearsals and guide technique and safety, arrange space and formations, direct and stage the presentation, and collaborate with production roles such as music and costume and lighting.

zh.name: 编舞师
zh.summary: 创作新的舞蹈作品并排练作品演出：研究音乐与文本、生成并记录动作素材、带排练并指导技术与安全、安排空间与队形、执导与搬演呈现，并与音乐与服装与灯光等制作岗位协作。

en.name: Civil engineers
en.summary: Civil engineers plan and design infrastructure, review technical documents, and oversee construction or maintenance. Duties vary by project and discipline.

zh.name: 土木工程师
zh.summary: 土木工程师参与道路、桥梁、建筑及给排水等设施的规划与设计，核对技术资料，并配合施工和维护。具体工作随项目和专业分工而变。

en.name: Cleaners of vehicles and equipment
en.summary: Cleaning vehicles, machinery and other equipment with water and cleaning agents and brushes and cloths and hoses and similar materials: rinsing and scrubbing and spraying mechanical parts and equipment and vehicles, mixing cleaning solutions to formula, adjusting pressure and flow per the equipment manual, checking cleanliness and damage and polishing and waxing and lubricating and fitting trim as needed, and leaving verifiable job and anomaly records.

zh.name: 车辆与设备清洁工
zh.summary: 用水与清洁剂与刷子与布与软管等材料清洗车辆与机械与其他设备：冲洗与擦洗与喷淋机械零件与设备与车辆、按配方配制清洗液、按设备说明书调节压力与流量、检查清洁度与损坏并按需抛光打蜡与润滑与安装饰件，并留下可核对的作业与异常记录。

en.name: Clergy
en.summary: Lead religious worship and perform other spiritual functions associated with beliefs and practices of a religious faith or denomination, providing members with spiritual and moral guidance and assistance: prepare and deliver sermons, recite scriptures, organise and lead regular and special ceremonies, visit and counsel those in need and refer to procedure, train leaders and plan religious education, and handle the congregation's financial and administrative and personnel affairs.

zh.name: 神职人员
zh.summary: 主持宗教礼拜并履行与信仰或教派信念与实践相关的其他精神职能，为成员提供精神与道德指引与帮助：准备并宣讲讲道、诵读经书、组织并主持例行与特别仪式、探访与辅导有需要的人并按规程转介、训练带领者与筹划宗教教育、并处理堂会的财务与行政与人员事务。

en.name: Climate change policy analysts
en.summary: Research and analyse climate change related policy developments and make climate-related recommendations for action such as legislation and awareness-raising activities or fundraising methods: collect and review research and regulations and data, analyse and distil research conclusions, write research reports and briefs and testimony, present and defend at meetings and in public, promote mitigation action and education and outreach, and prepare grant applications to obtain funding for projects.

zh.name: 气候变化政策分析师
zh.summary: 研究与分析气候变化相关政策进展，并为立法与意识提升活动或筹款方法等行动提出与气候相关的建议：收集并审阅研究与法规与数据、分析与提炼研究结论、撰写研究报告与简报与证词、在会议与公开场合陈述与答辩、推动减缓举措与教育外展，并准备拨款申请为项目取得经费。

en.name: Clinical Data Managers
en.summary: Use medical and health and database management knowledge to analyze clinical data and identify and report trends: design and validate clinical databases and logical checks, process data and generate and resolve data queries, develop data management plans and write work instructions and standard operating procedures, perform quality control audits and monitor work output and quality, use statistical tools to analyze data and produce reports, and contribute to the writing and organization and production of controlled documents such as protocols and clinical study reports and regulatory submissions.

zh.name: 临床数据经理
zh.summary: 运用医疗健康与数据库管理知识分析临床数据并识别与报告趋势：设计并验证临床数据库与逻辑校验、处理数据并生成与解决数据查询、制定数据管理计划并编写作业指导书与标准操作程序、执行质量控制审计并监测工作产出与质量、使用统计工具分析数据并编制报告，并参与方案与临床研究报告与监管申报等受控文件的编写与组织与产出。

en.name: Clinical neuropsychologists
en.summary: Apply neuropsychological theory and standardized tests to assess higher brain function and behavioral problems related to acquired or developmental neurological disease: interview patients and obtain a complete history, administer assessments of intelligence and attention and memory and language, check validity and norm fit, integrate multi-source evidence into a report, establish a neurobehavioral baseline and compare progress before and after intervention, recommend treatment after diagnosis, give patients and families feedback on results and recommendations, and consult with other professionals about neurological status.

zh.name: 临床神经心理学家
zh.summary: 应用神经心理学理论与标准化测验评估与获得性或发育性神经系统疾病相关的高级脑功能与行为问题：访谈患者并获取完整病史、实施智力与注意与记忆与语言等评估、检查效度与常模适配、整合多源证据撰写报告、建立神经行为基线与比较干预前后进展，并在诊断后建议治疗、向患者与家庭反馈结果与建议、就神经系统状况与其他专业人员会诊。

en.name: Clinical nurse specialists
en.summary: Guide nursing staff in delivering patient care in clinical practice settings and ensure that nursing follows established clinical policies and procedures and regulations and standards: observe and interview and assess patients to identify care needs, provide direct and indirect care within a designated specialty, develop and maintain nursing practice standards and department policies, evaluate the quality and effectiveness of nursing practice or organizational systems and design improvements, guide and mentor nursing staff and deliver training, and provide consultation and clinical advice to the team and patients.

zh.name: 临床护士专员
zh.summary: 在临床实践场所指导护理人员提供患者照护并确保护理遵循既定的临床政策与规程与法规与标准：观察与访谈并评估患者以识别照护需求、在指定专科内提供直接与间接照护、制定与维护护理实践标准与科室政策、评估护理实践或组织系统的质量与有效性并设计改进、指导并带教护理人员与开展培训，并向团队与患者提供咨询与临床建议。

en.name: Clinical research coordinators
en.summary: Plan, direct, or coordinate clinical research projects, direct the staff working on clinical research projects to ensure compliance with the trial protocol and overall clinical objectives, and possibly evaluate and analyze clinical data: arrange and perform participant-related procedures per protocol, screen participants and obtain and document informed consent, prepare and maintain study documents and records, monitor study activities to ensure compliance with the protocol and local and federal and state regulations and institutional policies, record adverse event and side effect data and discuss reporting with the investigator, verify source data against the case report form, and prepare for or take part in sponsor and regulatory agency quality assurance monitoring.

zh.name: 临床研究协调员
zh.summary: 规划、指导或协调临床研究项目，指导从事临床研究项目的人员以确保遵循试验方案与总体临床目标，并可评估与分析临床数据：按方案安排并执行受试者相关操作、筛选受试者并取得与记录知情同意、准备并维护研究文件与记录、监测研究活动以确保遵循方案与地方与联邦与州法规及机构政策、记录不良事件与副作用数据并与研究者商议上报、核对源数据与病例报告表，并准备或参与申办方与监管机构的质量保证核查。

en.name: Coaches and scouts
en.summary: Instruct or coach groups or individuals in the fundamentals of a sport for the primary purpose of competition, demonstrate techniques and methods, and possibly evaluate athletes' strengths and weaknesses to consider recruitment or to improve their techniques for competition: plan and organize and lead practice sessions, provide training direction and encouragement and nutritional advice, adjust training methods to strengths and weaknesses, develop strategy and select players for competition, analyze opponents and evaluate athletes' skills and potential, identify and recruit prospective athletes and complete scouting reports, monitor equipment use and enforce safety rules and regulations, and manage sports program budgets and schedules and the coaching staff.

zh.name: 教练与球探
zh.summary: 以竞技为主要目的指导或训练团体或个人掌握运动基本技术，示范技术和方法，并可评估运动员的强项与弱项以考虑招募或为比赛改进其技术：计划与组织并主持训练课、提供训练方向与鼓励与营养建议、根据强项与弱项调整训练方法、为比赛制定策略并选择队员、分析对手并评估运动员技能与潜力、识别与招募潜在运动员并填写球探报告、监测器材使用并执行安全规则与规定，并管理体育项目预算与日程与教练团队。

en.name: Coating, painting, and spraying machine setters, operators, and tenders
en.summary: Set up, operate, or tend spraying or roll-coating machines that apply coatings or paint using varnish, silver paste, copper, rubber, clear oil, glaze, enamel, oils, or rust-preventive materials to products such as glassware, fabric, ceramics, metal, plastic, paper, or wood, including transportation vehicle painters (such as painters in automotive body repair shops): start and stop equipment and adjust nozzles, flow, and air pressure, apply rust-preventive primer and do seam filling and sealing, monitor the operation and identify and correct appearance defects, inspect and measure or weigh or test samples, disassemble, clean, and reassemble sprayers or power equipment, and dispose of hazardous waste properly and record operating data on the required forms.

zh.name: 涂装、油漆与喷涂机器操作员
zh.summary: 设置、操作或看管喷涂或滚涂机器，用清漆、银浆、铜、橡胶、清油、釉料、瓷漆、油类或防锈材料，为玻璃器皿、织物、陶瓷、金属、塑料、纸或木材等各类产品上涂料或油漆，并包含运输工具喷漆工（如汽车车身修复车间的喷漆人员）：启停设备并调整喷嘴与流量与气压、涂刷防锈底漆并做接缝填缝与密封、监控作业并识别与纠正外观缺陷、检查与测量或称量或测试样品、拆解清洁并重新装配喷涂器或动力设备、按适当方式处置危险废物并在规定表格上记录运行数据。

en.name: Coil winders, tapers, and finishers
en.summary: Operate or tend winding machines to wind wire into coils used in electrical components (such as resistors and transformers) and in electrical equipment and instruments (such as field cores, forms, armature cores, motors, generators, and control devices): determine the material and part types from the work order and specification, select and load workpieces and materials, use hand tools to terminate, reconnect, and trim wire and insulation, cut, strip, and bend the wire ends at the coil ends, use sheet insulation to line the slots and insert the coils, apply solution or varnish to the wound parts and bake them, use measuring devices to inspect and test wound electrical parts and record the test results, disassemble and assemble motors and repair and maintain electrical parts and machine parts, and record production and operating data on the required forms.

zh.name: 线圈绕线工、包扎工、修整工
zh.summary: 操作或看护绕线机，把用于电气元件（如电阻器与变压器）以及电气设备与仪器（如励磁铁芯与线架与电枢铁芯与电动机与发电机与控制设备）的导线绕成线圈：按工单与规格确定材料与待加工零件类型、选择并装载工件与材料、用手工具接装与改接并修剪导线与绝缘、剪断与剥皮并弯折线圈端部的导线端头、用片状绝缘衬垫槽口并嵌入线圈、给已绕线部件涂覆溶液或漆并烘烤、用测量装置检查与测试已绕线电气部件并记录测试结果，拆装电机并维修保养电气部件与机器零件，并在规定表格上记录生产与运行数据。

en.name: Commercial Pilot
en.summary: Pilots and navigates fixed-wing aircraft or helicopters on nonscheduled flights; a commercial pilot's license is required; includes charter pilots with similar licenses and air ambulance and aerial tour pilots; excludes airline pilots of regional, domestic, and international airlines: verify per checklist whether the aircraft's engines and controls and instruments and other systems are normal; obtain and review payload weight and fuel supply and weather conditions and flight schedules and plan the flight; calculate the speed required for lift-off considering airport elevation and outside temperature and aircraft weight and wind direction and speed; verify baggage or cargo loading and submit an instrument flight plan to air traffic control; start engines and pilot and monitor engines and fuel and aircraft systems per procedure; use radio to contact control towers for takeoff clearance and arrival instructions and request altitude or route changes as circumstances require; select route and altitude and speed and fill in flight records; supervise the crew and instruct other pilots and students, and conduct rescue and evacuation when needed; and operate large drones or unmanned aircraft for commercial purposes.

zh.name: 商业飞行员
zh.summary: 在非定期航线上驾驶并导航固定翼航空器或直升机；须持有商业飞行员执照；包括持有类似执照的包机飞行员，以及空中救护与空中游览飞行员；不含地区、国内与国际航空公司的航线飞行员：按检查单核对航空器的发动机与操纵与仪表与其他系统；获取并复核载荷重量与燃油供应与天气条件与航班时刻并规划飞行；考虑机场标高与外界温度与飞机重量与风向风速计算离地所需速度；核对行李或货物装载并向空中交通管制提交仪表飞行计划；启动发动机并按程序驾驶与监控发动机与燃油与航空器系统；使用无线电联络管制塔台取得起飞许可与到达指令并按情况请求更改高度或航路；选择航路与高度与速度并填写飞行记录；监督机组并指导其他飞行员与学员，并在需要时实施救援与撤离；并为商业目的操作大型无人机或无人航空器。

en.name: Community health workers

zh.name: 社区健康工作者
zh.summary: 通过协助个人采取健康行为来促进社区健康；通过帮助社区居民与医疗服务提供者或社会服务机构有效沟通，为个人的健康需求担任倡导者；担任联络人或倡导者并实施促进、维持与改善个人与整体社区健康的项目；可提供血压、青光眼与听力筛查等健康相关预防服务；可收集数据以帮助识别社区健康需求：就自我照护与总体健康与风险预防与卫生与筛查向客户或社区团体提供建议；识别社区或目标区域中个人的特定健康照护需求并把社区成员转介到所需服务；为个人与家庭与社区团体制定改善整体健康的计划或正式契约；就个人或社区健康需求向政府机构或健康服务提供者倡导并反馈服务可及性；开展基础筛查并实施免疫与急救等基础预防处置；对孕妇与新生儿或其他高风险个人进行家访并监测高风险群体营养；维护客户档案并联系客户确认行动完成；参与社区会议与健康博览会并分发教育材料；并按需要向主管部门报告儿童或老人受虐待与忽视与伤害威胁的情形。

en.name: Compensation and benefits managers
en.summary: Compensation and benefits managers plan, direct, or coordinate an organization's compensation and benefits activities, including compensation policy and market benchmarking, benefit policy evaluation, reporting duties, budget, personnel data, and employee communication; negotiation and merger integration and hearings are undertaken depending on the specific position. Plan and signing authority is confirmed against employer policy, and retirement benefit fiduciary responsibility is judged by the applicable jurisdiction and actual management function.

zh.name: 薪酬与福利经理
zh.summary: 薪酬与福利经理规划、指导或协调组织的薪酬与福利活动，包括薪酬政策与市场对标、福利政策评估、报告义务、预算、人事数据和员工沟通；谈判、并购整合及听证等依具体岗位承担。方案与签字权限按雇主制度确认，退休福利受托责任按适用法域和实际管理职能判断。

en.name: Compensation, Benefits, and Job Analysis Specialists
en.summary: Conduct compensation, benefits and job analysis programs for employers, and may specialize in areas such as job classification and pension plans: manage employee insurance and pension and savings plans and collaborate with insurance brokers and plan carriers; ensure the company complies with federal and state laws and complete reporting obligations; study employee benefits and health and safety practices and recommend changes to current policies; evaluate jobs, document the basis for classification, exemption and pay recommendations, and refer final decisions to the authorized role; prepare occupational classifications and job descriptions and pay grade tables; develop and manage compensation programs such as pay-for-performance or incentive pay; conduct multi-factor data and cost analysis; collect job information through observation and interviews and questionnaires and focus groups and develop job analysis tools; advise managers and employees on state and federal employment regulations and collective agreements and benefits and compensation policies and personnel procedures and classification plans; assist in preparing and maintaining personnel records and employee handbooks and deliver training; and, in authorized labor relations assignments, represent the employer or workers in collective bargaining or dispute mediation.

zh.name: 薪酬、福利与岗位分析专员
zh.summary: 为用人单位开展薪酬与福利与岗位分析项目，并可在职位分类与养老金计划等方向专精：管理员工保险与养老金与储蓄计划并与保险经纪与福利计划提供方协作；确保公司遵守联邦与州法律并完成报告义务；研究员工福利与健康与安全做法并就现行政策的变更提出建议；评估岗位并记录分类、豁免和薪酬建议的依据，由实际获授权者作最终决定；编制职业分类与职位说明与薪酬等级表；开发并管理绩效工资或激励薪酬等薪酬项目；开展多因素数据与成本分析；通过观察与访谈与问卷与焦点小组收集岗位信息并开发岗位分析工具；就州与联邦雇佣法规与集体协议与福利与薪酬政策与人事程序与分类方案向管理者与员工提供建议；协助编制与维护人事记录与员工手册并开展培训；并可在获授权的劳动关系岗位代表雇主或劳动者参与集体协商或争议调解。

en.name: Compliance Managers
en.summary: Compliance managers plan, direct or coordinate organizational activities so that they comply with ethical or regulatory standards; the work includes policy training, risk monitoring, internal review and investigation, documentation and reporting, coordination with attorneys and auditors, and specialized compliance carried out according to the position. Investigations and external reporting are carried out by actually authorized positions under the applicable rules.

zh.name: 合规经理
zh.summary: 合规经理规划、指导或协调组织活动，使其符合道德或监管标准；工作包括政策培训、风险监控、内部审查调查、文档与报告、律师审计协同及按岗位承担的专项合规。调查及对外报告由实际授权岗位依适用规则执行。

en.name: Compliance Officers
en.summary: Examine, evaluate and investigate eligibility for or conformity with laws and regulations governing contract compliance of licenses and permits, and carry out other compliance and enforcement inspection and analysis activities not classified elsewhere: evaluate applications and records or documents to gather information about eligibility or liability issues; advise licensees or other individuals or groups on licensing, permit or pass regulations; confer or interview officials or technical or professional experts or applicants to clarify facts related to licensing decisions; visit business premises to verify that valid licenses or permits are displayed and that licensing standards are met; administer oral and written and road or flight tests and score them; in some licensing assignments, issue permits or collect fees only when legally authorized and write notification correspondence about licensing decisions or appeal procedures; prepare reports on activities and evaluations and recommendations or decisions and report violations to committees or agencies and inform violators of infractions or possible penalties; identify compliance issues that require follow-up or investigation and assist internal and external audits; and verify that enterprise and regulatory policies and procedures have been documented and implemented and communicated.

zh.name: 合规专员
zh.summary: 审查、评估并调查许可与执照与合同合规中与法律和规章相符或资格的问题，并承担其他未被归类的合规与执法检查与分析活动：评估申请与记录或文件以收集资格或责任问题的信息；就许可与执照或通行证相关规定向持证人或其他个人或团体提供建议；与官员或技术或专业专家或申请人商谈或面谈以澄清与许可决定相关的事实；走访经营场所核实有效执照或许可已展示且许可标准得到遵守；实施口头与书面与道路或飞行测试并对测试评分；部分许可岗位在获授权时可发证、按法定条件收费，并就许可或申诉编写通知函件；编制活动与评估与建议或决定的报告并向委员会或机构报告违规并告知违规者违规情形或可能的处罚；识别需要跟进或调查的合规问题并协助内外部审计；并核实企业与监管政策与程序已被记录与实施与传达。

en.name: Computer and Information Research Scientists
en.summary: Conduct basic computer and information science research as a theorist, designer or inventor, and develop solutions to problems in the computer hardware and software field: analyze problems to develop solutions involving computer hardware and software; apply theoretical expertise and innovation to create or apply new technology; conduct logical analysis of business and scientific and engineering and technical problems and build mathematical models for computer solution; evaluate project plans and proposals to determine feasibility; design computers and the software that runs on them; maintain network hardware and software and direct security measures and monitor availability; participate in interdisciplinary projects such as virtual reality and human-computer interaction or robotics; assign tasks and set goals and performance standards and evaluate work; direct the daily operations of a department and coordinate projects with other departments; participate in staffing decisions and supervise the training of subordinates; and approve, prepare, monitor and adjust operating budgets.

zh.name: 计算机与信息研究科学家
zh.summary: 作为理论家、设计者或发明者开展计算机与信息基础科学研究，并为计算机硬件与软件领域的问题开发解决方案：分析问题以提出涉及计算机硬件与软件的解决方案；运用理论专长与创新来创造或应用新技术；对商业与科学与工程与技术问题开展逻辑分析并为计算机求解建立数学模型；评估项目计划与提案以判断可行性；设计计算机及其运行的软件；维护网络硬件与软件并指导安全措施并监控可用性；参与虚拟现实与人机交互或机器人等跨学科项目；分派任务并制定目标与绩效标准并评估工作；指导部门日常运行并与其他部门协调项目；参与用人决策并指导下属培训；并审批与编制与监控与调整运营预算。

en.name: Computer and Information Systems Managers
en.summary: Plan, direct or coordinate activities such as electronic data processing, information systems, systems analysis and computer programming: manage the department's daily operations and analyze workflow and establish priorities and develop standards and set deadlines; manage backup and security and user help systems; provide technical support to users for computer problems; review project plans to plan and coordinate project activity; assign and review the output of systems analysts and programmers and other computer-related workers; review and approve system charts and programs before implementation; evaluate data processing proposals to assess project feasibility and requirements; develop computer information resources and assess the organization's technology use and needs; consult with users and management and vendors to assess computing and system needs; develop and interpret organizational goals and policies and procedures; control operating budgets and expenditures and purchase necessary equipment; and recruit and train and supervise staff.

zh.name: 计算机与信息系统经理
zh.summary: 计划、指导或协调电子数据处理、信息系统、系统分析与计算机编程等活动：管理部门日常运行并分析工作流程与确定优先级与制定标准与设定截止期限；管理备份与安全与用户帮助系统；为用户提供计算机问题的技术支持；审查项目计划以规划并协调项目活动；分派并复核系统分析师与程序员与其他计算机相关人员的产出；在系统图表与程序实施前予以审查与批准；评估数据处理提案以判断项目可行性与需求；开发计算机信息资源并评估组织的技术使用与需求；与用户与管理层与供应商协商以评估计算需求与系统需求；制定与解释组织目标与政策与程序；控制运营预算与支出并采购必要设备；招聘与培训与监督员工。

en.name: Computer, Automated Teller, and Office Machine Repairers
en.summary: Repair, maintain or install computers, word processing systems, automated teller machines and office electronic equipment such as copiers and fax machines: travel to customers' stores or offices to repair equipment or provide emergency repair service; talk with customers to establish the fault details and disassemble machines to inspect parts for wear or defects; use oscilloscopes and multimeters or diagnostic software to test circuits to locate defects; use hand or power tools to repair, adjust or replace electrical or mechanical parts and reassemble; assemble, align, adjust and calibrate to specifications; operate machines to test function; install and configure new equipment and operating system software and peripherals; reinstall or adjust software settings; update existing equipment; maintain parts inventory and order spare parts; explain operation and maintenance to customers; and maintain repair records and complete bills and time cards and expense reports.

zh.name: 计算机、自动柜员机与办公设备维修员
zh.summary: 维修、维护或安装计算机、文字处理系统、自动柜员机与复印与传真等办公电子设备：前往客户门店或办公室维修设备或提供紧急维修服务；与客户交谈确定故障细节并拆开机器检查部件磨损或缺陷；使用示波器与万用表或诊断软件测试电路以定位缺陷；使用手动或电动工具维修与调整与更换电气或机械部件并重新装配；按规格装配与对齐与调整与校准；操作机器测试功能；安装并配置新设备与操作系统软件与外围设备；重新安装或调整软件设置；更新现有设备；维护部件库存并订购备件；向客户说明操作与维护；维护维修记录并填写账单与工时卡与费用报告。

en.name: Computer hardware engineer
en.summary: Research, design, develop or test computer and computer-related equipment for commercial, industrial, military or scientific use, and possibly supervise its manufacture and installation: discuss with engineers and consult specifications to assess hardware and software interfaces and system operation and performance requirements; design and develop computer hardware and supporting peripherals, including central processing units and support logic and microprocessors and custom integrated circuits and printers and disk drives; select hardware and materials and ensure they meet specifications and product requirements; evaluate cost and safety and reporting format requirements to determine hardware configuration; specify power supply requirements and configuration; build and test and modify product prototypes using working models built through computer simulation or theoretical models; test and validate hardware and supporting peripherals by recording and analyzing test data; write detailed functional specifications and document the hardware development process; provide technical support to designers and marketing and sales and suppliers and engineers; instruct technicians and engineering design staff; provide training and support to system designers and users; and monitor equipment function and make necessary modifications.

zh.name: 计算机硬件工程师
zh.summary: 为商业、工业、军事或科学用途研究、设计、开发或测试计算机与计算机相关设备，并可能监督其制造与安装：与工程人员商议并查阅规格以评估硬件与软件接口与系统运行与性能要求；设计并开发计算机硬件与支持外围设备，包括中央处理器与支持逻辑与微处理器与定制集成电路与打印机与磁盘驱动器；选定硬件与材料并确保符合规格与产品要求；评估成本与安全与报告格式要求以确定硬件配置；说明电源需求与配置；使用通过计算机仿真构建的工作模型或理论模型构建与测试与修改产品原型；通过记录与分析测试数据来测试与验证硬件与支持外围设备；撰写详细的功能规格说明并记录硬件开发过程；为设计人员与市场与销售与供应商与工程师提供技术支持；指导技术员与工程设计人员；为系统设计人员与用户提供培训与支持；并监控设备功能并作出必要修改。

en.name: Computer network support specialist
en.summary: Network support specialists keep an existing network working. They establish the scope of an incident, examine logs or monitoring data, test likely causes, resolve or escalate the issue within their authority, and document the handoff. Major changes follow the organization’s approval and rollback process.

zh.name: 计算机网络支持专家
zh.summary: 网络技术支持负责让已有网络恢复并稳定运行：记录故障范围，查看监控和日志，验证可能的原因，按权限修复或升级，并把处理过程留给下一班或其他团队。涉及重大变更时需走审批和回退流程。

en.name: Computer programmer
en.summary: Computer programmers turn specifications into code that can be run and checked. They clarify conflicting requirements, reproduce bugs and document what changed, what passed and what still needs review.

zh.name: 计算机程序员
zh.summary: 计算机程序员把规格变成可运行、可验证的代码。遇到矛盾需求先确认规则，修缺陷要留复现步骤、回归结果和待评审事项。

en.name: Computer Systems Analysts
en.summary: Computer systems analysts analyze business and technical problems, turn requirements into implementable system solutions, and take responsibility for solution evidence, change records and deployment results.

zh.name: 计算机系统分析师
zh.summary: 计算机系统分析师分析业务与技术问题，把需求转成可实施的系统方案，并对方案依据、变更记录与上线结果负责。

en.name: Concierge
en.summary: Concierges provide personal services to guests in hotels, apartments or office buildings, including relaying messages, arranging or advising on transport, business and entertainment matters, and following up on guest-room, maintenance and other requests, with responsibility for service arrangements, records and information boundaries.

zh.name: 礼宾员
zh.summary: 礼宾员在酒店、公寓或办公楼为宾客提供个人服务，包括传达留言、安排或建议交通、商务与娱乐事项，并跟进客房与维修等需求，对服务安排、记录与信息边界负责。

en.name: Conservation Scientist
en.summary: Conservation scientists manage, improve and conserve natural resources and improve their use without harming the environment; conduct soil surveys, develop plans to prevent soil erosion or conserve rangelands, and guide land users on soil/water conservation and improvement.

zh.name: 自然保护科学家
zh.summary: 自然保护科学家管理、改善并保护自然资源，在不损害环境的前提下提高其利用；开展土壤调查，制定防治土壤侵蚀或保护牧场的方案，并向土地使用者提供水土保持与改良指导。

en.name: Construction Laborers
en.summary: Construction laborers do physical work on construction sites, operating pneumatic breakers, tampers and small machines to clear sites, excavate trenches, erect formwork and scaffolding, move materials and clear waste, and assist other skilled trades.

zh.name: 建筑工人
zh.summary: 建筑工人在施工现场从事体力作业，操作风镐、夯土机与小型机具完成场地清理、沟槽开挖、支模与脚手架搭设、材料搬运与废弃物清理，并协助其他技术工种作业。

en.name: Construction Managers
en.summary: Construction managers plan, organize, budget and supervise the construction and maintenance of building works: taking part in early-stage scheme and feasibility judgments, preparing schedule and cost plans, organizing site work and subcontractor coordination, and checking that the works comply with building and safety regulations.

zh.name: 施工经理
zh.summary: 施工经理负责计划、组织、预算与监督建筑工程的施工与维护：参与项目前期方案与可行性判断，编制进度与成本计划，组织现场作业与分包配合，并检查工程是否符合建筑与安全法规。

en.name: Continuous mining machine operator
en.summary: Continuous mining machine operators drive self-propelled mining machines to cut coal, metal and non-metal ore, rock and sand and gravel continuously at the ore body face and load the material onto conveyors, shuttle cars or trucks; before work they check ventilation and methane and confirm that roof and rib support is stable, during work they monitor equipment operation, and after work they maintain machine parts and change cutting teeth.

zh.name: 连续采矿机操作员
zh.summary: 连续采矿机操作员驾驶自走式采矿机，在矿体工作面连续切削煤、金属与非金属矿石、岩石与砂石，并把物料装载到输送机、梭车或卡车上；作业前核查通风与甲烷、确认顶板与煤帮支护稳定，作业中监控设备运转，作业后维护机件并更换切割齿。

en.name: Control and Valve Installers and Repairers, Except Mechanical Door
en.summary: Control and valve installers and repairers install, repair and maintain mechanical regulating and control devices: installing and testing electricity and gas meters, gas pressure regulators, thermostats, safety valves and flow valves and similar equipment, calibrating instruments for pressure, temperature, flow and level, testing leaks and set values, handling faults and recording maintenance and testing data.

zh.name: 控制与阀门安装维修工（非机械门类）
zh.summary: 控制与阀门安装维修工安装、维修与维护机械式调节与控制装置：安装与检测电表、燃气调压器、恒温器、安全阀与流量阀等设备，按压力、温度、流量与液位校准仪表，测试泄漏与设定值，处理故障并记录维护与检测数据。

en.name: Conveyor Operators and Tenders
en.summary: Conveyor operators and tenders watch material flow and equipment readings, track loads or downtime, and report faults on assigned lines. Site training and task authorization determine who may adjust, clear, service or restart the equipment.

zh.name: 输送机操作员与看护员
zh.summary: 输送设备操作与看护员观察分配输送线的物料流动和设备读数，记录搬运量或停机情况并报告异常。谁可调整、清堵、检修或重启，须按现场培训与具体作业授权核实。

en.name: Cooling and freezing equipment operators and tenders
en.summary: Operate cooling and freezing equipment, monitor temperature, flow and equipment status, and record output and exceptions. Cold-storage and frozen-food roles in mainland China overlap in some tasks; a one-to-one classification covering the same duties has not been verified.

zh.name: 冷却与冷冻设备操作员与看护员
zh.summary: 操作冷却或冷冻设备，按规程监控并调节温度、进料和设备状态，记录处理量并交接异常。中国大陆的冷藏工和冷冻食品制作工作有部分任务重叠；尚未核实覆盖相同任务范围的一对一分类。

en.name: Coroners
en.summary: Coroners carry statutory coordination of death investigations, but how the position is created, whether it must be held by a physician, and whether it can order an autopsy or issue documents all vary by jurisdiction; the core is to turn the scene, the body, identity, medical history and examination materials into a traceable conclusion.

zh.name: 验尸官
zh.summary: 验尸官承担法定死亡调查协调，但职位产生方式、是否必须为医师、能否下令尸检或签发文件都依法域而异；核心是把现场、遗体、身份、病史和检验资料形成可追溯结论。

en.name: Correspondence clerks
en.summary: Correspondence clerks correspond in the United States to O*NET-SOC 43-4021.00 (Correspondence Clerks); the BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook groups this type of position into Information Clerks (information clerks, 43-4000 combined basis) and explicitly lists it. The core is reading incoming letters and customer requests, checking order, billing, arrears and claim records, drafting and proofreading standard replies and issuing confirmation and payment letters, routing letters to the appropriate department and explaining rules and processes to customers when needed; the output is verifiable, traceable correspondence and records. On the China side, similar clerical positions are scattered across different units and outsourcing settings and are not a one-to-one correspondence with this U.S. detailed occupation, so appointment conditions and pay bases cannot be interchanged.

zh.name: 函件文员
zh.summary: 函件文员在美国对应 O*NET-SOC 43-4021.00（Correspondence Clerks）；BLS 职业展望手册把该类岗位归入 Information Clerks（信息文员，43-4000 组合口径）并明确列出。核心是阅读来信与客户诉求，核对订单、账单、欠款与理赔等记录，起草与校对标准回复、开具确认与催款函件，把来函分派给相应部门，并在需要时向客户解释规则与流程；产出是可核对、可追溯的函件与记录。中国侧，同类事务性文员岗位散落在不同单位与外包场景，与该美国职业细类不是一一对应，任职条件与计酬口径不能互换。

en.name: Cost estimators
en.summary: Turn drawings or specifications into quantity, labor and material estimates. Record rates, assumptions and risks, then hand off a reviewed bid or budget. Manufacturing and services also use estimators; sign-off depends on the role and jurisdiction.

zh.name: 成本估算师
zh.summary: 拆解图纸或规格，核算工程量、工时和材料，记录报价依据和风险，复核后交付预算或投标估算。制造和服务也有估算工作，签章权限按岗位与当地规则核实。

en.name: Costume attendants
en.summary: Prepare, fit, label and maintain costumes by cast member and scene. Help with changes, then count, repair or flag damaged pieces and return them to storage.

zh.name: 服装服务员
zh.summary: 按角色与场次准备、协助演员试装、标记和维护戏服，协助演出换装，结束后清点、处理破损并归位。工作重点是服装现场可用和交接可靠。

en.name: Counter and rental clerks
en.summary: Take rental, repair or service orders, explain options and charges, and record handoff and payment. Rental staff may check returns for damage and escalate disputes to someone authorized to decide.

zh.name: 柜台租赁文员
zh.summary: 受理租赁、维修或其他服务订单，说明可用选项、费用和条款，完成登记、交付和结算。租赁岗位还可能核对退还状态并把损坏争议转给有权限的同事。

en.name: Couriers and messengers
