en.summary: Pick up messages, documents or packages, check addresses and handling requirements, deliver along a route, and record receipt, exceptions and returns. Lab specimens and valuable or confidential items can require special handoffs.

zh.name: 快递员
zh.summary: 收取信件、文件或包裹，核地址与交接要求，按路线送达，保留签收、异常和退回记录。医院样本、贵重或需保密物品要按对应流程交接。

en.name: Craft artists
en.summary: Craft artists correspond in the US to O*NET-SOC 27-1012.00 (Craft Artists). The core is turning ideas into deliverable functional or decorative handmade works for sale or exhibition using materials, tools and equipment: selecting materials by strength, color, texture, weight, dimensions and ductility, conceiving and drawing the object to be made, making samples or templates, first producing a prototype, cutting, forming, assembling, casting or machining materials by hand, power tools or machines, setting material, dimension and surface treatment specifications, applying surface treatment to the finished product and checking quality, developing packaging, display and pricing practice, packing and shipping, promoting works and products through internet advertising and brochures, communicating with clients to understand needs and feedback, planning and attending craft fairs, researching craft trends, sales channels and customer buying habits, and also producing design drawings with specialist software. The US basis is a single occupation breakdown, and comparable posts on the Chinese side are spread across handicrafts, cultural-creative work and craft art production, are not one-to-one with this US occupation breakdown, and their employment and pay bases cannot be interchanged.

zh.name: 工艺艺术家
zh.summary: 工艺艺术家在美国对应 O*NET-SOC 27-1012.00（Craft Artists）。核心是用材料、工具与设备把构思制作成可供销售或展览的功能性或装饰性手工作品，并使之可交付：按强度、色彩、质感、重量、尺寸与延展性等选择材料，构思并绘制要制作的物件、制作样板或模板、先做出原型，用手工、电动工具或机器切割、成形、装配、浇注或加工材料，设定材料、尺寸与表面处理规格，对成品施加表面处理并做质检，制定包装、陈列与定价做法，打包发货，通过互联网广告与宣传册等方式推介作品与产品，与客户沟通了解需求与反馈，策划并参加手工艺展销会，调研工艺潮流、销售渠道与客户购买习惯，也用专业软件出设计图。美国口径为单一职业细分，中国侧同类岗位分散在手工艺、文创与工艺美术制作方向，与该美国职业细类不是一一对应，任职与计酬口径不能互换。

en.name: Credit analysts
en.summary: Review financial statements, cash flow, debt and credit records. Verify sources and anomalies, document risks and limits, then submit the analysis to the authorized decision-maker.

zh.name: 信用分析师
zh.summary: 审阅财务报表、现金流、负债和信用记录，核实来源及异常，写明风险判断、证据和限制，交给有权限的人审查或决策。

en.name: Credit authorizers, checkers, and clerks
en.summary: Check applications, transactions or account information, record evidence and flag exceptions. Act within assigned limits and rules, and escalate cases that exceed them or raise risk concerns.

zh.name: 信贷授权员、核查员、文员
zh.summary: 按流程核查信用申请、交易或账户资料，补记证据并标记异常。可在授予的限额和规则内办理，超限或高风险情况交给有权人员。

en.name: Credit counselors
en.summary:
In the United States, credit counselors correspond to O*NET-SOC 13-2071.00 (Credit Counselors). The core is providing advice and education to individuals or organizations on obtaining and managing debt, helping judge the most suitable loan type, explaining loan requirements or limits, and helping prepare debt management plans: assess the client's overall financial condition including income and assets and debt and expenses and credit reports, calculate the monthly income available to repay debt and estimate the repayment timeline from the debt amount
and interest rate, prepare a debt management plan or spending plan or budget, interview to collect financial information and explain to clients general financial knowledge such as credit report ratings and bankruptcy law and consumer protection law and wage garnishment and collection, recommend repayment and financial strategies and prioritize the repayment order, explain available loan types and eligibility conditions, prepare written documents and contracts and negotiate repayment adjustments or interest rates and terms with creditors, maintain client account activity and consultation records and pay amounts from client accounts to creditors
, and when needed refer clients to social services and community resources beyond credit or debt counseling. The US basis is a single occupation segment, while similar positions on the China side are spread across bank debt negotiation and consumer finance post-loan and consumer credit services, which is not a one-to-one correspondence with that US occupation segment, and the appointment and authorization and pay bases cannot be interchanged.

zh.name: 信贷咨询顾问
zh.summary: 信贷咨询顾问在美国对应 O*NET-SOC 13-2071.00（Credit Counselors）。核心是就取得与管理债务向个人或组织提供建议与教育，帮助判断最适合的贷款类型、解释贷款要求或限制，并协助制定债务管理计划：评估客户的收入、资产、债务、支出与信用报告等整体财务状况，计算可用于偿还债务的月收入、按债务金额与利率估算还款时间，制定债务管理计划、支出计划或预算，面谈收集财务信息并向客户解释信用报告评级、破产法、消费者保护法、工资扣划与催收等一般金融知识，推荐还款与理财策略、优先安排还款顺序、讲解可用贷款类型与资格条件，准备书面文件与合同、与债权人协商还款调整或利率与期限，维护客户账户活动与咨询记录、向客户账户向债权人支付款项，并在需要时把客户转介到信用或债务咨询之外的社会服务与社区资源。美国口径为单一职业细分，中国侧同类岗位分散在银行债务协商、消费金融贷后与消费者信用服务等方向，与该美国职业细类不是一一对应，任职、授权与计酬口径不能互换。

en.name: Critical care nurses
en.summary: In the United States critical care nurses correspond to O*NET-SOC 29-1141.03 (Critical Care Nurses) and provide specialty registered nursing to critically ill or injured patients in settings such as intensive care units (ICU/CCU): continuously assess vital signs and laboratory data, administer medication and life support nursing per orders, monitor equipment such as ventilators, ECG monitors, oxygen therapy, and pressure monitoring, identify condition changes such as sepsis or shock and escalate promptly, collaborate with the interprofessional team to develop and revise treatment plans, complete standardized nursing records, handover, and family communication, and take part in quality and process improvement. The preparation level for this occupation is Job Zone Four (most require a four-year bachelor's degree in nursing), and US wage, employment, and industry data are published on O*NET on the parent occupation registered nurse (Registered Nurses) basis; the comparable position on the Chinese side is a registered nurse in hospital critical care medicine departments and intensive care units, where basic practice registration is managed in tiers along with hospital critical care competency admission and high-risk technique authorization, and it cannot be interchanged with the US preparation level.

zh.name: 重症护理护士
zh.summary: 重症护理护士在美国对应 O*NET-SOC 29-1141.03（Critical Care Nurses），为重症监护病房（ICU/CCU）等场景中危重或受伤的患者提供专科注册护理：持续评估生命体征与检验数据，按医嘱执行用药与生命支持护理，监护呼吸机、心电监护、氧疗与压力监测等设备，识别脓毒症、休克等病情变化并及时升级，与跨专业团队协作制定与修订治疗计划，完成规范护理记录、交接与家属沟通，并参与质量与流程改进。该职业准备层级为 Job Zone Four（多数要求四年制护理学士学位），美国工资、就业与行业数据在 O*NET 上以母职业注册护士（Registered Nurses）口径发布；中国侧同类岗位为医院重症医学科与重症监护病房的注册护士，基础执业注册与医院重症能力准入、高风险技术授权分层管理，不能与美国的准备层级互换。

en.name: Crossing guards and flaggers
en.summary: Guide pedestrians or vehicles at assigned crossings, schools or road works. Watch visibility and conflicts and report incidents under the site plan. School crossing and work-zone flagging have different equipment, training and authority.

zh.name: 交通路口警卫旗手
zh.summary: 在指定路口、校区或道路作业区，按现场方案提示行人和车辆，观察视距与冲突并报告异常。过街护导和作业区交通引导的设备、培训和授权不同。

en.name: Crushing, grinding, and polishing machine setters, operators, and tenders
en.summary: In the United States crushing, grinding, and polishing machine setters, operators, and tenders correspond to O*NET-SOC 51-9021.00 (Crushing, Grinding, and Polishing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders), who set up, operate, or tend machines used for crushing, grinding, or polishing materials, handling materials such as coal, glass, grain, stone, food, or rubber: setting the mill and grinding fineness per work orders and specifications, starting and adjusting machine controls, watching auxiliary equipment such as pumps and conveyors to keep material flowing, weighing or measuring materials and products at intervals and sampling for laboratory testing, observing equipment operation to find anomalies in time and clear blockages, cleaning, adjusting, and maintaining equipment and reporting needed repairs, judging and removing nonconforming product per specifications, and recording operation, test, and production data on the designated forms. The preparation level for this occupation is Job Zone 1-2 (usually requiring a high school diploma or equivalent and providing from a few days to one year of on-the-job training); the comparable positions on the Chinese side are crushing, grinding, and polishing equipment operation and watching positions in industries such as mineral processing, building materials, and food processing, whose duty and authorization bases do not correspond one-to-one with this US occupation segment and cannot be interchanged.

zh.name: 破碎、研磨与抛光设备调整工、操作员、看护员
zh.summary: 破碎、研磨与抛光设备调整工、操作员、看护员在美国对应 O*NET-SOC 51-9021.00（Crushing, Grinding, and Polishing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders），设置、操作或看护用于破碎、研磨或抛光物料的机器，处理煤、玻璃、谷物、石料、食品或橡胶等材料：按工单与规格设置磨机和研磨细度，启动并调整机器控制，看护泵、输送带等辅助设备以推进物料流动，按间隔称量或测量物料与产品并取样送检，观察设备运行以及时发现异常并排除堵塞，清洁、调整并维护设备、报告所需维修，按规格判定并剔除不合格产品，并按指定表单记录运行、测试与生产数据。该职业准备层级为 Job Zone 1-2（通常要求高中文凭或同等学历，提供几天到一年的在岗培训）；中国侧同类岗位为矿物加工、建材与食品加工等行业中的破碎、研磨与抛光设备操作与看护岗位，职责与授权口径与该美国职业细类不是一一对应，不能互换。

en.name: Curators
en.summary: In the United States curators correspond to O*NET-SOC 25-4012.00 (Curators) and manage collections and research material in institutions such as museums: planning and organizing collection acquisition, custody, and exhibitions, setting exhibition themes and design and producing or installing display material, establishing and maintaining the registration, cataloging, and basic record system with databases, carrying out research projects in the professional field, providing collection information to other curators and the public, negotiating the purchase, sale, exchange, or loan of collections and approving per authorization, authenticating and assessing the provenance, composition, history, and current value of objects proposed for accession, inspecting the venue to judge repair needs and deal with temperature, humidity, and pest control problems, writing and reviewing funding applications, journal articles, institutional reports, and publicity material, designing and organizing guided tours, workshops, and teaching activities, training and supervising curatorial, finance, technical, and research staff as well as volunteers and interns, and agreeing policies and budgets with the board and planning overall operations. The preparation level for this occupation is Job Zone Five (usually requiring a graduate degree, SVP 8.0 and above); the comparable positions on the Chinese side are collection acquisition, custody, research, exhibition planning, and public education positions in museums, art galleries, and cultural institutions, mostly reviewed and appointed under professional title categories such as cultural relic and museum research, cultural relic conservation, cultural relic archaeology, and cultural relic utilization, whose duty and authorization bases do not correspond one-to-one with this US occupation segment and cannot be interchanged.

zh.name: 策展人
zh.summary: 策展人在美国对应 O*NET-SOC 25-4012.00（Curators），在博物馆等机构管理藏品与研究材料：规划与组织藏品的征集、保管与展览，制定展览主题与设计并制作或安装展陈材料，用数据库建立并维护登记、编目与基础记录系统，开展专业领域的研究项目，向其他策展人与公众提供馆藏信息，就藏品的购买、出售、交换或借展进行谈判并按授权批准，对拟入藏对象做来源、构成、历史与现状价值的鉴定与评估，检查场馆以判断维修需要并处理温湿度与虫害控制问题，撰写并评审资助申请、期刊论文、机构报告与宣传材料，设计并组织导览、工作坊与教学活动，训练并督导策展、财务、技术与研究等员工及志愿者与实习生，与理事会商定政策与预算并规划整体运营。该职业准备层级为 Job Zone Five（通常要求研究生学历，SVP 8.0 及以上）；中国侧同类岗位为博物馆、美术馆与文化机构中的藏品征集、保管、研究、展览策划与公众教育岗位，多按文物博物馆研究、文物保护、文物考古、文物利用等职称类别评聘，职责与授权口径与该美国职业细类不是一一对应，不能互换。

en.name: Customer Service Representatives
en.summary: Answer questions, document orders or complaints, resolve issues within policy, and route exceptions to a specialist. Phone, chat and email roles differ in the products and decisions they cover.

zh.name: 客户服务代表
zh.summary: 回答客户咨询，记录订单、投诉或退款诉求，在政策授权内处理，向专岗升级无法当场解决的问题。渠道可能是电话、聊天或邮件，职责取决于产品与权限。

en.name: Customs and Border Protection Officers
en.summary: In the United States, customs and border protection officers correspond to O*NET-SOC 33-3051.04 (Customs and Border Protection Officers), responsible for conducting investigation and inspection as people, conveyances, goods and merchandise enter the country or move between U.S. states, in order to detect violations of immigration and customs laws and regulations: examining immigration applications, visas and passports and conducting interviews to determine eligibility for entry, stay and travel; inspecting inbound or outbound goods, baggage and personal effects for compliance with tax law and customs rules; locating and seizing contraband, undeclared merchandise and the vehicles, aircraft or vessels concealing them; detaining people who violate customs or immigration law and arranging legal actions such as deportation; explaining laws and regulations to travelers, prospective immigrants, shippers and manufacturers; determining the duties and taxes owed and drawing product samples for testing; recording and reporting duty activities, findings, transactions, violations, discrepancies and decisions; and testifying at immigration appeals or in federal court about the relevant decisions. The preparation level for this occupation is Job Zone Three (SVP 6.0 to below 7.0); on O*NET its wage, employment and industry data are published under the parent occupation "Police and Sheriff's Patrol Officers" (33-3051.00), not values collected separately for this subcategory. Comparable positions in China are customs, exit and entry border inspection and port enforcement positions; their duties and authorization basis do not correspond one-to-one with this U.S. occupational subcategory and cannot be interchanged.

zh.name: 海关与边境保护官员
zh.summary: 海关与边境保护官员在美国对应 O*NET-SOC 33-3051.04（Customs and Border Protection Officers），负责在人员、运输工具、货物与商品入境或在美国各州之间流动时开展调查与查验，以侦测违反移民与海关法律法规的行为：查验移民申请、签证与护照并面谈判断入境、居留与旅行资格，查验入境或出境货物、行李与随身物品是否符合税收法律与海关规定，查找并扣押违禁品、未申报商品以及藏匿上述商品的车辆、航空器或船只，对违反海关或移民法律的人员实施扣留并安排驱逐等法律行动，向旅客、潜在移民、托运人与制造商解释法律法规，确定应缴关税与税费、抽取商品样品送检，记录并报告职务活动、发现、交易、违规、差异与决定，并在移民上诉或联邦法院就相关决定作证。该职业准备层级为 Job Zone Three（SVP 6.0 至低于 7.0）；在 O*NET 上其工资、就业与行业数据以母职业「警察与治安巡逻官」（33-3051.00）口径发布，不是本细类单独采集的数值。中国侧同类岗位为海关、出入境边防检查与口岸执法岗位，职责与授权口径与该美国职业细类不是一一对应，不能互换。

en.name: Customs Brokers
en.summary: Check declarations, classification, duties and client authorization, and follow up on customs messages or exceptions. Preparing documents, representing a client and arranging transport are different responsibilities; the title alone does not establish signing authority.

zh.name: 海关经纪人
zh.summary: 核对申报资料、归类、税费和客户授权，处理海关回执与异常。协助整理单证、独立代理和运输调度是不同职责，岗位名称不能说明签署权限。

en.name: Cutters and Trimmers, Hand
en.summary: In the United States, cutters and trimmers, hand, correspond to O*NET-SOC 51-9031.00 (Cutters and Trimmers, Hand), using hand tools or hand-held power tools to cut and trim finished products such as carpet, fabric, stone, glass and rubber: reading the work order to determine dimensions, cutting positions and quantities, positioning to template or measuring tool and marking on the material; cutting to order and profiling with hand cutting tools, shears, hand-held power tools or bench cutting equipment; separating materials by size, weight, type, colour or colour difference, and folding or shaping before and after cutting; trimming excess material and loose threads and pressing bench cutting tools down to the specified specification; adjusting guides and stops to control cutting depth and width; replacing or sharpening blunt tools and blades; sanding, polishing, cleaning and marking the finished item, and counting or weighing before bundling, stacking and moving to the next process. The preparation level for this occupation is Job Zone 1-2 (little to some preparation, SVP below 6.0), typically requiring a high school diploma or equivalent with some positions requiring none, and on-the-job training ranging from a few days to a year. Comparable positions in China are manual cutting, trimming and sanding positions in manufacturing and processing enterprises; their duties and pay basis do not correspond one-to-one with this U.S. occupational subcategory and cannot be interchanged.

zh.name: 手工切割与修整工
zh.summary: 手工切割与修整工在美国对应 O*NET-SOC 51-9031.00（Cutters and Trimmers, Hand），使用手工工具或手持动力工具切割与修整地毯、织物、石材、玻璃、橡胶等制成品：读工单确定尺寸、切割位置与数量，按样板或量具定位并在材料上画线；用手持刀具、剪具、手持动力工具或台式切割设备下料与仿形；按尺寸、重量、类型、颜色或色差分离材料，切割前后折叠或整形；修整多余边料与线头，按尺寸把台式刀具下压到指定规格；调整导板与限位控制切割深度与宽度；更换或磨锐变钝的刀具与锯片；打磨、抛光、清洁并标记成品，计数或称重后捆扎、码放并搬运到下一工序。该职业准备层级为 Job Zone 1-2（准备很少到一些，SVP 低于 6.0），通常要求高中文凭或同等学历、部分岗位不作要求，在职培训从数天到一年不等。中国侧同类岗位为制造业与加工企业中的手工裁剪、修边与打磨岗位，职责与计酬口径与该美国职业细类不是一一对应，不能互换。

en.name: Cutting and Slicing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
en.summary: In the United States, cutting and slicing machine setters, operators and tenders correspond to O*NET-SOC 51-9032.00 (Cutting and Slicing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders), setting up, operating or tending cutting and slicing machines to cut and slice glass, stone, cork, rubber, tobacco, food, paper and insulation materials, among others, to specification: determining the components, settings and adjustments from the work order, drawing or sample and positioning the tools, rollers and templates; positioning and feeding, starting the equipment to trial cut, monitoring the run and adjusting alignment, speed and pressure; measuring and weighing with measuring tools, micrometers and scales to verify specification, removing non-conforming material and readjusting the machine; removing finished products and stacking and sorting them, cleaning and lubricating the machine and tools and replacing or sharpening blades, saw blades and grinding wheels when necessary; and recording output, type and dimensions and transferring the finished products and edge material to the next process. The preparation level for this occupation is Job Zone 1-2 (little to some preparation, SVP below 6.0), typically requiring a high school diploma or equivalent with some positions requiring none, and on-the-job training ranging from a few days to a year. Comparable positions in China are cutting, slicing and blanking equipment operation positions in manufacturing and processing enterprises; their duties and pay basis do not correspond one-to-one with this U.S. occupational subcategory and cannot be interchanged.

zh.name: 切割与切片设备调整工、操作员、看护员
zh.summary: 切割与切片设备调整工、操作员、看护员在美国对应 O*NET-SOC 51-9032.00（Cutting and Slicing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders），装设、操作或看护切割与切片机器，把玻璃、石材、软木、橡胶、烟草、食品、纸与隔热材料等按规格切开与分片：按工单、图纸或样品确定部件、设定与调整，安置刀具、辊轮与模板；定位并送料、启动设备试切、监控运行并调整对位、速度与压力；用量具、千分尺与秤量测称重核对规格，剔除不合格材料并回调机器；取走成品并码放分类，清洗润滑机器与刀具，必要时更换或磨锐刀片、锯条与砂轮；记录产量、类型与尺寸，并把成品与边料转运到下一工序。该职业准备层级为 Job Zone 1-2（准备很少到一些，SVP 低于 6.0），通常要求高中或同等学历、部分岗位不作要求，在职培训从数天到一年不等。中国侧同类岗位为制造业与加工企业中的切割、切片与下料设备操作岗位，职责与计酬口径与该美国职业细类不是一一对应，不能互换。

en.name: Cutting, Punching, and Press Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
en.summary: Read work orders and drawings, set up or run cutting and press equipment, check the first piece for dimensions and burrs, and log problems. Ask whether the job runs an existing setup, changes dies independently, or adjusts the machine.

zh.name: 金属冲压与剪压设备操作工
zh.summary: 按工单和图纸设置或操作剪切、冲孔和压力设备，检查首件尺寸和毛刺，监控设备并记录停机异常。应聘时问清是按已调参数操作、独立换模，还是兼做调机。

en.name: Cytogenetic Technologists
en.summary: Cytogenetic technologists prepare specimens, stain or hybridize slides, and examine chromosome number and structure. They document quality issues and submit findings under laboratory procedures. Result approval and clinical interpretation follow local roles and institutional rules.

zh.name: 细胞遗传学技师
zh.summary: 细胞遗传技术员从样本制备、染色或杂交到显微图像分析，检查染色体的数目与结构，记录质量问题并按实验室授权提交结果。报告审核和临床解释按本地岗位及机构分工。

en.name: Cytotechnologists
en.summary: Match specimens to records, prepare and stain slides, screen cell morphology under a microscope, and refer abnormal findings through the applicable review process.

zh.name: 细胞技术专家
zh.summary: 本页的细胞技术专家指细胞病理技术员。核对标本与记录，制片染色，在显微镜下筛查细胞形态，并按适用流程递交异常所见。

en.name: Dancers
en.summary: Learn and rehearse movement, perform on stage, at events or on camera, and adjust timing, spacing and coordination from feedback. Ask how rehearsals, performances and travel are paid.

zh.name: 舞者
zh.summary: 学习与反复排练动作，在舞台、活动或镜头前完成表演，按编导反馈调整节奏、站位和配合。应聘时核清排练、演出与外地交通怎么计酬。

en.name: Data Entry Keyers
en.summary: Data Entry Keyers in the United States correspond to O*NET-SOC 43-9021.00 (Data Entry Keyers). They operate data entry equipment, such as keyboards or photo composing perforators, and their responsibilities may include verifying data and preparing materials for printing: compiling, sorting, and verifying the accuracy of data before entry; comparing data with source documents or re-entering it in a verification format to detect errors; reading source documents such as canceled checks, sales reports, or bills and using a keyboard or scanner to enter data into specified fields or media; locating and correcting entry errors or reporting them to supervisors; storing completed documents in appropriate locations; maintaining logs of work activities and completed work; loading the input or output media required by equipment (paper, cards, disks, tapes, or Braille media); and using cryptographic procedures and equipment to decipher garbled or illegible information. The preparation level is Job Zone 1-2 (little to some preparation needed, SVP below 6.0). The official education survey presents requirements for new entrants as “some positions require a high school diploma or equivalent, some require some college experience, and some require an associate's or another two-year degree”; the official page does not publish corresponding percentages. On O*NET, this detailed occupation's tasks, work context, preparation level, and wages all use its own scope; its national wage page publishes both hourly and annual percentiles for 2025. Comparable roles in China are mostly data entry or data processing positions in administrative and professional service organizations. Their responsibilities, employment arrangements, and pay scopes do not correspond one to one with this detailed U.S. occupation and cannot be used interchangeably.

zh.name: 数据录入员
zh.summary: 数据录入员在美国对应 O*NET-SOC 43-9021.00（Data Entry Keyers），操作数据录入设备（如键盘或照相排版穿孔机），职责可包括核对数据并准备打印材料：录入前汇总、排序并核对数据的准确性；将数据与源文件比对，或按校验格式重新录入以发现错误；阅读已注销支票、销售报表或账单等源文件，用键盘或扫描仪把数据录入指定字段或介质；定位并更正录入错误，或向上级报告；把完成的文件存放到适当位置；维护工作活动与已完成工作的日志；为设备装载所需的输入或输出介质（纸张、卡片、磁盘、磁带或盲文介质）；并用密码程序与设备解析乱码或无法辨认的信息。该职业准备层级为 Job Zone 1-2（几乎到少量准备即可，SVP 低于 6.0），官方教育调查显示新入职者的教育要求以「部分岗位要求高中文凭或同等学历、部分岗位要求部分大学经历、部分岗位要求副学士或其他两年制学位」呈现，官方页面未公布对应的百分比。在 O*NET 上，本细类的任务、工作情境、准备层级与工资均为自身口径；其全国工资页 2025 年同时公布小时与年度分位。中国侧同类多为行政与专业服务机构中的数据录入或数据处理岗位，职责、用工与计酬口径与该美国职业细类不是一一对应，不能互换。

en.name: Data Warehousing Specialists
en.summary: Start by mapping source fields and defining what each row represents. Extract, transform and load data, reconcile row counts and key measures, then publish documented tables. When a load fails, isolate source, transformation or scheduling problems and verify that a rerun does not double count. U.S. wages and employment use the Database Architects parent group. Mainland China evidence consists of two historical job postings and no established national wage estimate.

zh.name: 数据仓库专家
zh.summary: 数仓工作从理解源字段开始：定好数据粒度和映射，用 ETL 抽取、转换与装载，核对行数、重复与关键指标，再发布数据表和维护说明。失败时定位源数据、转换逻辑或调度问题，并验证重跑不会重复计数。 美国工资与就业使用数据库架构师父组统计；中国大陆保留两条历史招聘样本及全国职业工资缺口。

en.name: Database administrators
en.summary: Database administrators correspond in the U.S. to O*NET-SOC 15-1242.00 (Database Administrators). They administer, test and implement computer databases using database management system knowledge: Modify existing databases and database management systems or direct programmers and analysts to make changes; plan, coordinate and implement security measures against accidental or unauthorized damage, modification or disclosure of information in computer files; plan and install database management system upgrades to improve performance; specify users and access levels for each database segment; test changes to database applications or systems; test programs or databases, correct errors and make necessary modifications; train users and answer questions; support junior staff or clients; approve, schedule, plan and supervise installation and testing of new products; set standards and guidance for software use and acquisition and protection of vulnerable information; write logical/physical database descriptions and specify identifiers or direct others to do so; develop data models describing data elements and uses under procedures; select and enter code to monitor database performance and create production databases; identify, assess and recommend hardware/software achieving required performance; consult database management system manual procedures to modify databases; identify and assess database industry trends and advise senior management; review programmer analysts' workflow charts to understand computer tasks; and revise corporate data dictionary definitions. Preparation level is Job Zone Four (considerable preparation, SVP 7.0 to below 8.0). Official education surveys show 89% require a bachelor's for new hires, 4% a post-baccalaureate certificate and 3% an associate's or other two-year degree. O*NET tasks, work context, preparation level and wages concern this detailed occupation itself. Its 2025 national wage page publishes annual and hourly percentiles, neither parent proxies nor figures for related database architects or data warehousing specialists. Similar Chinese roles are mostly database management, database operations or data platform jobs. Duties, employment and compensation scopes do not correspond one to one with this U.S. detailed occupation and cannot be interchanged.

zh.name: 数据库管理员
zh.summary: 数据库管理员在美国对应 O*NET-SOC 15-1242.00（Database Administrators），管理、测试并实施计算机数据库，应用数据库管理系统知识：修改现有数据库与数据库管理系统，或指导程序员与分析人员完成变更；规划、协调并实施安全措施，防止计算机文件中的信息被意外或未经授权地损坏、修改或泄露；规划并安装数据库管理系统软件升级以提升性能；为数据库的每个片段指定用户与访问级别；测试数据库应用或系统的变更；测试程序或数据库、修正错误并做必要修改；培训用户并解答问题；向初级员工或客户提供技术支持；审批、排期、规划并监督新产品的安装与测试；制定软件使用与采购以及保护脆弱信息的标准与指南；编写逻辑与物理数据库描述并指定标识符，或指导他人编写；按流程开发描述数据元素及用途的数据模型；选择并输入代码以监测数据库性能并创建生产数据库；识别、评估并推荐能达到所需性能的硬件或软件技术；查阅数据库管理系统手册中的流程以修改数据库；识别并评估数据库系统的行业趋势，为高层管理提供信息与建议；查阅程序员分析师绘制的工作流图以了解计算机将执行的任务；并修订公司数据字典中的数据定义。该职业准备层级为 Job Zone Four（需要相当程度的准备，SVP 7.0 至低于 8.0），官方教育调查显示新入职者中 89% 要求学士学位、4% 要求学士后证书、3% 要求副学士或其他两年制学位。在 O*NET 上，本细类的任务、工作情境、准备层级与工资均为自身口径：其全国工资页 2025 年同时公布年度与小时分位，既不是父职业代理口径，也不属于同族的数据库架构师或数据仓储专家。中国侧同类多为数据库管理、数据库运维或数据平台岗位，职责、用工与计酬口径与该美国职业细类不是一一对应，不能互换。

en.name: Database architect
en.summary: Database architects design enterprise databases and warehouses around query, capacity and security requirements. They develop models, standards and migration plans, and validate them with engineering and operations teams. Some roles also include tuning and database operations.

zh.name: 数据库架构师
zh.summary: 数据库架构师根据查询、容量和安全要求设计企业数据库或数据仓库，制定数据模型、标准和迁移方案，并与开发和运维团队验证。部分岗位也涉及性能调优和数据库运行。

en.name: Demonstrators and product promoters
en.summary: Demonstrate products in stores or at booths, explain use and limits, answer questions and log common questions. Before taking a shift, ask whether it includes tastings, checkout or stock duties.

zh.name: 演示员推广员
zh.summary: 在卖场或展位示范产品、说明用法和限制、回答问题，并记录顾客常问事项。签班前问清是否也负责试吃、收银和库存。

en.name: Dental assistants
en.summary: Prepare patients and instruments, pass instruments and assist with suction chairside, then follow instrument processing and record procedures. Check local rules, training and authorization for radiography or expanded clinical duties. BLS lists a postsecondary nondegree award as typical. Some U.S. states allow on-the-job training; check the state dental board for radiography and expanded duties. In mainland China, check the actual clinical, nursing or administrative role. A U.S. dental assistant title is not the Chinese registered assistant physician credential.

zh.name: 牙科助理
zh.summary: 椅旁助理准备患者和器械，治疗时配合递械、吸引，之后按流程清洁或送灭菌，整理记录和预约。拍片或扩展临床任务要另核当地规定、培训与授权。 美国 BLS 列典型入门为高等教育非学位证书，不同州也可能允许在岗训练；拍片和扩展职责另查州牙科委员会。大陆招聘中的口腔护士、诊疗辅助和行政支持须按实际工作核准资质，不能把 dental assistant 直接译作持证的口腔执业助理医师。

en.name: Dental Hygienists
en.summary: Dental hygienists provide preventive care within their authorized scope: record gum and oral findings, clean teeth, explain oral hygiene and refer concerns to the dentist. Permitted procedures depend on local licensing and the workplace. In the U.S. an associate degree in dental hygiene is typical. Every state requires licensure, with state-specific rules. Mainland China’s oral health technician classification (2-05-07-17) is a task comparison, not a U.S. license equivalent or authorization to practice independently. Verify specific duties with the institution and local authority.

zh.name: 口腔卫生师
zh.summary: 口腔卫生师在获准范围内做预防性口腔护理，记录牙龈和口腔检查发现、提供洁治与健康教育，并把异常交给牙医。实际可做项目按当地执照及机构授权核查。 美国通常需牙科卫生副学士学位，各州都要求执照，具体条件按州核查。大陆人社部发布的口腔卫生技师（2-05-07-17）是任务参照，不等于美国执照或单独执业许可；洁治等实际权限须向机构及当地主管部门核实。

en.name: Dental Laboratory Technicians
en.summary: Dental laboratory technicians make and repair restorations to a dentist’s order. They check impressions, scans and materials, and document fabrication, inspection and rework. Dentists handle diagnosis, prescriptions, clinical fitting and adjustments. Try the D-01 paper case to see how you feel about checking dimensions and files.

zh.name: 牙科技工室技术员
zh.summary: 牙科技工室技术员按牙医工单制作和修理修复体，核对印模、扫描数据和材料，记录制作、检验与返修。医生负责诊断、处方、临床装戴和调整。想知道自己是否愿意反复核对尺寸与文件，可以先做 D-01 纸面工单。

en.name: Dermatologists
en.summary: Dermatologists (O*NET-SOC29-1213.00) diagnose and treat diseases of the skin, hair and nails and may also practise dermatologic surgery; consultation and examination, diagnosis and treatment, records and follow-up and education are divided according to qualification and position. The 2025 U.S. employed median wage is 328,730 USD per year and 158.04 USD per hour, with annual percentiles of 102,810/139,990/328,730/452,450/578,560. The O*NET summary still lists this subcategory's 2024 employment 10,900, 2024—2034 growth of 5% to 6% and 400 openings per year on average; the same BLS page separately lists dermatology 2025 employment 12,200, projected 13,000 in 2025—2035, growth 7% and a net increase of 800. The BLS physicians broad group has 2025 employment 862,800, growth 4% over the same period, a net 31,300 and 22,100 openings per year on average. Periods and scopes are not mixed, a net increase is not the same as average annual openings, and the projection is not AI causation or an individual hiring probability. China's article 9 education and practice pathway, examination registration, 2022 dermatology residency and aesthetic attending physician specialty filing are verified separately; the NBS2025 consulted did not obtain dermatology occupational wages, and AI adoption effects were not verified and are not filled in. With zero background, D-05 only verifies fictitious text.

zh.name: 皮肤科医师
zh.summary: 皮肤科医师（Dermatologists，O*NET-SOC29-1213.00）诊断治疗皮肤、毛发和指甲疾病，可兼皮肤外科；问诊检查、诊断治疗、记录随访和宣教按资格与岗位分工。美国2025受雇工资中位328,730美元/年、158.04美元/时，年分位102,810/139,990/328,730/452,450/578,560。O*NET摘要仍列本细类2024就业10,900、2024—2034增长5%～6%、年均空缺400；BLS同页另列皮肤科2025就业12,200、2025—2035预计13,000、增长7%及净增800。BLS医师大类2025就业862,800、同期增长4%、净增31,300、年均空缺22,100。期间与范围不混用，净增不是年均空缺，预测不是AI因果或个人录用概率。 中国法9学历实践路径、考试注册、2022皮科住培及美容主诊专业备案分别核；所查NBS2025未取皮科职业工资，未核AI采用效果不代填。零基础D-05仅核虚构文字。

en.name: Derrick Operators, Oil and Gas
en.summary: Derrick operators, oil and gas (United States 47-5011.00) are responsible for derrick inspection, mud circulation and reporting, tripping coordination and equipment maintenance. In 2025 the United States national median annual wage is 58,620 USD; the BLS2025—2035 projection is growth of 2% and a net increase of 200 people. The older 2024—2034 annual average openings of about 1,000 include growth and replacement and cannot be spliced with the new projection. In China, verify training and qualifications according to unit category, the actual work items and onshore/offshore special requirements; special operation certificates are renewed on expiry, and the new catalogue assessment for offshore drillers is implemented from June 1, 2028 onward. Comparable evidence on Chinese occupational wages and on generative AI adoption and effects in this narrow occupation has not been obtained; see each section for details.

zh.name: 石油天然气井架操作员
zh.summary: 石油天然气井架操作员（美国47-5011.00）负责井架检查、泥浆循环与报告、起下钻协同及设备维护。2025年美国全国年薪中位数58,620美元；BLS2025—2035预测增长2%、净增200人。旧2024—2034年均空缺约1,000个含增长与替补，不能与新预测拼接。中国按单位类别、实际操作项目及陆海专项要求核对培训和资格；特种作业证到期换证，海洋司钻新目录考核自2028年6月1日起实施。中国职业工资及本细类生成式AI采用、效果未取得可比证据，详情见各板块。

en.name: Desktop Publishers
en.summary: Turn copy, images and styles into proofable layouts. Check pagination, overflow, images and output settings, revise after review and keep versions. Editing and press operation depend on the assignment.

zh.name: 桌面出版专员
zh.summary: 把稿件、图片和样式整理成可校样、可交付的版面，检查分页、文字溢出、图像和输出设置，按反馈修版并保存版本。内容审核和印刷操作按岗位分工。

en.name: Detectives and Criminal Investigators
en.summary: Detectives and Criminal Investigators (O*NET-SOC 33-3021.00) are personnel who investigate conduct suspected of violating federal, state or local law in order to prevent or solve crime: obtaining facts or statements from complainants, witnesses and accused persons and recording interviews, checking records and government agency files to verify identity and connections, and determining the scope, timing and direction of the investigation; cordoning off or roping off the scene and checking the surrounding area, organizing the scene search and assigning tasks and areas, recording, marking and photographing scene objects and measuring the scene, searching for and collecting evidence such as fingerprints, and preserving, processing and analyzing evidence items; recording investigation progress and maintaining suspect files, submitting reports to superiors or a magistrate to apply for warrants, preparing and serving search and arrest warrants within the scope of authorization, testifying before a grand jury about criminal activity investigations, and preparing charges or defences and court case materials according to formal procedure, collaborating with other agencies and keeping surveillance or carrying out undercover assignments. United States scope: in the 2025 wage data for this occupation the median annual wage is 93,790 USD (median hourly 45.09 USD), with annual percentiles of 55,390 / 69,330 / 93,790 / 120,520 / 160,540 USD (hourly percentiles 26.63 / 33.33 / 45.09 / 57.94 / 77.18); 2024 employment is about 117,900 people, a decline is projected for 2024—2034 (-1% or lower) with about 7,800 projected openings; the BLS Occupational Outlook separately gives the Police and Detectives broad group as 824,200 positions in 2025, +3% for 2025—2035 and about 60,100 annual average openings; the preparation level is Job Zone Three (medium preparation, SVP 6.0 to below 7.0), usually requiring 1—2 years of training; the interest code is ICR; the work context includes dealing with the public 100% extremely important, email and telephone conversation both 100% every day, continuous contact with others 90%, importance of precision or accuracy 99% extremely important, consequences of error 82% extremely serious, typical workweek over 40 hours 67%, and outdoor exposure to various weather 60% every day. Mainland China scope: investigative work is carried out by people's police who have lawfully obtained law enforcement qualifications, who must meet the conditions set out in the People's Police Law of the People's Republic of China (at least eighteen years old, upholding the Constitution, good political, professional and personal conduct, good health, a high school education or above, and willingness to work as people's police; those who have previously been criminally punished or dismissed from public office may not serve), are generally recruited through public examination (including written examination, interview, physical fitness assessment, medical examination and political vetting), and are subject to a police rank system. Public statistics have not published occupational-level wages corresponding to this occupation, and this page retains the gap as it stands.

zh.name: 侦探刑事调查员
zh.summary: 侦探刑事调查员（Detectives and Criminal Investigators，O*NET-SOC 33-3021.00）是对涉嫌违反联邦、州或地方法律的行为开展调查、以预防或侦破犯罪的人员：从投诉人、证人与被指控人处取得事实或陈述并记录访谈，查阅记录与政府机构档案核实身份与关联，确定调查的范围、时间与方向；封锁或围起现场并检查外围，组织现场搜索并分配任务与区域，记录、标记并拍摄现场物体并测量现场，搜寻并收集指纹等证据，保存、处理与分析证据物项；记录调查进展并维护嫌疑人档案，向上级或治安法官提交报告申请令状，在授权范围内准备与送达搜查令、逮捕令，就犯罪活动调查在大陪审团前作证，并按正式程序准备指控或答辩及法庭案件材料，与其他机构协作并保持监视或执行卧底任务。美国口径：本职业 2025 年工资数据中位年薪 93,790 美元（中位时薪 45.09 美元），年度分位为 55,390／69,330／93,790／120,520／160,540 美元（小时分位 26.63／33.33／45.09／57.94／77.18）；2024 年就业约 117,900 人，2024—2034 年预计下降（-1% 或更低）、预计空缺约 7,800 个；BLS 职业展望另以 Police and Detectives 大类给出 2025 年 824,200 个岗位、2025—2035 年 +3% 与年均约 60,100 个空缺；准备层级为 Job Zone Three（中等准备，SVP 6.0 到低于 7.0），通常需要 1—2 年培训；兴趣代码 ICR；工作情境包括与公众打交道 100% 极其重要、电子邮件与电话交谈均 100% 每天、与他人持续接触 90%、精确或准确的重要性 99% 极其重要、错误后果 82% 极其严重、典型工作周超过 40 小时 67%、户外暴露于各种天气 60% 每天。中国大陆口径：侦查工作由依法取得执法资格的人民警察承担，须符合《中华人民共和国人民警察法》规定的条件（年满十八岁、拥护宪法、有良好政治业务素质和品行、身体健康、具有高中毕业以上文化程度、自愿从事人民警察工作；曾因犯罪受过刑事处罚或曾被开除公职者不得担任），并一般经公开考试录用（含笔试、面试、体能测评、体检与政治考察等环节），实行警衔制度。公开统计未发布与本职业对应的职业级工资，本页据实保留缺口。

en.name: Diagnostic Medical Sonographers
en.summary: Diagnostic medical sonographers acquire and check ultrasound images, measurements and technical records for physicians to interpret. This is U.S. O*NET 29-2032.00. Mainland China distinguishes technical and physician roles in hiring, qualifications and diagnostic responsibility.

zh.name: 医学超声技师
zh.summary: 医学超声技师采集和复核超声图像、测量及技术记录，交给医师解释。这里对应美国 O*NET 29-2032.00。大陆的超声技师和超声诊断医师在招聘、资格与诊断责任上分列。

en.name: Dietetic technicians
en.summary: Check meal plans, record intake and feedback, verify service and report discrepancies. Qualified technical staff can assist with screening, assessment or meal preparation within applicable rules. A job title or assignment alone does not authorize prescribing.

zh.name: 膳食技术员
zh.summary: 按分工核对餐单、记录进食及反馈，检查交付并报告差异。合资格技术人员可按规定参与筛查、评估或膳食配置；处方不是由岗位名称或机构分工单独决定。

en.name: Dietitians and nutritionists
en.summary: Assess dietary and health information, design a nutrition or food-service plan and review implementation and outcomes. Clinical, community and food-service roles differ; clinical treatment follows the institution’s division of responsibility and credentials.

zh.name: 膳食与营养师
zh.summary: 先收集饮食及健康信息，评估营养需要，设计可跟踪的饮食或供餐方案，随后回看执行与结果。医院、社区和供餐岗位的权限不同，疾病治疗须按机构和人员资质分工。

en.name: Dining Room and Cafeteria Attendants and Bartender Helpers
en.summary: Dining room and cafeteria attendants and bartender helpers (O*NET 35-9011.00) set and clear tables, replenish tableware and bar supplies, and may help deliver meals. Servers focus on taking orders and serving tables; bartenders focus on preparing and serving drinks. Duties can overlap, so check who is authorized to handle payments, refunds, alcohol, or allergy questions.

zh.name: 餐厅、食堂与酒吧服务助手
zh.summary: 餐厅、食堂与酒吧服务助手（O*NET 35-9011.00）协助摆台、撤下脏餐具、补齐餐具和吧台用品，也可能协助上菜。服务员侧重接单和席间服务，调酒师侧重调制和供应酒水；店内分工可能重叠，收银、退款、酒水与过敏原问题要按岗位授权处理。

en.name: Directors, Religious Activities and Education
en.summary: Directors, Religious Activities and Education (United States side, O*NET-SOC 21-2021.00) is an education program and activity management position within a denomination: coordinating or designing programs and conducting outreach within a religious group or institution to promote the religious education or activities of a denominational group; analyzing member participation and the congregation's focus according to the group's education goals to determine religious education needs, selecting courses or class structures, and collaborating with other ministry members to determine education goals; identifying and recruiting potential volunteers and training and supervising religious education teaching staff; arranging special activities such as camps and meetings and seminars and retreats, and implementing program plans by ordering materials and arranging instructors and reserving venues; analyzing income and program costs to determine budget priorities, planning fundraising activities, publicizing programs through newsletters and announcements and mailings, and negotiating with clergy and congregational leaders for support; may provide counseling and guidance on interpersonal, health, financial and religious issues, and conducts review and handoff within the scope of authorization. The outputs are course and activity plans designed according to education goals, a volunteer team recruited and trained, activities and camps held as planned, and checkable review records of participation and costs. United States scope: the median annual wage for this occupation in May 2025 wage data is 52,100 US dollars (median hourly wage 25.05 US dollars), with annual percentiles of 34,670／44,010／52,100／73,730／98,310 US dollars (hourly percentiles 16.67／21.16／25.05／35.45／47.26); the O*NET summary page gives employment of about 138,900 in 2024, growth of 1% to 2% in 2024—2034 (below average) and about 13,800 projected job openings, with the main industry being other services except public administration; the preparation level is Job Zone Four (SVP 7.0 to below 8.0), the education feedback is 54% bachelor's degree and 21% postsecondary certificate and 14% associate's or two-year degree, with a considerable amount of related experience required; the interest code is SE; the work context includes freedom to determine tasks and priorities very much 98%, in a controlled indoor environment every day 86%, decision freedom very much 78%, use email every day 64%, telephone conversations every day 47%, and contact with others most of the time 78%. Chinese mainland scope: this occupation has no uniform access-type professional qualification; religious clergy engaged in religious affairs activities must be recognized by a religious group and filed with the religious affairs department at or above the county level under the Regulations on Religious Affairs (State Council Decree No. 686, effective 2018-02-01), the appointment and departure of the principal clergy of a religious activity venue must be consented to and filed by the religious group, and entities that are not religious groups, religious colleges or religious activity venues may not conduct religious education and training. Public wage statistics have not established an occupation-level scope corresponding to this occupation, and this page truthfully retains the gap.

zh.name: 宗教活动与教育主管
zh.summary: 宗教活动与教育主管（美国侧 O*NET-SOC 21-2021.00）是教派内部的教育项目与活动管理岗位：在宗教团体或机构内协调或设计项目并开展外展，以促进某一教派团体的宗教教育或活动；按团体的教育目标分析成员参与情况与会众重心以确定宗教教育需求，选择课程或班级结构，与其他事工成员协作确定教育目标；识别并招募潜在志愿者，培训与督导宗教教育教学人员；安排营会与会议与研讨会与静修等专项活动，通过订购材料与安排讲员与预留场地落实项目计划；分析收入与项目成本以确定预算优先顺序，策划筹款活动，通过通讯与公告与邮寄宣传项目，并与神职人员与会众负责人协商争取支持；可就人际、健康、财务与宗教问题提供咨询与指导，并在授权范围内做复盘与交接。产出是按教育目标设计的课程与活动方案、招募并培训到位的志愿者队伍、按计划举办的活动与营会，以及参与度与成本的可核对复盘记录。美国口径：本职业 2025 年 5 月工资数据中位年薪 52,100 美元（中位时薪 25.05 美元），年度分位为 34,670／44,010／52,100／73,730／98,310 美元（小时分位 16.67／21.16／25.05／35.45／47.26）；O*NET 摘要页给出 2024 年就业约 138,900 人、2024—2034 年增长 1% 至 2%（低于平均）与约 13,800 个预计职位空缺，主要行业为除公共管理外的其他服务业；准备层级为 Job Zone Four（SVP 7.0 至低于 8.0），教育反馈为 54% 学士学位与 21% 中学后证书与 14% 副学士或两年制学位，相关经验要求「相当数量」；兴趣代码 SE；工作情境包括确定任务与优先级的自由度「很大」98%、每天处于室内受控环境 86%、决策自由度「很大」78%、每天使用电子邮件 64%、每天电话交谈 47%、与他人接触「大部分时间」78%。中国大陆口径：本职业不设统一准入类职业资格；从事宗教教务活动的宗教教职人员须按《宗教事务条例》（国务院令第 686 号，2018-02-01 施行）经宗教团体认定并报县级以上宗教事务部门备案，宗教活动场所主要教职的任职与离任须经宗教团体同意并备案，非宗教团体、非宗教院校、非宗教活动场所不得开展宗教教育培训。公开工资统计未建立与本职业对应的职业级口径，本页据实保留缺口。

en.name: Disc Jockeys, Except Radio
en.summary: Disc Jockeys, Except Radio (United States side, O*NET-SOC 27-2091.00) is a position providing paid music and mood services for clients and live crowds: operating disc jockey controllers and microphones and other audio and video equipment, communicating activity information with clients or venue managers (music preferences, schedule, expected attendance), customizing the playlist by activity segment, assembling audio and video equipment and doing a sound check, selecting tracks and playing and mixing according to crowd preferences and mood, taking guest song requests, operating lighting and smoke and visual equipment and building mood and hosting party games, writing announcement scripts and booking contracts, issuing itemized invoices and promoting services through internet advertising and brochures; and after the event dismantling and inventorying equipment, collecting fees and reviewing and handing off. United States scope: for this occupation the BLS 2025 wage data hourly median is 21.61 US dollars, with hourly percentiles of 13.50／16.91／21.61／37.50／60.17 US dollars; that source publishes only the hourly scope for this occupation and does not publish an annual median wage or annual percentiles, and this page does not convert them on its own. The O*NET summary page gives employment of about 15,400 in 2024, growth of 3% to 4% in 2024—2034 (average) and about 1,500 projected job openings; the preparation level is Job Zone 1-2 (SVP below 6.0), the education feedback is 52% high school or equivalent and 36% less than high school and 4% some college no degree, with on-the-job training from a few days to a year; the interest code is AEC; the work context includes decision freedom very much 72%, use email every day 63%, dealing with external customers or the public extremely important 60%, working hours irregular 60%, public speaking weekly or more 48%, continuous standing 36%, continuous use of hands 44%, noise exposure weekly or more 32%, and level of competition extremely fierce 40%. Chinese mainland scope: this occupation has no uniform access-type individual certificate; holding a commercial performance requires an entity that has obtained a commercial performance operating license according to law to apply for approval under the Regulations on the Administration of Commercial Performances (promulgated by State Council Decree No. 439 of 2005, revised for the fourth time by State Council Decree No. 732 on 2020-11-29) and its implementing rules, and performance venue operating units and individual performers and individual performance brokers must file as prescribed; publicly playing or disseminating musical works must meet copyright and collective management requirements. Public statistics have not established an occupation-level wage scope corresponding to this occupation, and this page truthfully retains the gap.

zh.name: 非电台唱片骑师
zh.summary: 非电台唱片骑师（美国侧 O*NET-SOC 27-2091.00）是面向客户与现场人群提供有偿音乐与气氛服务的岗位：操作唱片骑师控制器与麦克风等音视频设备，与客户或场地负责人沟通活动信息（音乐偏好、排期、预计人数），按活动环节定制播放清单，组装音频与视频设备并做声音检查，结合人群偏好与气氛选曲与播放与混音，接受来宾点歌，操作灯光与烟雾与视觉设备并带动气氛与主持派对游戏，撰写公告稿与预订合同、开具明细发票并通过互联网广告与宣传册推广服务；并在活动后拆卸清点设备、收取费用与复盘交接。美国口径：本职业 BLS 2025 年工资数据小时中位 21.61 美元，小时分位为 13.50／16.91／21.61／37.50／60.17 美元；该来源对本职业只公布小时口径，未公布年薪中位数与年度分位，本页不自行折算。O*NET 摘要页给出 2024 年就业约 15,400 人、2024—2034 年增长 3% 至 4%（平均）与约 1,500 个预计职位空缺；准备层级为 Job Zone 1-2（SVP 低于 6.0），教育反馈为 52% 高中或同等学历与 36% 高中以下即可与 4% 部分大学无学位，在职培训从几天到一年；兴趣代码 AEC；工作情境包括决策自由度「很大」72%、每天使用电子邮件 63%、与外部客户或公众打交道「极其重要」60%、工作时间「不规律」60%、公开演讲「每周以上」48%、持续站立 36%、持续用手操作 44%、噪声暴露「每周以上」32%、竞争程度「极其激烈」40%。中国大陆口径：本职业无统一准入类个人证书；举办营业性演出须由依法取得营业性演出许可证的主体按《营业性演出管理条例》（2005 年国务院令第 439 号公布，2020-11-29 国务院令第 732 号第四次修订）与《营业性演出管理条例实施细则》申请审批，演出场所经营单位与个体演员与个体演出经纪人须按规定备案；公开播放或传播音乐作品须符合著作权与集体管理要求。公开统计未建立与本职业对应的职业级工资口径，本页据实保留缺口。

en.name: Dishwashers
en.summary: Dishwashers clean dishes and cookware, put clean items away and keep the dish area ready. Some jobs include restocking, bussing or food prep. Ask about combined duties, shifts, training and local health requirements.

zh.name: 洗碗工
zh.summary: 洗碗工负责清洗餐具和厨具、归位干净器皿，并保持洗涤区可用。部分岗位还要补给、收台或协助备料；看招聘时先确认兼岗、班次、带教和健康证明。

en.name: Dispatchers (Except Police, Fire and Ambulance)
en.summary: Review requests, assign available staff, equipment or vehicles, then track changes, delays and handoffs. Fleet dispatch is one setting. This occupation excludes police, fire and ambulance dispatch.

zh.name: 调度员（不含警务、消防和救护）
zh.summary: 核对请求，按人员、设备或车辆可用情况派工，跟踪任务并记录改派、延误和交接。这里指非警务、消防或救护的调度，车队只是其中一种场景。

en.name: Document management specialists
en.summary: Maintain classification and metadata, configure version, approval, access and release workflows, and support retrieval, migration and audit. Organizational rules determine access and final approvals.

zh.name: 文档管理专员
zh.summary: 制定或维护文件分类和元数据，配置版本、审批、访问及发布流程，支持检索、迁移与审计。权限和最终批准由组织规则决定。

en.name: Door-to-door sales workers, news and street vendors, and related workers
en.summary: Door-to-Door Sales Workers, News and Street Vendors, and Related Workers (United States side, O*NET-SOC 41-9091.00) is a non-store face-to-face direct selling position: selling goods or services door to door or along the street; determining potential customers or a vending location and preparing samples and explanatory materials and payment money, explaining the goods or services and price to potential customers and demonstrating, checking customer needs and answering questions about product functions and benefits, persuading customers to buy and recording or entering orders, and organizing purchasing meetings and seeking sponsorship when necessary; arranging delivery or same-spot delivery and payment with change and vouchers and invoices, distributing samples or materials, restocking and tidying the display, keeping service records and contacting customers to confirm satisfaction, and training newly recruited staff or other employees when necessary; the employment form may be employed, commission-based or self-employed (individual business operator). United States scope: the BLS 2025 wage data median is 41,380 US dollars per year (19.89 US dollars per hour), with annual percentiles of 32,010／36,470／41,380／47,390／51,470 US dollars (hourly percentiles 15.39／17.54／19.89／22.78／24.74); this scope is employed wage statistics, OEWS does not cover the self-employed, and commissions and expense reimbursement and irregular business income do not necessarily enter the same scope; the O*NET summary page gives employment of about 25,300 in 2024, a 2024—2034 projection of decline (-1% or lower) and about 2,700 projected job openings (the source gives only the category and not a specific percentage, and this page states it in the original wording); the preparation level is Job Zone 1-2 (SVP below 6.0), the interest code is ECR, the education feedback is 57% less than high school and 43% high school or equivalent, and there are 14 tasks; the work context includes continuous contact with others 52% (another 43% in contact most of the time), face-to-face discussions every day 36% (another 50% weekly or more), telephone conversations every day 55%, dealing with external customers or the public extremely important 70%, decision freedom very much 88%, precision or accuracy extremely important 17%, facing time pressure every day 17%, working hours irregular 67%, standing about half the time 46%, dealing with unpleasant or angry or rude people monthly or more 38%, conflict situations yearly or more 50%, level of competition extremely competitive 13%, and use email every day 70%. Chinese mainland scope: business activity should involve truthful and comprehensive explanation, clearly marked prices, provision of vouchers, protection of personal information and handling of complaints (under the Consumer Rights and Interests Protection Law of the People's Republic of China); engaging in individual business and vending and mobile business should meet local market supervision and urban management requirements, and where food is involved should also meet food safety requirements (cited by regulation and rule name and general requirements, without checking article numbers item by item); on the United States side, in door-to-door or other off-premises transactions covered by the federal rule, the seller must disclose the three-business-day cancellation right to the consumer under 16 CFR Part 429 (the FTC cooling-off rule), and whether it applies depends on amount, location, goods or services and exceptions. This occupation has no uniform access-type professional qualification in the Chinese mainland. Public statistics have not established an occupation-level wage scope corresponding to this occupation, and this page truthfully retains the gap.

zh.name: 上门销售员与街头摊贩及相关人员
zh.summary: 上门销售员与街头摊贩及相关人员（美国侧 O*NET-SOC 41-9091.00，Door-to-Door Sales Workers, News and Street Vendors, and Related Workers）是非门店的面对面直接销售岗位：上门或沿街销售商品或服务；确定潜在客户或摆摊地点并准备样品与说明材料与货款，向潜在客户说明商品或服务与价格并演示，核对客户需求并回答商品功能与利益问题，说服客户购买并记录或录入订单，必要时组织购买会并争取赞助；安排交付或当场交货收款并找零与出具凭证与发票，分发样品或资料，补货与整理陈列，保存服务记录并联系客户确认满意度，必要时培训新招募人员或其他雇员；从业形态可能是雇员、佣金制或自营（个体经营者）。美国口径：BLS 2025 年工资数据中位 41,380 美元/年（19.89 美元/时），年度分位 32,010／36,470／41,380／47,390／51,470 美元（小时分位 15.39／17.54／19.89／22.78／24.74）；该口径为受雇工资统计，OEWS 不覆盖自雇者，佣金与费用报销与不规则的经营收入未必进入同一口径；O*NET 摘要页给出 2024 年就业约 25,300 人、2024—2034 年预测为「下降（-1% 或更低）」与约 2,700 个预计职位空缺（该来源只给出类别而未给出具体百分比，本页按口径原文表述）；准备层级为 Job Zone 1-2（SVP 低于 6.0），兴趣代码 ECR，教育反馈为 57% 低于高中学历与 43% 高中或同等学历，任务 14 项；工作情境包括与他人持续接触 52%（另 43% 大部分时间接触）、每天面对面讨论 36%（另 50% 每周以上）、每天电话交谈 55%、与外部客户或公众打交道「极其重要」70%、决策自由度「很大」88%、精确或准确「极其重要」17%、每天面对时间压力 17%、工作时间「不规律」67%、站立「约一半时间」46%、应对不愉快或愤怒或粗鲁的人「每月以上」38%、冲突情境「每年以上」50%、竞争程度「极度竞争」13%、每天使用电子邮件 70%。中国大陆口径：经营活动应真实全面说明、明码标价、提供凭证、保护个人信息并处理投诉（依《中华人民共和国消费者权益保护法》）；从事个体工商户与摊贩与流动经营应符合所在地市场监督与城市管理要求，涉及食品还应符合食品安全要求（按法规与制度名称与一般要求引用，未逐条核对条文编号）；美国侧在联邦规则适用的上门或其他场所交易中，销售方须依 16 CFR Part 429（FTC 冷静期规则）向消费者披露三工作日取消权，是否适用取决于金额、地点、商品服务与例外。本职业在中国大陆不设统一准入类职业资格。公开统计未建立与本职业对应的职业级工资口径，本页据实保留缺口。

en.name: Dredge operators
en.summary: Dredge operators (U.S. side O*NET-SOC 53-7031.00, Dredge Operators) are the dredge operator positions for dredging and waterway maintenance: they operate a dredge to remove sand and gravel or other materials in order to excavate and maintain navigable channels in waterways; the work includes positioning the dredge with control levers for excavation and engaging the hydraulic pump and raising and lowering the suction arm and controlling cutter rotation, starting and stopping the engine to operate equipment, operating power winches to pay out and haul in lines to adjust vessel position or handling lines by hand, pumping water to flush the mechanical pipeline, lowering the spud with the winch to check the excavation depth or reading the depth gauge to determine the excavation depth, directing or assisting workers in laying out shore anchors and lines and laying the pipeline from the dredge to shore and pontoon drainage, and adjusting the excavation line and depth based on survey and depth data, performing routine maintenance on dredge equipment (such as changing oil), discharging slurry and spoil in designated areas, and recording excavation and discharge data and reporting and handing over when anomalies occur. U.S. definition: the BLS 2025 wage data median is 49,640 USD per year (23.86 USD per hour), with annual percentiles of 41,080 / 46,430 / 49,640 / 62,070 / 74,140 USD (hourly percentiles 19.75 / 22.32 / 23.86 / 29.84 / 35.65); the O*NET summary page gives 2024 employment of about 1,100, a 2024—2034 projection of 'slower than average (Slower than average, 1% to 2%)', and about 100 projected job openings (that source gives only the category and range rather than a single precise percentage, and this page follows the source wording); the preparation level is Job Zone 1-2 (SVP below 6.0), the education feedback is 80% high school or equivalent and 9% postsecondary certificate and 7% less than high school, the interest code is RC, and there are 7 tasks; the work context includes continuous contact with others 43%, face-to-face discussions every day 95%, telephone conversations every day 24% (another 39% never), email use 'never' 89%, teamwork 'extremely important' 34%, decision freedom 'very large' 39%, precision or accuracy 'very important' 19%, time pressure every day 13%, work hours 'regular (fixed schedule)' 72%, standing 'about half the time' 52%, exposure to hazardous equipment 'every day' 64%, exposure to whole-body vibration 'every day' 40%, wearing common protective or safety equipment 'every day' 97%, exposure to noise 'every day' 69%, exposure to extreme heat or extreme cold 'weekly or more' 35%, outdoor exposure to all kinds of weather 'every day' 81%, and consequences of error 'extremely serious' 13% (another 30% very serious). Mainland China definition: carrying out permitted overwater and underwater operations in jurisdictional sea areas and inland navigable waters requires a permit from the maritime administration and a designated safe work zone (Provisions of the People's Republic of China on Navigation Safety Administration of Overwater and Underwater Operations and Activities, Ministry of Transport Order No. 24 of 2021, with waterway maintenance dredging excluded); carrying out navigation channel construction and dredging of navigation channels and waters in front of wharves in inland navigable waters should be reported to the maritime administration for approval (Article twenty-five, paragraph one, item (six) of the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Inland Waterway Traffic Safety Administration); the department responsible for waterway management carrying out waterway maintenance activities that affect navigation, such as waterway dredging and obstacle clearance, should set up prominent operation signs and take necessary safety measures and give advance notice to the maritime administration (Article nineteen, paragraph two of the Waterways Law of the People's Republic of China); vessels should meet minimum safe manning requirements and be crewed by personnel holding qualified and valid certificates (the Minimum Safe Manning Rules of the People's Republic of China and Article thirty-three of the Maritime Traffic Safety Law of the People's Republic of China). Except for Order No. 24 and Article nineteen, paragraph two of the Waterways Law, the parts above are cited by regulation name and general requirements without verifying article numbers one by one. This occupation has no unified access-type occupational qualification in mainland China. Public statistics have not established an occupation-level wage definition corresponding to this occupation, and this page preserves the gap as it stands.

zh.name: 挖泥船操作员
zh.summary: 挖泥船操作员（美国侧 O*NET-SOC 53-7031.00，Dredge Operators）是疏浚与航道维护的挖泥船操作岗位：操作挖泥船清除沙子与砾石或其他材料，以开挖并维护水道中的可通航航道；工作含操纵杆定位挖泥船进行开挖与接合液压泵与升降吸泥臂与控制绞刀旋转，启停发动机操作设备，操作动力绞盘收放缆绳调整船位或手动收放缆绳，泵水冲洗机械管路，用绞盘下放锚桩核对开挖深度或读取深度计确定开挖深度，指挥或协助工人布设岸锚与缆绳与铺设从挖泥船到岸的管路与浮箱排水，并依据测量与深度数据调整开挖线与深度，对挖泥船设备做日常保养（如更换机油），按指定区域排放泥浆与弃土，记录开挖与排放数据并在异常时上报与交接。美国口径：BLS 2025 年工资数据中位 49,640 美元/年（23.86 美元/时），年度分位 41,080／46,430／49,640／62,070／74,140 美元（小时分位 19.75／22.32／23.86／29.84／35.65）；O*NET 摘要页给出 2024 年就业约 1,100 人、2024—2034 年预测为「慢于平均（Slower than average，1% 至 2%）」与约 100 个预计职位空缺（该来源只给出类别与区间而未给出单一精确百分比，本页按口径原文表述）；准备层级为 Job Zone 1-2（SVP 低于 6.0），教育反馈为 80% 高中或同等学历与 9% 中学后证书与 7% 低于高中学历，兴趣代码 RC，任务 7 项；工作情境包括与他人持续接触 43%、每天面对面讨论 95%、每天电话交谈 24%（另 39% 从不）、每天使用电子邮件 89%「从不」、团队协作「极其重要」34%、决策自由度「很大」39%、精确或准确「非常重要」19%、每天面对时间压力 13%、工作时间「规律（固定日程）」72%、站立「约一半时间」52%、暴露于危险设备「每天」64%、暴露于全身振动「每天」40%、穿戴常见防护或安全装备「每天」97%、暴露于噪音「每天」69%、暴露于极热或极冷温度「每周以上」35%、户外暴露于各种天气「每天」81%、错误后果「极其严重」13%（另 30% 非常严重）。中国大陆口径：在管辖海域与内河通航水域从事需许可的水上水下作业应经海事管理机构许可并核定安全作业区（《中华人民共和国水上水下作业和活动通航安全管理规定》，交通运输部令 2021 年第 24 号，航道养护疏浚除外）；在内河通航水域进行航道建设与航道与码头前沿水域疏浚等应报海事管理机构批准（《中华人民共和国内河交通安全管理条例》第二十五条第一款第（六）项）；负责航道管理的部门进行航道疏浚与清障等影响通航的航道养护活动应设置明显的作业标志与采取必要的安全措施并提前通报海事管理机构（《中华人民共和国航道法》第十九条第二款）；船舶应满足最低安全配员要求并配备持有合格有效证书的船员（《中华人民共和国船舶最低安全配员规则》与《中华人民共和国海上交通安全法》第三十三条）。上述除第 24 号令与《航道法》第十九条第二款外的部分按法规名称与一般要求引用，未逐条核对条文编号。本职业在中国大陆不设统一准入类职业资格。公开统计未建立与本职业对应的职业级工资口径，本页据实保留缺口。

en.name: Driver/sales workers
en.summary: Deliver goods along a route and handle the sales duties assigned to the job. Check stock and proof of delivery, then record sales, replenishment or returns as applicable and reconcile under employer procedures.

zh.name: 司机兼销售员
zh.summary: 沿路线送货并完成岗位约定的销售任务。出车前核货，交付时核数量和签收；若岗位包含销售，再记录补货订单、销售或退货，按公司流程对账。

en.name: Drywall and ceiling tile installers
en.summary: Drywall and ceiling tile installers (U.S. side O*NET-SOC 47-2081.00, Drywall and Ceiling Tile Installers) are the drywall and ceiling panel installation positions in building interior fit-out: they install paper-faced drywall or other wallboard to building ceilings or interior walls and install or secure acoustic tiles or blocks or strips or sheet vibration-damping material to ceilings and walls to damp or reflect sound and decorate rooms, and also secure wood or metal or rock wool lath to walls and ceilings or partitions as the supporting substrate for plaster or fire protection or acoustic material; the work includes studying the drawings and specifications to determine the installation method and sequence and materials and tools, measuring and laying out and marking according to the drawings, installing metal or wood studs and hangers and lath substrate and insulation and moisture barrier, cutting and assembling stud frames, hoisting and securing drywall and ceiling panels and acoustic tiles, measuring and cutting openings for outlets and windows and air grilles and ducts and irregular and corner boards and trimming panel edges and providing expansion joints, installing frames and decorative trim and ceiling wires and angle grid, sealing ceiling-to-wall joints, coordinating joint treatment with the tapers, inspecting the verticality and levelness of suspension fittings and mechanical fasteners and masonry surfaces, and removing existing plaster or panels and cleaning up and closing out. U.S. definition: the BLS 2025 wage data median is 58,930 USD per year (28.33 USD per hour), with annual percentiles of 38,460 / 47,440 / 58,930 / 74,230 / 102,010 USD (hourly percentiles 18.49 / 22.81 / 28.33 / 35.69 / 49.04); the O*NET summary page gives 2024 employment of about 103,100, a 2024—2034 projection of 'average (Average, 3% to 4%)', and about 7,700 projected job openings (that source gives only the category and range rather than a single precise percentage, and this page follows the source wording); the preparation level is Job Zone 1-2 (SVP below 6.0), the education feedback is 42% less than high school graduation and 24% high school or equivalent and 19% postsecondary certificate (that page shows only these three, totaling 85%), the interest code is RC, and there are 24 tasks; the work context includes standing continuously 92%, continuous use of hands 83%, continuous contact with others 88%, exposure to heights every day 72%, continuous walking or running 78%, face-to-face discussions every day 68%, time pressure every day 52%, decision freedom 'very large' 54%, precision or accuracy 'extremely important' 37%, decisions every day 74%, wearing common protective or safety equipment every day 61%, responsibility for the health and safety of others 'very high responsibility' 45%, competition 'extremely fierce' 43%, continuous climbing of ladders or scaffolds 47%, continuous bending or twisting 52%, minor burns or cuts every day 34%, exposure to hazardous equipment 'every day' 20%, consequences of error 'extremely serious' 30%, continuous kneeling, squatting, bending, or crawling 31%, work hours 'regular' 94%, and automation level 'not automated at all' 55%. Mainland China definition: ceiling works should be carried out in accordance with the current national standard Standard for Construction Quality Acceptance of Building Decoration (GB 50210-2018) and this project's design documents (including material conformity certificates and performance test reports and incoming inspection records and retest reports and concealed works acceptance records and construction records; before installing studs, carry out handover inspection of the room's clear height and opening elevations and the elevations of pipes and equipment and their supports within the ceiling as required by the design; the hanger distance from the end of the main stud must not exceed 300mm and reverse bracing is provided when the hanger length exceeds 1500mm; heavy equipment and equipment with vibration loads must never be installed on the studs of ceiling works; a steel transfer layer is provided when the hanger length exceeds 2500mm); working at height should follow the Technical Code for Safety of Working at Height in Building Construction (JGJ 80) and the Regulations on the Administration of Construction Project Work Safety (State Council Order No. 393) and the Work Safety Law of the People's Republic of China, with stable platforms and protection installed and protective equipment such as safety harnesses worn. The above is cited by standard and regulation name and verified key points, and article numbers were not verified one by one. This occupation has no unified access-type occupational qualification in mainland China. Public statistics have not established an occupation-level wage definition corresponding to this occupation, this page preserves the gap as it stands, and industry average wages serve only as a visible industry proxy.

zh.name: 石膏板与天花板瓷砖安装工
zh.summary: 石膏板与天花板瓷砖安装工（美国侧 O*NET-SOC 47-2081.00，Drywall and Ceiling Tile Installers）是建筑室内装修的石膏板与吊顶板安装岗位：把纸面石膏板或其他墙板安装到建筑吊顶或内墙，并把吸声瓷砖或块或条或片状减振材料安装或固定到吊顶与墙面以减振或反射声音与装饰房间，也包括把木或金属或岩棉板条固定到墙与吊顶或隔断作为抹灰或防火或吸声材料的支承基层；工作含研读图纸与说明确定安装方法与工序与材料与工具，按图纸测量放样与划线，安装金属或木龙骨与吊杆与板条基层与保温防潮层，切割与组装龙骨框，吊装并固定石膏板与吊顶板与吸声板，测量并切割插座与窗与风口与管道洞口与异形与边角板并修整板边与预留伸缩缝，安装框与装饰线与吊线与角钢网格，密封吊顶板与墙接缝，与嵌缝工协调接缝处理，检查吊挂件与机械固定件与砌体表面的垂直与水平，拆除原有抹灰或板材并清理收尾。美国口径：BLS 2025 年工资数据中位 58,930 美元/年（28.33 美元/时），年度分位 38,460／47,440／58,930／74,230／102,010 美元（小时分位 18.49／22.81／28.33／35.69／49.04）；O*NET 摘要页给出 2024 年就业约 103,100 人、2024—2034 年预测为「平均（Average，3% 至 4%）」与约 7,700 个预计职位空缺（该来源只给出类别与区间而未给出单一精确百分比，本页按口径原文表述）；准备层级为 Job Zone 1-2（SVP 低于 6.0），教育反馈为 42% 低于高中毕业与 24% 高中或同等学历与 19% 中学后证书（该页仅显示这三项、合计 85%），兴趣代码 RC，任务 24 项；工作情境包括持续站立 92%、持续用手 83%、持续与他人接触 88%、每天暴露于高处 72%、持续步行或跑动 78%、每天面对面讨论 68%、每天时间压力 52%、决策自由度「很大」54%、精确或准确「极其重要」37%、每天决策 74%、每天穿戴常见防护或安全装备 61%、他人健康与安全「非常高责任」45%、竞争「极其激烈」43%、持续爬梯或脚手架 47%、持续弯腰或扭身 52%、每天轻微烧伤割伤 34%、暴露于危险设备「每天」20%、错误后果「极其严重」30%、持续跪蹲弯腰爬行 31%、工作时间「规律」94%、自动化程度「完全非自动化」55%。中国大陆口径：吊顶工程应按现行国家标准《建筑装饰装修工程质量验收标准》（GB 50210-2018）与本项目设计文件执行（含材料合格证书与性能检验报告与进场验收记录与复验报告与隐蔽工程验收记录与施工记录；安装龙骨前按设计要求对房间净高与洞口标高和吊顶内管道与设备及其支架标高进行交接检验；吊杆距主龙骨端部不得大于 300mm 且吊杆长度大于 1500mm 时设反支撑；重型设备和有振动荷载的设备严禁安装在吊顶工程的龙骨上；吊杆长度大于 2500mm 时设钢结构转换层）；高处作业应按《建筑施工高处作业安全技术规范》（JGJ 80）与《建设工程安全生产管理条例》（国务院令第 393 号）与《中华人民共和国安全生产法》要求搭设稳固平台与防护并佩戴安全带等防护用品。上述按标准与法规名称与已核要点引用，未逐条核对条文编号。本职业在中国大陆不设统一准入类职业资格。公开统计未建立与本职业对应的职业级工资口径，本页据实保留缺口，行业平均工资只作为可见行业代理。

en.name: Earth drillers, except oil and gas
en.summary: Earth drillers operate drilling equipment for water wells, mineral exploration, soil investigations and construction or mining holes. Duties vary by project: coring, well development and drilling blast holes are possible tasks, not a requirement that every worker performs all of them. In mainland China, the work overlaps with geological exploration drillers (4-08-07-01); project scope, employer training and applicable work-safety requirements need separate checks.

zh.name: 土方钻探工、石油天然气除外
zh.summary: 这一美国职业在水井、矿产勘查、土壤调查及采矿或建设项目中操作钻探设备。取心、成井及爆破孔钻进属于可能涉及的任务，具体随项目变化，并非每个岗位全部承担。中国大陆可参照地勘钻探工（4-08-07-01）的职责交集，同时分别核对项目范围、雇主培训和适用的安全生产要求。

en.name: Economists
en.summary: Use data, models, and economic theory to explain phenomena, evaluate policy or market problems, and write the assumptions, uncertainty, and recommendations into a reviewable report.

zh.name: 经济学家
zh.summary: 用数据、模型和经济理论解释现象、评估政策或市场问题，并把假设、不确定性与建议写成可审查报告。

en.name: Editors
en.summary: Plan, review, and revise content to be published, verify facts, language, structure, style, and version, and coordinate authors and publication responsible persons.

zh.name: 编辑
zh.summary: 规划、审阅和修订待发布内容，核对事实、语言、结构、风格与版本，并协调作者和发布责任人。

en.name: Education administrators, kindergarten through secondary
en.summary: Education administrators, kindergarten through secondary (US O*NET-SOC 11-9032.00, Education Administrators, Kindergarten through Secondary) are the schooling and instructional leadership positions for kindergarten through secondary education: planning, directing, or coordinating the academic and administrative and auxiliary activities of kindergartens and elementary and secondary schools; the work includes determining curriculum standards and performance goals and school improvement directions per education goals and regulations and data, observing teaching and reviewing learning materials to assess and unify curriculum and instruction, working with teachers to set curriculum standards and mission and performance goals, determining course offerings and scheduling and staffing and facility needs, organizing professional development, providing students with academic and behavioral and attendance guidance and enforcing discipline and attendance rules, communicating with parents and faculty, recruiting, training, and evaluating faculty and making personnel recommendations, preparing and submitting budgets and funding applications and authorizing procurement, arranging school buses and meals and facilities and building maintenance and safety, interpreting government regulations and developing compliance plans, liaising with government and businesses and the community and writing reports, and supervising student drop-off and pickup. US basis: the BLS 2025 wage data median is 105,870 US dollars per year (that source provides only the median and does not provide the 10/25/75/90 percentiles or an hourly basis); the O*NET summary page gives about 333,300 employed in 2024, a 2024—2034 projection of Decline (Decline, -1% or lower), and about 20,800 average annual openings for 2024—2034; the preparation level is Job Zone Five (SVP 8.0 and above), the education feedback is 62% master's degree and 27% bachelor's degree and 10% post-master's certificate, the interest code is SEC, and there are 33 tasks. Mainland China basis: the appointment qualification, engagement, assessment, and training of primary and secondary school principals and related management positions follow the Education Law and the Compulsory Education Law of the People's Republic of China and the relevant provisions of the education administration department, and doing education and teaching work in primary and secondary schools requires obtaining the corresponding teacher qualification per the Teachers Law and the Regulations on Teacher Qualifications of the People's Republic of China. Public statistics have no occupation-level wage basis corresponding to this occupation established, and this page truthfully keeps the gap, with the industry average wage serving only as a visible industry proxy.

zh.name: 教育行政管理者、幼儿园至中等教育
zh.summary: 教育行政管理者、幼儿园至中等教育（美国侧 O*NET-SOC 11-9032.00，Education Administrators, Kindergarten through Secondary）是幼儿园至中等教育的办学与教学领导岗位：规划、指导或协调幼儿园与小学与中学的学术与行政与辅助活动；工作含按教育目标与法规与数据确定课程标准与绩效目标与学校改进方向，观察教学并审阅学习材料以评估与统一课程与教学，与教师共同制定课程标准与使命与绩效目标，确定课程开设范围与排课与师资与设施需求，组织专业发展，为学生提供学业与行为与出勤指导并执行纪律与出勤规则，与家长与教职工沟通，招聘与培训与考核教职工并提出人事建议，编制与提交预算与拨款申请并授权采购，安排校车与餐饮与设施与校舍维护与安全，解读政府法规并制定遵循方案，与政府与企业与社区对接并撰写报告，并监督学生接送。美国口径：BLS 2025 年工资数据中位 105,870 美元/年（该来源仅提供中位数，未提供 10/25/75/90 分位与小时口径）；O*NET 摘要页给出 2024 年就业约 333,300 人、2024—2034 年预测为「下降（Decline，-1% 或更低）」与 2024—2034 年预计年均空缺 20,800 个；准备层级为 Job Zone Five（SVP 8.0 及以上），教育反馈为 62% 硕士学位与 27% 学士学位与 10% 硕士后证书，兴趣代码 SEC，任务 33 项。中国大陆口径：中小学校长与相关管理岗位的任职资格、聘任与考核与培训依《中华人民共和国教育法》《中华人民共和国义务教育法》与教育行政部门的相关规定执行，在中小学从事教育教学工作应依《中华人民共和国教师法》与《教师资格条例》取得相应教师资格。公开统计未建立与本职业对应的职业级工资口径，本页据实保留缺口，行业平均工资只作为可见行业代理。

en.name: Education Teachers, Postsecondary
en.summary: Education Teachers, Postsecondary (United States side O*NET-SOC 25-1081.00, Education Teachers, Postsecondary) is a teaching and research post in higher education institutions: teaching and research of education and teacher education related courses in higher education institutions; the work includes determining course content and teaching and assessment objectives by subject direction and program goals and assessment data, preparing syllabi and assignments and lecture notes and practice materials, teaching and organizing discussions and seminars and practice, setting and administering and grading examinations and giving feedback, updating course content and teaching methods, conducting educational research and literature reviews and data collection and analysis, writing and submitting and revising papers and monographs and reports, applying for and carrying out research projects and funding, taking part in academic conferences and peer review and academic exchange, advising students on course selection and studies and research methods and papers and proposal defense and oral defense, supervising fieldwork and internships and research and competitions and student societies, taking part in department curriculum and degree and accreditation and admissions and program work, undertaking review and consultation and academic organization and public service, and keeping good records and handover of teaching and research and service. United States basis: BLS 2025 wage data median 75,350 USD per year (that source provides only the median and does not provide the 10/25/75/90 percentiles or an hourly basis); the O*NET summary page gives 2024 employment of about 74,900, a 2024—2034 projection of "slower than average (Slower than average, 1% to 2%)" and about 5,600 projected openings for 2024—2034 (total for the projection period); the preparation level is Job Zone Five (SVP 8.0 and above), education feedback is 90% doctoral degrees and 9% master's degrees and 1% bachelor's degrees, the interest code is SI, and there are 25 tasks. Mainland China basis: higher education post appointment and qualification and assessment and training are carried out in accordance with the Higher Education Law of the People's Republic of China and the Regulations on Personnel Management of Public Institutions and the relevant provisions of education administrative departments and institutions, and teaching in a teaching post should obtain a higher education institution teaching qualification in accordance with the Teachers Law of the People's Republic of China and the Regulations on Teacher Qualifications. Public statistics have not established an occupation-level wage basis corresponding to this occupation, and this page preserves the gap faithfully, with the industry average wage serving only as a visible industry proxy.

zh.name: 教育学教师（高等教育）
zh.summary: 教育学教师（高等教育）（美国侧 O*NET-SOC 25-1081.00，Education Teachers, Postsecondary）是高等学校的教学科研岗位：在高等学校从事教育学与教师教育相关课程的教学与研究；工作含按学科方向与培养目标与评价数据确定课程内容与教学与评价目标，准备大纲与作业与讲义与实践材料，授课与组织讨论与研讨与实践，编制与实施与评阅考试并给出反馈，更新课程内容与教学方法，开展教育学研究与文献综述与数据收集与分析，撰写与投稿与修改论文与专著与报告，申报与执行科研项目与经费，参加学术会议与同行评议与学术交流，指导学生选课与学业与研究方法与论文与开题与答辩，指导田野与实习与科研与竞赛与社团，参与院系课程与学位与认证与招生与培养方案工作，承担评审与咨询与学术组织与公共服务，并做好教学与科研与服务的记录与交接。美国口径：BLS 2025 年工资数据中位 75,350 美元/年（该来源仅提供中位数，未提供 10/25/75/90 分位与小时口径）；O*NET 摘要页给出 2024 年就业约 74,900 人、2024—2034 年预测为「低于平均（Slower than average，1% 至 2%）」与 2024—2034 年预计空缺 5,600（预测期合计口径）；准备层级为 Job Zone Five（SVP 8.0 及以上），教育反馈为 90% 博士学位与 9% 硕士学位与 1% 学士学位，兴趣代码 SI，任务 25 项。中国大陆口径：高校岗位聘任与任职资格与考核与培训依《中华人民共和国高等教育法》与《事业单位人事管理条例》与教育行政部门及院校的相关规定执行，在教学岗位从事教学工作应依《中华人民共和国教师法》与《教师资格条例》取得高等学校教师资格。公开统计未建立与本职业对应的职业级工资口径，本页据实保留缺口，行业平均工资只作为可见行业代理。

en.name: Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors
en.summary: Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors (United States side O*NET-SOC 21-1012.00, Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors) is a guidance and counseling post in schools and institutions and agencies: providing students and job seekers with academic and career and further study and employment guidance and counseling and assessment and planning; the work includes assessing students' and clients' abilities and interests and needs and backgrounds, providing individual and group counseling and career planning, explaining assessment results and helping form academic and further study and employment and financial aid and life plans, assisting with course selection and applications and interviews and job search preparation, collaborating with teachers and parents and employers and institutions and agencies, maintaining interview and follow-up and confidentiality and referral records, handling confidentiality and informed consent and exceptions according to ethics, assessing and referring and reporting crises and high-risk situations according to the process, designing and implementing lectures and courses and programs and activities and evaluating their effects, carrying out prevention and advocacy and resource connection, and taking part in supervision and training and professional development. United States basis: BLS 2025 wage data median 64,330 USD per year (30.93 USD per hour; that source provides only the median and does not provide the 10/25/75/90 percentiles); the O*NET summary page gives 2024 employment of about 376,300, a 2024—2034 projection of "average (Average, 3% to 4%)" and about 31,000 projected openings for 2024—2034 (total for the projection period); the preparation level is Job Zone Five (SVP 8.0 and above), the interest code is SCE, and there are 35 tasks; the BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook separately gives growth of 3% and an average of about 27,800 openings per year on the 2025—2035 basis. Mainland China basis: the qualifications and training and supervision for posts related to school mental health education and career guidance follow the relevant provisions of education administrative departments and institutions, and where teaching and education work is involved the corresponding teaching qualification should be obtained in accordance with the Teachers Law of the People's Republic of China and the Regulations on Teacher Qualifications; this occupation is not equivalent to a clinical psychology or medical diagnosis post. Public statistics have not established an occupation-level wage basis corresponding to this occupation, and this page preserves the gap faithfully, with the industry average wage serving only as a visible industry proxy.

zh.name: 教育指导与职业顾问
zh.summary: 教育指导与职业顾问（美国侧 O*NET-SOC 21-1012.00，Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors）是学校与院校与机构的指导与咨询岗位：为学生与求职者提供学业与职业与升学与就业指导与咨询与测评与规划；工作含评估学生与来访者的能力与兴趣与需求与背景，提供个人与团体咨询与生涯规划，解释测评结果并帮助形成学业与升学与就业与资助与生活规划，协助选课与申请与面试与求职准备，与教师与家长与雇主与院校与机构协作，维护约谈与跟进与保密与转介记录，按伦理处理保密与知情同意与例外情形，对危机与高风险情形按流程评估与转介与上报，设计与实施讲座与课程与项目与活动并评估效果，开展预防与倡导与资源对接，并参加督导与培训与专业发展。美国口径：BLS 2025 年工资数据中位 64,330 美元/年（30.93 美元/时，该来源仅提供中位数，未提供 10/25/75/90 分位）；O*NET 摘要页给出 2024 年就业约 376,300 人、2024—2034 年预测为「平均（Average，3% 至 4%）」与 2024—2034 年预计空缺 31,000（预测期合计口径）；准备层级为 Job Zone Five（SVP 8.0 及以上），兴趣代码 SCE，任务 35 项；BLS 职业展望另按 2025—2035 年口径给出增长 3% 与年均空缺约 27,800。中国大陆口径：学校心理健康教育与生涯指导相关岗位的任职资格与培训与督导依教育行政部门与机构的相关规定执行，涉及教育教学工作应依《中华人民共和国教师法》与《教师资格条例》取得相应教师资格；本职业不等于临床心理或医疗诊断岗位。公开统计未建立与本职业对应的职业级工资口径，本页据实保留缺口，行业平均工资只作为可见行业代理。

en.name: Electric Motor, Power Tool, and Related Repairers
en.summary: Receive motors or power tools, match the nameplate, fault report and work order, then document repair, recheck and return status.

zh.name: 电机与电动工具修理工
zh.summary: 接收送修的电机或电动工具，核对铭牌、故障描述和工单，按流程维修、复检并记录交还状态。

en.name: Electrical and Electronic Equipment Assemblers
en.summary: Check parts and revisions against the work order, assemble electrical or electronic equipment, record checks and refer discrepancies to quality or the shift lead.

zh.name: 电气与电子设备装配工
zh.summary: 按工单核对部件和版本，组装电气或电子设备，记录检验结果并把异常交给质检或班组长。

en.name: Electrical and Electronics Drafters
en.summary: Turn confirmed electrical or electronic design inputs into schematics, wiring diagrams and lists. Check terminals, sheet numbers and revisions, and refer conflicts to engineering.

zh.name: 电气与电子制图员
zh.summary: 把确认过的电气或电子设计输入整理为原理图、接线图和清单，核对端子编号、页码和版本，把冲突交给工程人员确认。

en.name: Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technologists and Technicians
en.summary: Check drawing versions and test conditions, record measurements on electrical or electronic equipment and refer discrepancies to engineering staff.

zh.name: 电气与电子工程技师与技术员
zh.summary: 按工程要求检查图纸版本和测试条件，记录电气电子设备的测量结果，并把偏差及复核事项交给工程人员。
