en.name: Electrical and electronics installers and repairers, transportation equipment
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 49-2093.00, install, inspect, test, and repair electrical and electronic systems on transportation equipment (motor vehicles, rail vehicles, ships, aircraft, and more): read circuit diagrams and work orders, measure with instruments to locate faults, replace or adjust components, perform preventive maintenance and keep records, then retest and submit for release confirmation by an authorized role.

zh.name: 运输设备电气电子安装与维修工
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 49-2093.00，安装、检查、测试与维修运输装备（机动车、轨道车辆、船舶、航空器等）的电气与电子系统：读电路图与工单、用仪器测量定位故障、更换或调整部件、执行预防性维护并记录，最后复测并交有权角色确认签放。

en.name: Electrical and electronics repairers, commercial and industrial equipment
en.summary: Check fault records, inspect commercial equipment or industrial controls under a work order, and document repairs, rechecks and return status. Ask which equipment and decisions are within the role.

zh.name: 电气与电子商业与工业设备维修工
zh.summary: 核对故障记录，按工单检查工业控制器或商用设备，记录修复、复检与交还状态。上岗先核设备类型、授权范围及谁确认恢复运行。

en.name: Electrical and electronics repairers, powerhouse, substation, and relay
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 49-2095.00, inspect, test, repair, or maintain electrical equipment in powerhouses, substations, and in-service relays: read controlled drawings and setting sheets, test equipment and circuits with instruments, repair and replace components, check protection settings and record results, then retest and submit for confirmation by an authorized role that equipment may resume operation.

zh.name: 电厂、变电站与继电器电气维修工
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 49-2095.00，在发电站、变电站与在役继电器上检查、试验、检修或维护电气设备：读受控图纸与整定单、用仪器测试设备与回路、检修与更换部件、核对保护定值并记录，最后复测并交有权角色确认设备可恢复运行。

en.name: Electrical engineers
en.summary: Turn system requirements into an electrical design and verification plan. Review equipment choices, test results and changes, and hand over unresolved requirements.

zh.name: 电气工程师
zh.summary: 把系统需求变成电气方案和验证计划，核对设备选型、测试结果及变更记录，交接还未满足的要求。

en.name: Electricians
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 47-2111.00, install, maintain, and repair electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures: follow drawings and codes to install conduit, pull wires, make connections, and secure equipment; de-energize, verify absence of voltage, and test insulation, grounding, and circuits; troubleshoot faults; energize according to procedure and hand over work records.

zh.name: 电工
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 47-2111.00，安装、维护与检修电气布线、设备与器具：按图纸与规范完成布管、穿线、接线与设备固定，执行停电验电与绝缘、接地及回路测试，排查故障，按程序送电并交付作业记录。

en.name: Electromechanical equipment assemblers
en.summary: Check drawings and parts lists, assemble electromechanical units, record identifiers and measurements, and route revision or measurement discrepancies to quality review.

zh.name: 机电设备装配工
zh.summary: 核对图纸和物料单后装配机电部件，记录编号、测量和检验结果，并把版本或尺寸异常交给质检复核。

en.name: Electronic equipment installers and repairers, motor vehicles
en.summary: Following U.S. O*NET-SOC 49-2096.00, install, diagnose, and repair communication, audio, security, and navigation equipment on motor vehicles: check vehicle model configurations, perform disassembly/refitting, routing, wiring, and securing according to manufacturer information, commission and verify functions, and hand over vehicles under procedures while documenting warranty boundaries.

zh.name: 机动车电子设备安装维修工
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 49-2096.00，在机动车上安装、诊断与维修通信、音响、安防与导航设备：核对车型配置，按厂商资料完成拆装、走线、接线与固定，调试并验证功能，按程序交车并记录质保边界。

en.name: Electronics Engineers, Except Computer
en.summary: Turn component, signal and interface requirements into circuit designs. Review schematics, board-level verification and part revisions, and document changes and evidence.

zh.name: 电子工程师（计算机除外）
zh.summary: 把器件、信号和接口需求转成电路方案，核对原理图、板级验证和物料版本，记录设计变更及证据。

en.name: Eligibility Interviewers, Government Programs
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 43-4061.00, determines whether applicants qualify for government assistance under applicable regulations and program rules: accepts applications, interviews and checks materials, verifies income and household situations, calculates benefits, explains the decision basis, and records the handling process.

zh.name: 政府项目资格审核员
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 43-4061.00，依据适用法规与项目规则判定申请人是否符合政府援助资格：受理申请、面谈与资料核对、核实收入与家庭情况、计算补助、解释决定依据并记录处理过程。

en.name: Embalmers
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 39-4011.00, embalms human remains per applicable regulations and health requirements: verifies identity and authorization documents, cleans and disinfects, injects embalming fluid, restores and prepares the appearance, and records the handling process and materials used.

zh.name: 遗体防腐师
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 39-4011.00，依适用法规与卫生要求对遗体进行防腐处理：核实身份与授权文件、清洁与消毒、注射防腐液、修复与整理仪容，并记录处理过程与所用材料。

en.name: Emergency management director
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 11-9161.00, coordinates the emergency management work of a jurisdiction or institution: assesses risk, drafts and updates emergency plans, organizes exercises and training, coordinates resources and agency responses during incidents, and organizes recovery and review afterwards.

zh.name: 应急管理主管
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 11-9161.00，统筹辖区或机构的应急管理工作：评估风险、编制与更新应急预案、组织演练与培训、在突发事件中协调资源与机构响应，并在事后组织恢复与复盘。

en.name: Emergency medicine physicians
en.summary: Emergency medicine physicians assess and care for patients with acute illness or injury, make time-sensitive diagnostic and treatment decisions, and arrange continuing care. This page uses the U.S. O*NET 29-1214.00 occupation; training, licensure and hospital privileges must be checked for the relevant jurisdiction and role.

zh.name: 急诊医学医师
zh.summary: 急诊医学医师评估和救治急性疾病或损伤患者，作出有时效要求的诊疗决定，并安排后续照护。本页以美国O*NET29-1214.00职业为对象，训练、执照及医院岗位权限按相应法域和岗位核验，大陆资格及注册另列。

en.name: Endoscopy Technicians
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 31-9099.02, prepare and maintain endoscopy equipment during endoscopic procedures, assist at the operator's direction, and complete instrument reprocessing and traceability records according to protocol; job training, reprocessing authorization, and infection control requirements must be verified against the original local and institutional texts. (The U.S. wage and employment figures checked are broader-group figures.)

zh.name: 内镜技术员
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 31-9099.02，在内镜诊疗中准备与维护内镜设备、按术者要求配合，并按规程完成器械再处理与追溯记录；岗位训练、再处理授权与感染控制要求须按所在地与机构原文核对。（所核美国工资与就业为更宽组口径。）

en.name: Energy Auditors
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 47-4011.01, define the audit scope and data scope with the client, collect bills and equipment records, perform on-site measurement and verification, establish an energy baseline and calculate itemized energy consumption, estimate energy-saving measures, and produce a reviewable audit report; does not carry out retrofit construction. (The U.S. wage and employment figures checked are broader-group figures.)

zh.name: 能源审计师
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 47-4011.01，与委托方界定审计范围与数据口径，收集账单与设备资料，现场测量与核查，建立能耗基线并核算分项能耗，测算节能措施并形成可复核的审计报告；不实施改造施工。（所核美国工资与就业为更宽组口径。）

en.name: Energy Engineers, Except Wind and Solar
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 17-2199.03, perform load analysis, system modeling and simulation, scheme design, engineering calculations, and energy efficiency estimation for industrial and building energy systems, producing reviewable design descriptions and calculation books; excludes wind and solar specializations. (The U.S. wage and employment figures checked are broader-group figures.)

zh.name: 能源工程师（风电与太阳能除外）
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 17-2199.03，为工业与建筑用能系统做负荷分析、系统建模与仿真、方案设计、工程计算与能效测算，形成可复核的设计说明与计算书；不含风电与太阳能专项。（所核美国工资与就业为更宽组口径。）

en.name: Engine and Other Machine Assemblers
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 51-2031.00, assemble parts and components of engines and other machines into complete machines according to assembly drawings and process requirements, complete alignment, positioning, torque-tightening, test running, and inspection, and record parameters and defects.

zh.name: 发动机和其他机器装配工
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 51-2031.00，按装配图与工艺要求把发动机与其他机器的零件、部件装配成整机，完成对中、定位、按扭矩紧固、试运转与检验，并记录参数与缺陷。

en.name: Engineering Teachers, Postsecondary
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 25-1032.00, design engineering courses and assessments in higher education according to program objectives, teach courses and organize laboratories and practice, guide student learning and projects, assess grades according to standards, and carry out research and academic service.

zh.name: 工程学教师（高等教育）
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 25-1032.00，在高校依据培养目标设计工程学科课程与考核，讲授课程并组织实验与实践，指导学生学习与项目，按标准评定成绩，并开展研究与学术服务。

en.name: English Language and Literature Teachers, Postsecondary
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 25-1123.00, design English language and literature courses and assessments in higher education according to program objectives, teach courses and organize seminars and writing workshops, guide student learning and writing, assess grades according to standards, and carry out research and academic service.

zh.name: 高校英语语言文学教师
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 25-1123.00，在高校依据培养目标设计英语语言与文学课程及考核，讲授课程并组织研讨与写作工作坊，指导学生学习与写作，按标准评定成绩，并开展研究与学术服务。

en.name: Entertainment and Recreation Managers, Except Gambling
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 11-9072.00, plan, direct, and coordinate non-gambling fitness and recreation activities and venue operations, responsible for operating plans and scheduling, event execution, personnel management, safety and licensing compliance, and budgeting and marketing.

zh.name: 娱乐休闲业经理（非博彩）
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 11-9072.00，规划、指导并协调非博彩健身与休闲娱乐活动及场所运营，负责运营计划与排班、活动执行、人员管理、安全与许可合规、预算与营销。

en.name: Environmental Compliance Inspectors
en.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 13-1041.01, conduct on-site inspections and investigations of pollution sources and facilities, take samples and gather evidence according to protocol, determine compliance based on environmental regulations, and produce inspection reports and enforcement documents. (The U.S. wage and employment figures checked are broader-group figures.)

zh.name: 环境合规检查员
zh.summary: 按美国 O*NET-SOC 13-1041.01，对污染源与设施开展现场检查与调查，按规程取样取证，依据环境法规判定是否符合并形成检查报告与执法文书。（所核美国工资与就业为更宽组口径。）

en.name: Environmental Economists
en.summary: Use economic principles and statistical techniques to assess the costs, benefits, and impacts of environmental protection and natural resource use options, and produce reviewable research conclusions and policy recommendations.

zh.name: 环境经济学家
zh.summary: 以经济学原理与统计技术，评估环境保护与自然资源利用方案的成本、效益与影响，并形成可复核的研究结论与政策建议。

en.name: Environmental Engineering Technologists and Technicians
en.summary: Environmental engineering technicians follow procedures for sampling, tests or equipment checks, maintain field and laboratory records and route anomalies to the lead.

zh.name: 环境工程技师与技术员
zh.summary: 环境工程技术员按流程采样、检测或检查设备，核编号并维护现场和实验室记录，把异常交给负责人。

en.name: Environmental Engineers
en.summary: Environmental engineers evaluate pollution controls, review design inputs, document evidence gaps and prepare material for design review.

zh.name: 环境工程师
zh.summary: 环境工程师评估污染控制方案、审查设计输入、记录证据缺口，并为方案审核准备材料。

en.name: Environmental Restoration Planners
en.summary: Collaborate with field and biological staff to develop and supervise the implementation of habitat and ecological restoration projects; collect and analyze environmental data, synthesize complex scientific material into schemes usable for restoration, monitoring, and management, obtain permits, and inspect on-site compliance.

zh.name: 环境修复规划师
zh.summary: 与现场及生物工作人员协作，制定并监督栖息地与生态修复项目的实施；采集与分析环境数据，把复杂的科学资料综合为可用于恢复、监测与管理的方案，并办理许可、检查现场合规。

en.name: Environmental Science and Protection Technicians
en.summary: Under the direction of environmental scientists, engineers, or other professionals, conduct laboratory and field testing to monitor the environment and investigate sources of pollution (including factors affecting health); collect gas, soil, water, and other samples according to procedures, record data, and produce testing reports.

zh.name: 环境科学与保护技术员
zh.summary: 在环境科学家、工程师或其他专业人员指导下，开展实验室与现场检测以监测环境、调查污染来源（含影响健康的因素）；按规程采集气体、土壤、水与其他样品，记录数据并形成检测报告。

en.name: Environmental Science and Protection Technicians, Including Health
en.summary: Under the direction of environmental scientists, engineers, or other professionals, conduct laboratory and field testing related to environmental health: monitor pollution and health hazard factors in air, water, soil, and workplaces, investigate sources of pollution or disease outbreaks, collect samples and record data, and provide traceable testing results to protect public and worker health.

zh.name: 环境科学与保护技术人员，包括健康
zh.summary: 在环境科学家、工程师或其他专业人员指导下，开展与环境健康相关的实验室与现场检测：监测空气、水、土壤与工作场所中的污染与健康危害因素，调查污染或疾病暴发来源，采集样品并记录数据，为保护公众与作业人员健康提供可追溯的检测结果。

en.name: Environmental Scientists and Specialists
en.summary: Conduct research and investigations to identify, reduce, or eliminate pollutants or hazards affecting the environment and public health: collect and analyze air, water, soil, and other sample data, monitor the effects of pollution and land degradation, apply environmental technical standards and permit reviews, and write scientific conclusions into reports and explain them to institutions, businesses, and the public.

zh.name: 环境科学家与专员
zh.summary: 开展研究与调查，识别、减少或消除影响环境与公众健康的污染物或危害源：采集并分析空气、水、土壤等样品数据，监测污染与土地退化影响，执行环境技术标准与许可审查，并把科学结论写成报告并向机构、企业与公众说明。

en.name: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health
en.summary: Conduct research and investigations to identify, reduce, or eliminate pollutants and hazards affecting the environment and population health: collect and analyze air, water, soil, food, and workplace sample data, assess exposure and health-related hazards, apply environmental and public health technical standards and permit reviews, and write the conclusions into reviewable reports.

zh.name: 环境科学家与专家（含健康）
zh.summary: 开展研究与调查，识别、减少或消除影响环境与人群健康的污染物与危害源：采集并分析空气、水、土壤、食品与工作场所样品数据，评估暴露与健康相关危害，执行环境与公共卫生技术标准与许可审查，并把结论写成可复核的报告。

en.name: Epidemiologists
en.summary: Investigate the distribution and causes of disease and injury and design and carry out public health surveillance and research: collect and analyze case, survey, and laboratory data, assess risk factors and transmission routes, communicate conclusions to health practitioners, decision-makers, and the public, and manage public health programs. A master's degree in public health or a related field is usually required.

zh.name: 流行病学家
zh.summary: 调查疾病与伤害的分布与成因，设计并执行公共卫生监测与研究：采集并分析病例、调查与实验室数据，评估风险因素与传播途径，向卫生从业者、决策者与公众沟通结论，并管理公共卫生项目。通常需要公共卫生或相关领域硕士学历。

en.name: Equal Opportunity Representatives and Officers
en.summary: Monitor and evaluate compliance with equal opportunity laws, guidelines, and policies to ensure that employment practices and contracting arrangements do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, or disability: receive and investigate complaints, interview relevant parties, mediate disputes, develop and monitor anti-discrimination guidelines, and provide training and consultation to managers and employees.

zh.name: 平等机会代表与官员
zh.summary: 监督并评估对平等机会法律、准则与政策的遵守情况，确保雇佣实践与合同安排不因种族、宗教、肤色、国籍、性别、年龄或残疾而受到歧视：受理与调查投诉、访谈相关方、调解争议、制定并监督反歧视准则，并向管理者与员工提供培训与咨询。

en.name: Etchers and Engravers
en.summary: Etch or engrave patterns, lettering, and markings on materials such as metal, wood, rubber, glass, and plastic: read drawings and samples, prepare workpieces and etching chemicals, set equipment parameters, use hand and machine tools to complete etching and engraving, and check etch depth, evenness, and appearance quality.

zh.name: 蚀刻工雕刻工
zh.summary: 在金属、木材、橡胶、玻璃、塑料等材料上蚀刻或雕刻图案、文字与标记：阅读图纸与样品、准备工件与蚀刻化学液、设定设备参数、使用手工与机械工具完成蚀刻与雕刻，并检查蚀刻深度、均匀度与外观质量。

en.name: Excavating and Loading Machine and Dragline Operators, Surface Mining
en.summary: Operate or tend machinery equipped with scoops, shovels, or buckets in surface mining sites to strip, excavate, and load loose materials: work according to the excavation plan and elevation markings, inspect and adjust equipment before work, coordinate with haulage and signal personnel, follow safety procedures, and record operations and equipment condition.

zh.name: 机器操作员
zh.summary: 在露天采矿场操作或看管带铲斗、铲子或挖斗的机械，完成剥离、挖掘与装载松散物料：按挖掘计划与标高标记作业，作业前检查与调整设备，与运输和指挥人员配合，遵守安全规程，并记录作业与设备状态。

en.name: Executive Secretaries and Executive Administrative Assistants
en.summary: Provide high-level administrative support to executives: manage and maintain schedules, handle travel, write and organize official documents and reports, handle information requests and receive visitors, and possibly train and guide junior clerical staff; the work mainly uses word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software and scheduling and filing systems as its main tools.

zh.name: 执行秘书与执行行政助理
zh.summary: 为高管提供高阶行政支持：安排与维护日程、办理差旅、撰写与整理公文与报表、处理信息请求与来访接待，并可能培训与指导初级文员；工作以文字处理、表格与演示软件、日程与档案系统为主要工具。

en.name: Exercise Physiologists
en.summary: Assess, design, or implement fitness programs covering cardiorespiratory function, body composition, muscular strength, muscular endurance, and flexibility; explain testing procedures, develop individual exercise programs, monitor and record responses, and may also take on clinical supervision, rehabilitative exercise, and emergency care tasks. Specific medical, licensing, and institutional authority must be verified separately, and the occupation name does not confer individual authorization.

zh.name: 运动生理学家
zh.summary: 评估、设计或实施体适能项目，围绕心肺功能、身体成分、肌力、肌耐力与柔韧性开展工作；解释测试流程、制定个体运动项目、监督并记录反应，也可承担临床监督、康复运动和应急照护等任务。具体医疗、执照与机构权限另核，职业名不授予个人授权。

en.name: Exercise Trainers and Group Fitness Instructors
en.summary: Instruct group or individual exercise primarily for personal fitness, demonstrate, observe, and correct movements, assess needs and design individual programs, provide general nutrition and lifestyle information, maintain equipment, and may also perform first aid, address minor chronic conditions, or lead therapeutic or recreational physical activities. Overlapping tasks do not equal an individual medical license; specific certifications, institutional rules, and jurisdictional authority are checked separately.

zh.name: 健身训练师与团体健身指导
zh.summary: 以个人健身为主要目的指导团体或个人运动，示范、观察并纠正动作，评估需要并设计个体方案，提供营养与生活方式信息、维护器械，也可能急救、处理轻微慢性障碍或带领治疗/体育活动。任务交叉不等于个人医疗许可，具体认证、机构及法域权限另核。

en.name: Extruding and Drawing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
en.summary: Set up, operate, or tend extruding and drawing machines to form thermoplastic or metal materials into tube, rod, hose, wire, or profile shapes; select dies and components to specification, set controls, measure and inspect, change dies, cut and coil, and may handle mixing, inventory, and minor equipment repair. Specific materials, inspection duties, and operating authority are checked by position.

zh.name: 金属挤压拉拔设备操作工
zh.summary: 设定、操作或看护挤压与拉拔设备，把热塑性或金属材料加工成管、棒、软管、线材或型材；按规格选配模具及部件、设置控制、测量检查、换模、裁断卷绕，并可能负责混料、库存和设备小修。具体材料、检验职责及操作权限按岗位核对。

en.name: Extruding and Forming Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Synthetic and Glass Fibers
en.summary: Set up, operate, or tend machines that extrude liquid polymer, rayon, or glass fiber and similar materials into continuous filaments; control equipment and feeding, observe gauges and abnormalities, record faults and job tags, and clean and maintain. Specific processes, inspection duties, and operating authority are checked by position.

zh.name: 合成与玻璃纤维挤压成型设备操作工
zh.summary: 设定、操作或看护设备，将液态聚合物、人造丝或玻璃纤维等材料挤压成型为连续长丝；控制设备和上料、观察仪表与异常、记录故障及作业标签，并清洁维护。具体工艺、检验职责和操作权限按岗位核对。

en.name: Extruding, Forming, Pressing, and Compacting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
en.summary: The US O*NET51-9041.00 covers setting up, operating, or tending machines such as glass forming machines, plodders, and tubers to form products such as glassware, food, rubber, soap, brick and tile, clay, wax, tobacco, or cosmetics. Official tasks include parameter and material control, measuring and weighing, gauge monitoring, handling jams and defective products, and production records; installing parts and disassembly and repair are supplementary items in the task set, and not every position performs all tasks.

zh.name: 挤压、成型、压制与压实设备操作工
zh.summary: 美国O*NET51-9041.00指设定、操作或看护玻璃成型机、plodder和tuber等机器，把玻璃器皿、食品、橡胶、肥皂、砖瓦、黏土、蜡、烟草或化妆品等产品成型。官方任务包括参数与物料控制、测量称重、仪表监视、卡料与不良品处理及生产记录；安装部件和拆修等属任务集合中的补充项，不要求每岗做全部任务。

en.name: Fabric and Apparel Patternmakers
en.summary: Draw and construct precise master patterns and marker layouts from design drawings and specifications, and mark and cut fabric and garments when needed; this includes grading and shrinking across a size range, breaking a design sample into pieceable garment parts, calculating material usage and determining material-efficient layouts, and verifying and correcting patterns through making and fitting sample garments; the work assumes dimensional precision and controllable material use.

zh.name: 织物与服装制版工
zh.summary: 按设计图与规格绘制并制作精确的母版纸样与排版图，必要时标记与裁剪面料与服装；包括按尺码范围做放码与缩码、把设计模型拆解为可排料的衣片、计算用料与确定省料排版，并通过制作与试穿样衣验证并修正纸样；作业以尺寸精确与用料可控为前提。

en.name: Facilities Managers
en.summary: Facilities managers organize work around facilities, equipment, budgets, contracts, materials, and supplier delivery, and continuously verify safety, compliance, quality, exceptions, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 设施经理
zh.summary: 设施经理围绕设施、设备、预算、合同、物资与供应商交付组织工作，持续核对安全、合规、质量、异常和授权边界。

en.name: Fallers
en.summary: Use axes or chainsaws to fell trees, controlling the fall direction per species characteristics and cutting technique and reducing tree damage; this includes judging tree lean and tilt direction, determining the notch position and depth, driving wedges or using jacks to control the fall direction, clearing the work area and escape routes, bucking logs to specification and verifying quality and length, and maintaining chainsaws and related equipment; the work assumes on-site safety and operating procedures.

zh.name: 伐木工
zh.summary: 使用斧具或链锯伐倒树木，依据树种特性与锯切技术控制倒向并减少树木损伤；包括判断树势与倾斜方向、确定切口位置与深度、打楔或使用千斤顶控制倒向、清理作业区与撤离通道、按规格截断原木并核对质量与长度，以及维护链锯与相关器材；作业以现场安全与作业规程为前提。

en.name: Family and Consumer Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary
en.summary: Teach family and consumer sciences courses at colleges and universities, such as child care, family relations, personal and family finance, nutrition and foods, and family management: prepare syllabi and course materials, lecture and lead class discussions, supervise students' laboratory work, practical training, and internships, evaluate assignments and projects, and advise on academic and career development; positions that combine teaching and research also conduct research, publish results, and apply for funded projects.

zh.name: 高校家庭与消费科学教师
zh.summary: 在高校讲授儿童照护、家庭关系、个人与家庭理财、营养与食品、家庭管理等家庭与消费科学课程：准备教学大纲与课程材料，讲授并主持课堂讨论，指导学生的实验、实训与实习，评估作业与项目，指导学业与职业发展；教学与研究并重的岗位还要开展研究、发表成果并申请课题。

en.name: Family Medicine Physicians
en.summary: Provide diagnosis, treatment, and preventive care for individuals and families of all ages: take medical histories and perform physical examinations, order and interpret laboratory tests and imaging, make diagnoses and develop treatment plans, manage chronic and common acute conditions, provide immunization, screening, and healthy lifestyle guidance, refer patients to specialists when needed, and complete medical records, risk communication, and follow-up arrangements.

zh.name: 家庭医学医师
zh.summary: 为各年龄段的个人与家庭提供诊断、治疗与预防保健：采集病史与体格检查，安排与解读检验和影像，作出诊断并制定治疗方案，管理慢性病与常见急性病，提供免疫、筛查与健康生活方式指导，需要时转诊至专科医师，并完成病历记录、风险沟通与随访安排。

en.name: Farm and Home Management Educators
en.summary: Teach and advise individuals and families engaged in agriculture, agriculture-related processes, or home management activities: use demonstrations and field guidance to teach agricultural production topics such as agricultural processes and techniques, pest management, and food safety, or home management topics such as budgeting and financial management, nutrition, and child development; translate research and trial findings into practical methods, and develop and organize extension education programs.

zh.name: 农场与家庭管理教育者
zh.summary: 面向从事农业、农业相关流程或家庭管理活动的个人与家庭开展教学与咨询：以演示和现场指导传授农业流程与技术、病虫害管理、食品安全等农业生产主题，或预算理财、营养与儿童发展等家庭管理主题；把研究与试验成果转化为可操作的做法，并开发与组织推广教育项目。

en.name: Farm Equipment Mechanics and Service Technicians
en.summary: Diagnose, adjust, repair, and overhaul agricultural machinery and vehicles, including tractors, harvesters, milking and feeding equipment, and irrigation systems: determine fault causes and repair plans, disassemble and assemble equipment and replace parts, service hydraulic, drivetrain, and electrical systems, make adjustments and conduct test runs, document repairs and parts used, and explain fault causes and operating precautions to users.

zh.name: 农场设备机械师技术员
zh.summary: 诊断、调整、修理与翻修农业机械与车辆，包括拖拉机、收割机、挤奶与饲喂设备以及灌溉系统：判断故障原因并确定修理方案，拆装与更换零部件，检修液压、传动与电气系统，进行调试与试运行，记录维修内容与所用零件，并向用户说明故障原因与使用注意事项。

en.name: Farm Labor Contractors
en.summary: Recruit and hire seasonal or temporary agricultural workers for farm owners: confirm staffing needs and seasons, recruit and hire workers and verify identity and work eligibility materials; arrange and direct workers to the appropriate worksites and provide tools; pay wages and retain working time and wage records; provide workers with food, drinking water, and field sanitation facilities, and ensure safe and compliant accommodation and transportation when responsible for them; hire crew leaders to manage workers directly on site, and fulfill registration, documentation, and reporting duties under local regulations and contracts.

zh.name: 农场劳务承包商
zh.summary: 为农场主招募并雇用季节性或临时性农业工人：确认用工需求与季节，招募与雇用工人并核实身份与用工资格材料；安排并指挥工人到相应作业地点，提供工具；支付工资并保存工时与工资记录；为工人提供食物、饮用水与田间卫生设施，在承担住宿与运输时保证其安全与合规；聘用领班在现场直接管理工人，并按所在地法规与合同完成注册、记录与报告义务。

en.name: Farmers, Ranchers, and Other Agricultural Managers
en.summary: Plan, direct, or coordinate management and operations of farms, ranches, greenhouses, aquaculture operations, nurseries, timber tracts, or other agricultural establishments: decide crop or livestock varieties and scale, arrange land preparation, sowing, fertilization, irrigation, crop protection, and harvesting; hire, train, and supervise agricultural workers or purchase services under contracts; maintain financial, production, and employment records and file statutory reports; negotiate sales, storage, and transportation with buyers, analyze markets and inputs, and manage business risks from weather, pests and diseases, and price fluctuations.

zh.name: 农场主、牧场主及其他农业经理
zh.summary: 规划、指挥或协调农场、牧场、温室、水产养殖、苗圃、林地或其他农业经营场所的管理与运营：决定种植或养殖的品种与规模，安排整地、播种、施肥、灌溉、植保与收获；雇用、培训并监督农业工人或按合同采购服务；维护财务、生产与用工记录，办理法定报告；与买方谈判销售、储运，并分析市场与投入，控制在天气、病虫害与价格波动下的经营风险。

en.name: Farmworkers and Laborers, Crop, Nursery, and Greenhouse
en.summary: Manually plant, cultivate, and harvest vegetables, fruits, nuts, horticultural specialties, and field crops: use hand tools such as shovels, trowels, hoes, tampers, pruning hooks, shears, and knives to prepare soil, fertilize, transplant, weed, thin, and prune according to plans; identify plants, pests, and weeds and apply pesticides and fertilizers as directed; set up and operate irrigation equipment and adjust greenhouse and seedbed conditions; manually pick fruits and vegetables and wash, grade, sort, pack, and load products; record pesticide use, yields, and costs, report crop progress to farmers or managers, and maintain work areas, fences, and farm facilities.

zh.name: 农作物、苗圃与温室农工
zh.summary: 手工种植、栽培与收获蔬菜、水果、坚果、园艺特优产品与大田作物：使用铁锹、小铲、锄头、夯具、修枝钩、修枝剪与刀具等手工具，按计划整地、施肥、移栽、除草、间苗与修枝；识别植物、害虫与杂草并按指示施用农药与肥料；架设与操作灌溉设备、调节温室与苗床条件；手工采摘水果与蔬菜，并对产品进行清洗、分级、分拣、包装与装载；记录农药使用、产量与成本，向农场主或经理报告作物进展，同时维护作业区、围栏与农场设施。

en.name: Farmworkers, Farm, Ranch, and Aquacultural Animals
en.summary: Care for live animals on farms, ranches, grazing areas, and aquaculture operations, including cattle, sheep, pigs, goats, horses and other equines, poultry, rabbits, fish, shellfish, and bees, as well as animals raised for products such as meat, hides, wool, feathers, eggs, milk, and honey: feed and water animals according to formulas and schedules, herd and rotate grazing, milk, weigh, catch, and load animals; observe animals to detect disease and injury, administer medications, vaccines, or pesticides according to veterinary or label instructions, and assist with births; group animals by weight, age, and body condition, and tag, brand, or paint-mark them; clean and maintain barns, pens, and fences, and check and repair equipment, machinery, and facilities; record growth, feeding, production, and cost information.

zh.name: 农场、牧场与水产养殖农工
zh.summary: 照料农场、牧场、放牧区与水产养殖的活体动物，包括牛、羊、猪、山羊、马等马属动物、家禽、兔、鱼类、贝类与蜜蜂，以及为肉、皮、毛、羽毛、蛋、奶与蜂蜜等产品而饲养的动物：按配方饲喂与供水、赶放与轮牧、挤奶、称重、抓取与装载；观察动物以发现疾病与外伤，按兽医或标签要求施用药物、疫苗或杀虫剂，并协助接产；按体重、年龄与体况分群，为动物打耳标、烙印或喷漆标识；清洁并维护畜舍、圈栏与围栏，检查维修设备、机具与设施；记录生长、饲喂、产量与成本信息。

en.name: Fashion Designers
en.summary: Design clothing, accessories and footwear: study fashion publications, attend fashion shows and visit fabric showrooms to gather trend and fabric information; determine the design direction by target market (age, gender, income and occasion) and draw sketches and style specifications (color, structure, fabric and accessory requirements); select fabrics and production processes and calculate costs; fit sample garments on dress forms or models and revise patterns and details; discuss design plans with sales, management or clients; provide sample garments to agents and sales representatives and arrange sample showings; direct patternmaking, cutting and sample sewing staff; test fabrics to support care labels; price styles and organize collections, or promote them through channels such as buyer stores and mail-order catalogs; and provide custom design for individuals, retailers or film and theater productions and research the required period styles.

zh.name: 时装设计师
zh.summary: 设计服装、配饰与鞋类：研读流行刊物、参加时装秀并走访面料展厅收集趋势与面料信息；按目标市场（年龄、性别、收入与场景）确定设计方向，绘制草图与款式规格（色彩、结构、面料与配饰要求）；选择面料与生产工艺并核算成本；在人台或模特上试穿样衣并修改版型与细节；与销售、管理层或客户讨论设计方案；向代理商与销售代表提供样衣并安排样品展示；指导打版、裁剪与样衣缝制人员；测试面料以支持洗护标签；为款式定价并组织系列产品，或通过买手店与邮购目录等渠道推广；为个人、零售商或影视戏剧制作提供定制设计并研究所需年代款式。

en.name: Fast Food and Counter Workers
en.summary: Take orders, serve food and beverages and collect payment in fast food and counter service settings, and may take part in preparing simple food and drinks: record orders and close out bills using cash register and ordering equipment and verify the cash; take food from the serving counter or holding station according to the order, plate or package it and hand it to the customer; brew coffee and tea, make cold drinks and ice cream drinks, and heat or simply cook foods such as sandwiches, salads, soups and pizza; restock the counter and materials and report shortages; clean the dining area, service counter, tableware and equipment and keep the work area hygienic; handle and store food according to hygiene requirements and monitor food temperature; communicate with customers about orders, comments and complaints, and hand over with colleagues and the shift manager.

zh.name: 食品柜台工人
zh.summary: 在快餐与柜台服务场所接受订单、提供食品与饮料并收款，可能参与制备简单食品与饮料：使用收银与点单设备记录订单与结账并核对收银钱款；按订单从售餐台或保温台取餐、装盘或打包并交付顾客；冲调咖啡与茶、制作冷饮与冰淇淋类饮品、加热或简单烹制三明治、沙拉、汤与披萨等食品；补充餐台与物料并上报缺货；清洁餐区、服务台、餐具与设备并保持操作区卫生；按卫生要求处理与存放食品并监测食品温度；就订单、意见与投诉与顾客沟通，并与同事和值班经理交接。

en.name: Fence Erectors
en.summary: Build and repair fences and fence gates using hand and power tools: lay out the fence line and mark post positions according to drawings or instructions, and confirm there are no cables or water pipes in the work area before digging; dig post holes with shovels, post hole diggers or power augers and set metal or wooden posts vertically and correct plumb with a level and string line; pour concrete at the base of the posts or backfill and tamp them into place; install rails and braces on the posts and saw lumber or cut metal pipe to make rails; stretch wire, wire mesh or chain link fencing and fasten it to the frame; assemble and install fence gates; also build and repair structures such as baffles, retaining walls and trellises; discuss fence needs with clients and estimate and quote; some work involves welding metal parts with portable gas welding equipment, and in special cases rock may be handled by blasting to allow post holes to be dug.

zh.name: 栅栏搭建工
zh.summary: 使用手工与动力工具搭建和维修围栏与围栏门：按图纸或说明测定围栏线路并标出立柱位置，开挖前确认作业区域没有电缆或水管；使用铁锹、挖坑器或动力钻挖柱坑，将金属或木质立柱竖直安放并用水准器与线绳校正垂直度；在立柱底部浇筑混凝土或回填夯实固定；在立柱上安装横杆与支撑件，锯切木料或切割金属管制作横杆；张紧铁丝、铁丝网或链式围栏并固定到框架；组装并安装围栏门；也可搭建与维修挡板、挡土墙、花架等围栏与墙体结构；与客户讨论围栏需求并估算与报价；部分作业涉及使用便携气焊设备焊接金属件，特殊情形下可能用爆破方式处理岩石以便开挖柱坑。

en.name: Fiberglass Laminators and Fabricators
en.summary: Lay up layers of fiberglass and resin on molds to make hulls and decks, golf cart and automobile bodies, and other fiberglass reinforced plastic products: inspect, clean and assemble molds and apply mold release wax and varnish to the mold surface; mix catalyst into resin and saturate fiber cloth and fiber mat with a brush; select and cut fiber mat, fiber cloth and wooden reinforcement materials; lay the saturated fiber layers onto the mold by hand or with a squeegee and use rollers to remove air bubbles and flatten seams; repeatedly apply resin layers to the mold surface until the required thickness is reached; cure the material by leaving it at room temperature, using heat lamps or an oven; trim excess material with hand shears or a trim knife and saw cured parts with a diamond cutting blade; measure with calipers or micrometers and inspect visually and by tapping to check whether the finished part meets specifications and has no bubbles or voids, and repair or modify defective fiberglass parts; mask areas that are not to be laminated and verify that the mold, templates and cutting templates match the drawings or customer specifications.

zh.name: 玻璃纤维层压工制造工
zh.summary: 在模具上逐层铺放玻璃纤维与树脂，制造船体与甲板、高尔夫球车与汽车车身以及其他玻璃钢制品：检查、清洁并组装模具，在模具表面涂布脱模蜡与清漆；把催化剂混入树脂并用刷子浸润纤维布与纤维毡；选择并裁切纤维毡、纤维布与木制加强材料；用手或刮板把浸润的纤维层铺贴到模具上，用滚轮排出气泡并压平接缝；在模具表面重复涂布树脂层直到达到所需厚度；通过室温放置、加热灯或烘箱使材料固化；用手剪或修边刀修剪多余材料，用金刚石切割片锯切固化件；用卡尺或千分尺测量、目视并敲击检查成品是否符合规格与有无气泡、空鼓，修复或改造有缺陷的玻璃钢部件；对不铺层区域做遮蔽，并核对模具、样板与裁切样板是否与图纸或客户规格一致。

en.name: File Clerks
en.summary: File correspondence, cards, invoices, receipts, and other records alphabetically, numerically, or according to the organization's filing system, and locate and retrieve materials on request: scan or read incoming materials to determine their classification and filing location; sort and classify them by content, purpose, user criteria, or chronological, alphabetical, or numerical order; number or code materials and register them in an index; place materials in filing cabinets, file boxes, drawers, or other storage containers; record filing and retrieval activity and generate electronic reports; locate, copy, and deliver information to authorized users on request; collect materials that departments or colleagues need filed; remove outdated or unnecessary materials under filing maintenance rules or legal requirements, destroying them or transferring them to inactive storage; periodically check file placement, legibility, and condition; enter data such as file numbers, updates, or file information codes into the system; answer inquiries about records or files; and improve or implement new filing systems.

zh.name: 档案文员
zh.summary: 按字母或数字顺序、或按机构使用的归档系统，归档信函、卡片、发票、收据与其他记录，并在被请求时查找与取出材料：扫描或阅读来件以判断分类与归档位置，按内容、用途、用户标准或时间、字母、号码顺序进行分拣与分类；给材料编号或打码并登记索引；把材料放入文件柜、文件盒或抽屉等存放容器；记录归档与取出情况并生成电子报表；按请求查找、复制并把信息交付给获得授权的使用者；收集各部门或同事需要归档的材料；按归档维护规则或法律要求清理过时或不再需要的材料，予以销毁或转入非现用存储；定期检查文件的放置、清晰度与状况；把数据如文件编号、更新信息或文件信息码录入系统；答复关于记录或文件的询问，并改进或实施新的归档系统。

en.name: Film and Video Editors
en.summary: Edit moving images on film, video, or other media, possibly working with producers or directors to organize footage for final production and possibly editing or synchronizing soundtracks: organize and assemble raw footage into a complete work according to scripts or director and producer requirements; review all materials to become familiar with their content before assembling them; select and combine the most effective shots in each scene into a coherent narrative; trim segments to specified lengths and reassemble them for the best effect; switch camera angles at specific points within scenes for smooth, seamless edits; insert and sequence music, dialogue, and sound effects and correct errors; mark starting and ending frames of shots or sounds and use editing, titling, switching, and digital effects equipment to complete the production; check key numbers and timecodes; collaborate with audio, visual, music, optical, or special effects departments on sound, picture, and graphics processing; review assembled productions on monitors to determine whether corrections are needed; study scripts, attend screenings, and discuss editing direction with producers or directors.

zh.name: 电影视频编辑
zh.summary: 在胶片、视频或其他介质上剪辑运动影像，可能与制片人或导演合作组织画面以完成最终制作，并可能剪辑或同步声轨：按剧本或导演、制片人的要求把原始素材整理并串联成完整作品；通读全部素材以熟悉内容后再行组装；挑选并组合每个场景中最有效的镜头以形成连贯叙事；按指定长度修剪片段并重新组合以获得最佳效果；在场景的特定位置切换镜头角度使剪辑流畅无缝；把音乐、对白与音效插入并排列成序列、修正错误；标记镜头或声音的起止帧并使用编辑、字幕、切换与数字特效设备完成成片；核对关键编号与时间码；与音频、视觉、音乐、光学或特效部门协作完成声画与图形处理；在监视器上审看已组装成片并判断是否需要修正；研究剧本、参加放映并就剪辑方向与制片人或导演讨论。

en.name: Financial and Investment Analysts
en.summary: Use quantitative methods to analyze investment programs or financial and operating data from public and private institutions, including business valuation: collect and check corporate disclosures, accounting data, and market data; build valuation or forecasting models for business questions and record key assumptions; conduct scenario and sensitivity tests and explain how sensitive conclusions are to assumptions; assess industry and market trends, competition, and major risks; write analytical conclusions, valuation reports, or investment recommendations for investment committees and clients; perform independent review under compliance requirements, maintain model versions, and retain supporting evidence; coordinate with investment managers, risk and compliance, accounting, and research staff; and follow local laws and institutional procedures.

zh.name: 金融与投资分析师
zh.summary: 用定量方法分析投资计划或公私机构的财务与经营数据，包括企业估值：收集并核对公司披露、会计与市场数据；按业务问题建立估值或预测模型并记录关键假设；做情景与敏感性测试，说明结论对假设的敏感程度；评估行业与市场趋势、竞争格局与主要风险；把结果写成分析结论、估值报告或投资建议供投资委员会与客户决策；按合规要求独立复核、维护模型版本并留存依据；与投资经理、风险与合规、会计与研究岗位对接，按所在地法规与公司制度执行。

en.name: Financial Examiners
en.summary: Inspect and supervise financial and securities institutions and financial and real estate transactions under laws and regulations: obtain balance sheets, operating income and expenditure, and loan materials to check assets and liabilities; examine internal controls involving cash reserves, collateral, and institution-owned securities; review internal and external audit reports and board and shareholder meeting records to confirm authority; recommend action on solvency, compliance, and problem accounts; prepare examination reports, issue lists, and corrective recommendations and track implementation; participate under statutory procedures in reviewing licenses, mergers, and securities registrations and make recommendations; and communicate with institutional management, external accountants, lawyers, and fellow regulators to obtain evidence.

zh.name: 金融审查员
zh.summary: 依据法律法规对金融机构、证券机构以及金融与房地产交易实施检查与监督：调阅资产负债表、经营收支与贷款资料，核对资产与负债；核查现金储备、担保物与机构自有证券等内控环节；复核内外部审计报告与董事会、股东会记录以确认授权范围；就偿付能力、合规与问题账户提出处理意见；撰写检查报告、问题清单与整改建议并跟踪落实；按法定程序参与牌照、并购与证券登记事项的审查并给出建议；与机构管理层、外部会计师、律师及同业监管人员沟通取证。

en.name: Financial Managers
en.summary: Oversee accounting, investment, banking, insurance, securities, and other financial activities at a branch, office, or department: develop and implement financial plans and budgets; prepare and review financial and regulatory reports; manage cash flows and financial instruments; arrange credit, credit facilities, and investments; establish custody and internal-control procedures for assets, records, collateral, and securities; evaluate financial reporting systems, accounting, and collection processes and recommend improvements; recruit, train, and assess staff; communicate with shareholders and investors and support financing; make approval and authorization decisions within regulatory and internal-control frameworks and take responsibility for the results.

zh.name: 财务经理
zh.summary: 统筹分支机构、办事处或部门的会计、投资、银行、保险、证券等财务活动：制定并执行财务计划与预算，编制与审阅财务报表和监管报表；管理资金流与金融工具，安排信贷、授信与投资；建立资产、记录、担保物与证券的保管与内控程序；评估财务报告系统、会计与收款流程并提出改进；招募、培训并考核下属，向股东与投资者沟通并支持融资；在法规与内控框架内作出审批与授权决定，并对结果负责。

en.name: Fine Artists, Including Painters, Sculptors, and Illustrators
en.summary: Create original artworks using varied media and techniques: work with materials such as pens, ink, watercolors, oils, clay, stone, wood, and metal, as well as software and graphics tablets; combine visual elements including line, space, mass, color, and perspective to express ideas, emotions, or atmosphere; discuss artwork nature and content with clients, editors, authors, and art directors; maintain portfolios demonstrating style and ability; promote work through catalogs, email, and personal websites and submit to exhibitions and galleries; keep learning techniques, following art-world developments, and researching topics; frame, mat, and install works, collaborating with engineers or technicians on large or installation works when needed; and potentially accept illustration, portrait, mural, sculpture, and custom commissions and teach art techniques to children or adults.

zh.name: 美术家（画家、雕塑家与插画师）
zh.summary: 使用多种媒介与技术创作原创艺术作品：结合钢笔、墨水、水彩、油画颜料、黏土、石材、木材与金属等材料，以及计算机软件与数位板等工具进行创作；整合线条、空间、体块、色彩与透视等视觉元素表达想法、情绪或氛围；与客户、编辑、作者与艺术指导就作品性质与内容沟通；维护作品集以展示风格与能力；通过画册、邮件与个人网站推广作品并向展览与画廊投稿；持续学习技法、关注艺术界动态与研究特定主题；为作品装框、加衬垫并布展，必要时与工程师或技师合作完成大型或装置类作品；也可承接插图、肖像、壁画、雕塑与定制创作项目，并向儿童或成人教授艺术技法。

en.name: Fire Inspectors and Investigators
en.summary: Inspect buildings to detect fire hazards and enforce local ordinances and state laws, or investigate and gather facts to determine the cause of fires and explosions: includes conducting premises inspections and hazard determinations under fire codes, testing and acceptance-testing fire protection and detection systems, checking premises where hazardous materials are stored or used and issuing permits, examining fire and explosion scenes and collecting physical evidence for laboratory submission, writing inspection and investigation conclusion reports, and carrying out public fire education and evacuation drills.

zh.name: 消防检查员调查员
zh.summary: 检查建筑物以发现火灾隐患并执行地方法规与州法律，或调查并收集事实以判定火灾与爆炸的原因：包括按消防规范实施场所检查与隐患认定、检验与验收测试消防保护与探测系统、核查危险物品存放与使用场所并签发许可、勘查起火与爆炸现场并收集与送检物证、撰写检查与调查结论报告，以及开展公众消防教育与逃生演练。

en.name: Fire-Prevention and Protection Engineers
en.summary: Research the causes of fires, determine fire prevention methods, and design or recommend materials and equipment such as structural components and fire detection devices to help organizations protect lives and property from fire, explosion, and related hazards: includes reviewing building drawings and verifying fire code compliance, designing fire detection and alarm systems and suppression devices, evaluating fire protection conditions such as water supply and evacuation exits, testing fire protection components and fire systems, preparing fire protection plans and technical reports, participating in revisions of codes and standards, and providing fire technical consulting and training to building design and construction personnel.

zh.name: 消防与防护工程师
zh.summary: 研究火灾成因，确定防火方法，并设计或推荐结构构件、火灾探测设备等材料与设备，帮助组织在火灾、爆炸及相关危害中保护生命与财产：包括审核建筑图纸并核对消防规范符合性、设计火灾探测与报警系统及灭火装置、评估水供应与疏散出口等防火条件、对防火构件与消防系统开展测试、编制防火方案与技术报告、参与规范与标准修订，并向建筑设计与施工人员提供消防技术咨询与培训。

en.name: Firefighters
en.summary: Control and extinguish fires and respond to emergency situations that threaten life, property, or the environment: includes driving and operating fire apparatus and equipment, wearing protective equipment such as fire-resistant clothing and breathing apparatus, connecting high-pressure hose lines and operating pumps and nozzles to extinguish fires, forcing open doors, windows, and roofs to create ventilation and entry, using ladders to reach upper floors or rescue trapped people, searching for and rescuing trapped people, providing emergency medical treatment such as first aid and CPR, handling hazardous materials that may ignite or leak, protecting property from water and smoke damage, and participating in drills, training, fire inspections, and public fire prevention education.

zh.name: 消防员
zh.summary: 扑救并控制火灾，并应对危及生命、财产或环境的紧急情况：包括驾驶与操作消防车辆和装备、穿戴防火服与呼吸器等防护装备、连接高压水带并操作水泵与喷嘴灭火、破拆门窗与屋顶开辟通风和进入通道、使用云梯进入高层或营救被困人员、搜寻并救出被困者、实施急救与心肺复苏等紧急医疗处置、处置可能起火泄漏的危化品、保护财产免受水渍与烟熏损失，以及参与演练、培训、消防检查与公众防火教育。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Construction Trades and Extraction Workers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the work of construction or extraction workers: includes checking construction progress and quality against drawings and specifications, supervising work safety and personal protection, arranging crew assignments and trade sequencing, estimating materials and labor hours and requisitioning materials and equipment, coordinating the work sequence among different trades and subcontractors, organizing training and mentoring, and recording progress and deviations and reporting to superiors.

zh.name: 建筑施工与采掘业工人一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调建筑或采掘作业人员的工作：包括按图纸与规范检查施工进度与质量、监督作业安全与个人防护、安排班组分工与工序衔接、估算材料与工时并申购材料与设备、协调不同工种与分包商之间的作业顺序、组织培训与带教，以及记录进度与偏差并向上级报告。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Correctional Officers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the work of correctional officers and jailers: includes organizing roll calls and counts as required, maintaining order and discipline in housing units, arranging shifts and post assignments, supervising and taking part in searches and contraband seizures, organizing response and handling in emergencies such as escapes and violence, reviewing inmate information and identifying those requiring focused attention, supervising the completion and retention of records and reports, and training and mentoring subordinates and evaluating their performance.

zh.name: 一线主管官
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调惩教人员与狱警的工作：包括按规定组织点名与清点、维持监区秩序与纪律、安排班次与岗位分工、监督并参与搜查与违禁品查获、在逃脱与暴力等紧急情形下组织响应与处置、审查在押人员信息并识别需重点关注的对象、监督记录与报表的填写与保存，以及培训带教下属并评估其表现。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Entertainment and Recreation Workers, Except Gambling Services
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the work of entertainment and recreation service workers: includes arranging shifts and position assignments, training employees and explaining work processes according to company rules, patrolling facilities and equipment to verify cleanliness and maintenance standards, organizing sports, aquatic, game, and performance activities, handling customer complaints and improving service, requisitioning equipment and supplies, evaluating employee performance and taking disciplinary action, and recording personnel and operating data and writing activity reports.

zh.name: 娱乐与休闲业工人一线主管（博彩除外）
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调娱乐与休闲服务人员的工作：包括安排班次与岗位分工、培训员工并按公司制度说明作业流程、巡视场地与设备以核对清洁与维护标准、组织运动与水上与游戏与表演等活动、处理顾客投诉并改进服务、申购器材与物资、评估员工表现并作出纪律处理，以及记录人员与运营数据并撰写活动报告。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Farming, Fishing, and Forestry Workers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the work of agricultural, forestry, aquaculture, and related workers: includes assigning work and scheduling shifts, arranging planting and harvesting or breeding and harvesting according to work plans, teaching operating methods and safety procedures to workers, patrolling fields, forest land, and aquaculture facilities to judge working conditions and progress, supervising compliance with safety procedures and correcting violations, requisitioning feed, chemicals, and equipment and supplies, recording output and personnel and equipment conditions, and assisting with equipment adjustment and repair.

zh.name: 农林渔业工人一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调农业、林业、水产养殖及相关作业人员的工作：包括派工与排班、按作业计划安排播种与采收或养殖与采伐、向作业人员传授操作方法与安全规程、巡视田间与林地与养殖设施以判断作业条件与进度、监督安全规程执行并纠正违规、申购饲料与药剂与器械等物资、记录产量与人员与设备情况，以及协助设备调整与维修。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Firefighting and Prevention Workers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate personnel engaged in firefighting, fire prevention, and fire control: assign firefighters to critical positions and clarify responsibilities; direct firefighting and rescue operations and communicate fire conditions to superiors, subordinates, and dispatch; assess fire size, building conditions, and water supplies to determine the resources to deploy; conduct training in firefighting, rescue, fire prevention, hazardous materials response, and emergency medical care; inspect and maintain firefighting equipment and protective gear; inspect stations and equipment for compliance with safety standards; inspect and test fire protection systems and detection equipment; direct investigations into arson and false alarms and submit reports; prepare and review budgets and monitor firefighting expenditures; arrange duty schedules and work priorities; and help develop fire safety guidelines and evacuation plans for nonresidential buildings.

zh.name: 消防与预防工人一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调从事灭火、防火及火灾控制工作的人员：包括把消防员分配到关键位置并明确分工、指挥灭火与救援行动并向上下级与调度中心通报火情、评估火势规模与建筑与水供应状况以决定出动力量、开展灭火与救援与防火与危险品处置与医疗急救等训练、检查与保养灭火装备与防护装具、巡视消防站与装备以确认符合安全标准、检查与测试消防系统与探测设备、指导纵火与虚假报警案件调查并提交报告、编制与审核预算并监督灭火开支、安排值班排班与工作优先次序，以及参与制定非住宅建筑的消防安全指南与疏散方案。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Food Preparation and Serving Workers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate workers engaged in food preparation and service: assign tasks, responsibilities, and workstations according to operational needs; specify food portions, serving sequences, and workstation and equipment layouts; train employees in food preparation, sanitation, and safety procedures; inspect supplies, equipment, and work areas for efficient service and compliance with standards; observe and assess employees and workflows to ensure quality and issue disciplinary records to employees; analyze operational problems such as theft and waste and establish improvement procedures; control inventories of food, equipment, tableware, and beverages and report shortages to designated personnel; forecast personnel, equipment, and supply needs from master menus; total and verify cash receipts at shift end; record production, operational, and personnel data; handle hiring, scheduling, and working-hours matters; establish departmental goals, budgets, and policies; and participate in food preparation and service as needed.

zh.name: 食品制备与餐饮服务人员一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调从事食品制作与服务的工作人员：包括按工作需求把任务、职责与工作岗位分配给员工、规定食品份量与出菜顺序以及工位与设备布置、培训员工掌握食品制作与卫生与安全规程、巡视供应品与设备与作业区域以确认服务效率与符合标准、观察并评估员工与作业流程以保证质量并向员工提出纪律记录、分析偷窃与浪费等运营问题并建立改进程序、控制食品与设备与餐具与酒水库存并向指定人员报告短缺、按主菜单预测人员与设备与供应品需求、在班次结束时汇总并核对现金收入、记录生产与运营与人事数据、办理招聘与排班与工时等人事事务、制定部门目标与预算与政策，并在需要时参与食品制作与服务。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Gambling Services Workers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate workers in designated gambling areas: circulate among tables and machines, observe operations, and ensure all stations and games are staffed each shift; supervise gambling operations under internal rules and jurisdictional regulations and ensure prompt, courteous service; observe gamblers for signs of cheating such as marked cards, card switching, or card counting and notify security; process and verify financial transaction paperwork; respond to and resolve complaints; verify and pay jackpots, reset slot machines after payouts, make minor repairs or adjustments, or recommend servicing; maintain knowledge of games and cheating methods; explain game rules, betting limits, and other internal rules; set and maintain game bankrolls and table limits; record machine fault details and follow up repairs; attend to patrons showing possible compulsive gambling and assist when necessary; oversee complimentary vouchers, rooms, discounts, and other benefits; enforce safety rules and report or remove hazards and underage, intoxicated, disruptive, or cheating patrons; assess employees and write performance evaluations; monitor stations and games and reassign dealers to ensure staffing; determine daily table openings and schedule accordingly; review operating expenses, budget estimates, betting accounts, and collection reports; set policies on gambling types, odds, and credit; interview and hire employees; and train, supervise, schedule, and evaluate staff.

zh.name: 博彩服务工人一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调指定博彩区域内工作人员的活动：包括在牌桌与机台之间巡视、观察运营情况，确保每个班次各工位与游戏都有人负责；按内部规则与所在法域监管要求监督博彩运营，并确保员工提供及时与礼貌的服务；观察赌客行为以识别标记牌、换牌或算牌等作弊迹象并通报安保人员；处理与核实金钱交易相关文书；回应并解决顾客投诉；核实并支付累积奖金，在派彩后重置老虎机并对机台进行小型维修或调整，或建议将机台送修；维护对场馆内游戏以及作弊手法的了解；解释与说明游戏规则与投注上限等内部规则；设置并维护各游戏的资金与牌桌限额；记录故障机台的细节并跟进维修；关注可能存在强迫性赌博迹象的顾客并在必要时提供协助；监督赠券与赠房与折扣等回馈的发放；执行安全规则并上报或清除安全隐患与未成年与醉酒与滋事或作弊的客人；评估员工表现并撰写绩效评价；监控工位与游戏并调配荷官以保证人手充足；确定每日开设多少牌桌并据此排班；审核运营开支与预算估算与投注账目与收款报告；制定所提供博彩类型与赔率与授信的政策；面试并聘用员工；培训与监督与排班与评估员工。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Helpers, Laborers, and Material Movers, Hand
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate helpers, laborers, or hand material movers: monitor safety procedures and equipment to maintain safe working environments; work with employees and managers to resolve operational problems; review work during operations and after completion for compliance with requirements; notify designated employees or departments of loading status and problems; inspect equipment for wear and specification compliance; prepare and maintain records and reports of hours, wages, daily receipts, and inspection results; communicate and explain work orders to laborers; schedule and assign work to maintain staffing amid workload fluctuations; review qualifications, interview applicants, and recommend hires; estimate material, time, and staffing needs from orders, specifications, and experience; coach employees on work and personal development; assess training needs and arrange or provide training; hold pre-shift and safety meetings; check loaded or unloaded materials against work order specifications; perform or assist with the same work as subordinates or more skilled and difficult tasks; address personnel issues, complaints, and grievances where possible and refer them upward when necessary; recommend or initiate promotions, transfers, and discipline; assess employees and write performance evaluations; inspect freight to determine loading sequences; schedule shipments and transport methods; inventory supplies and requisition or purchase replacements; quote prices to customers; assist account checks, track, monitor or forecast departmental budgets, and help develop policies and procedures; and inspect work sites to determine maintenance or repair needs.

zh.name: 帮工、劳工与手工物料搬运工一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调帮工、劳工或手工物料搬运工的活动：包括监控安全程序与设备以维护安全的工作环境；与员工和管理者协作解决作业问题；在作业过程与完工后复核以确认按要求完成；向指定员工或部门通报装载情况与遇到的问题；检查设备的磨损与是否符合规格；编制与维护工时与工资与日收与检查结果等工作记录与报告；向劳工传达并解释工单；制定排班并派工以维持足够人手应对工作量波动；参与招聘流程如审阅资历与面试并提出录用建议；根据工单与规格与经验估算材料与工时与人手需求；对员工进行工作与个人发展方面的辅导；评估培训需求并安排或提供培训；召开班前会与安全会传达信息；核对装载或卸载物料是否符合工单规格；承担与被监督人员相同或更高技能与更难的作业或协助其完成；在可能范围内处理人事问题与投诉与申诉，必要时移交上级；建议或发起晋升与调岗与纪律等人事事项；评估员工表现并撰写绩效评价；检查货运以确定装载顺序；安排发运时间与运输方式；盘点物资并申购或采购补充物资；向客户报价；协助核对账目与跟踪监控或预测部门预算并参与制定制度与流程；检查作业现场以确定所需维护或修理范围。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Housekeeping and Janitorial Workers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate cleaners in hotels, hospitals, offices, and other premises: inspect completed work against specifications and established standards; personally perform or assist cleaning when needed; prepare staff schedules; establish and implement departmental operating standards and procedures; assess facilities' physical conditions to determine required work; inventory and issue supplies and equipment and forecast staffing and stock needs for scheduling and ordering; inspect and maintain equipment for availability; maintain hours, budget, payroll, and other required records; direct activities to interrupt infection transmission in hospitals and similar settings; recommend or arrange additional services such as painting, repairs, renovation, and furniture and equipment replacement; coordinate departments for efficient, timely service; investigate service and equipment complaints and take corrective action; instruct employees in policies, procedures, and equipment use and maintenance; select and order or purchase equipment, supplies, or furniture; prepare activity, personnel, and information reports covering occupancy, hours, facility use, completed work, and departmental spending; discuss performance, personnel issues, and policies with employees; assess performance and recommend promotions, transfers, and dismissals; recommend service and efficiency improvements; estimate costs and prepare and manage budgets; screen applicants and hire staff; perform grounds maintenance such as snow removal and mowing; select cleaning materials for different linens, furniture, floors, and surfaces; notify management, front desks, or admissions staff of available rooms; and oversee in-house laundry, maintenance and repairs, dry-cleaning, or valet services.

zh.name: 家政保洁工人一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调酒店、医院、办公室及其他场所清洁人员的工作：包括检查已完成的工作以确认符合规格与既定标准；在必要时亲自完成或协助清洁工作；制定并准备员工排班；为其管辖部门建立并实施作业标准与流程；检查并评估设施的实际状况以确定所需工作类型；盘点库存并发放物资与设备，预测不同时段所需的人员与库存水平以便有效排班与订货；检查并维护设备以确保其可用；维护工时、预算与工资单及其他所要求的记录；指导医院等场所内阻断感染传播的相关活动；建议或安排粉刷、维修、翻新与家具设备更换等额外服务；与其他部门协调以确保服务高效及时；调查关于服务与设备的投诉并采取纠正措施；就工作政策与流程以及设备的使用与维护对员工进行指导；选择并订购或采购新设备、物资或家具；准备活动、人员与信息类报告，如入住率、工时、设施使用、已完工作与部门支出；与员工沟通解决绩效与人事问题并讨论单位政策；评估员工绩效并就晋升、调岗与解雇等人事事项提出建议；建议可改进服务并提高运营效率的变更；承担估算成本以及编制与管理预算等财务工作；筛选求职者并聘用新员工；承担除雪与割草等场地维护工作；针对不同布草、家具、地面与表面选择最合适的清洁材料；向管理人员、前台或入院登记人员通报可入住的房间；监督洗衣、维护与修理、干洗或代客服务等内部服务。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Landscaping, Lawn Service, and Groundskeeping Workers
en.summary: Schedule grounds maintenance crews, check site quality and safety, and coordinate quotes, tools and supplies. Common settings include parks, properties and sports grounds.

zh.name: 园林绿化工人一线主管
zh.summary: 安排绿化养护班组、复查现场质量和安全，跟进报价、工具与物资。常见工作场地包括公园、物业和运动场。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Material-Moving Machine and Vehicle Operators
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of material-moving machine and vehicle operators and helpers. Tasks include enforcing safety rules and procedures; explaining transportation or tariff regulations, waybills, safety rules, or organizational policies and procedures to employees; resolving employee problems or working with employees to help resolve them; communicating with customers, supervisors, contractors or others to exchange information or resolve problems; planning work assignments and equipment allocations to meet transportation, operations or production goals; inspecting, measuring or weighing goods or materials to determine specific handling requirements; explaining and demonstrating tasks to new employees or assigning training tasks to experienced employees; reviewing orders, production schedules, drawings or shipping and receiving notices to determine work sequences and the dates, types, quantities and destinations of material shipments; driving vehicles or operating machinery and equipment to complete tasks or assist employees; inspecting or testing materials, inventory, vehicles, equipment or facilities to ensure safety, freedom from defects and conformity to specifications; maintaining or checking records of work hours, materials, expenses or crew activities; requisitioning personnel, supplies, equipment, spare parts or repair services; recommending and implementing measures to improve employee motivation, equipment performance, work methods or customer service; preparing, compiling and submitting reports on work activities, operations, production or occupational injuries; dispatching personnel and vehicles in response to emergency reports received by telephone or radio; supervising on-site operations to ensure proper work practices and material use; recommending or implementing personnel actions such as selection, evaluation, rewards or discipline; performing or arranging repairs or preventive maintenance for vehicles and other equipment; calculating or estimating cash, payroll, transportation, personnel or storage requirements; assisting employees with tasks such as loading vehicles; directing personnel engaged in transportation or related services, such as pumping, moving, storing or handling materials; and developing and establishing work schedules.

zh.name: 物料搬运主管操作员
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调物料搬运机械与车辆操作员与帮工的活动：包括执行安全规则与规程；向员工解释运输或运价规定、运单、安全规定或单位政策与流程；解决员工问题或与员工协作协助解决问题；与客户、主管、承包商或其他人员沟通以交换信息或解决问题；为满足运输、作业或生产目标制定工作任务与设备分配计划；检查、测量或称重货物或物料以确定具体装卸要求；向新员工讲解与示范工作任务或为有经验的员工安排培训任务；审阅订单、生产进度、图纸或收发货通知以确定作业顺序与物料发运日期与类型与数量与目的地；驾驶车辆或操作机械与设备完成工作任务或协助员工；检查或测试物料、库存、车辆、设备或设施以确保其安全、无缺陷且符合规格；维护或核对工时、物料、支出或班组活动记录；申请所需人员、物资、设备、零配件或维修服务；建议并实施提高员工积极性、设备性能、作业方法或客户服务的措施；编制与汇总并提交作业活动、运营、生产或工伤事故报告；根据电话或无线电台的紧急报告派遣人员与车辆；监督现场作业以确保作业规范与物料使用合理；建议或实施员工选拔、评估、奖励或纪律处分等人事措施；完成或安排车辆与其他设备的维修或预防性维护；计算或估算现金、薪酬、运输、人员或仓储需求；协助员工完成装车等任务；指导从事运输或相关服务的人员开展工作，如泵送、移动、储存或装卸物料；制定并确立排班。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Mechanics, Installers, and Repairers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of mechanics, installers and repairers; may also advise customers on recommended services (excluding team or work leaders). Tasks include inspecting, testing and measuring completed work using hand tools, measuring instruments or similar devices to verify compliance with standards or repair requirements; inspecting and supervising work areas, inspecting tools and equipment, and providing employee safety training to prevent, detect and correct unsafe conditions or violations of procedures and safety rules; interpreting specifications, drawings or work orders, making templates and marking reference points for employees; monitoring employee workloads and reviewing performance; performing skilled repair or maintenance using hand or power tools, hydraulic presses, shears or welding equipment; calculating estimated and actual costs for materials, labor, outside contractors and other factors; monitoring tool and spare-parts inventories and workshop conditions and maintenance to ensure suitable working conditions; requisitioning materials and supplies such as tools, equipment and replacement parts; communicating with management, engineering, quality control, customers, union representatives or others to coordinate work, resolve employee grievances or identify and review resource needs; determining schedules, sequences and assignments by work priorities, equipment quantities and employee skills; inspecting objects, systems or facilities and analyzing information to determine installation, servicing or repair needs; advising employees on work-related problems and helping correct skill deficiencies; recommending or initiating personnel actions such as hiring, promotion, transfer, dismissal or discipline; investigating accidents or injuries and preparing findings reports; conducting or arranging employee training in safety, repair or maintenance techniques, operating procedures or equipment use; developing, implementing or evaluating maintenance policies and procedures; meeting vendors or suppliers to discuss products used in repairs; participating in budget preparation and administration, coordinating purchasing and documentation, and monitoring departmental expenditures; reviewing, evaluating and accepting contractor bids and coordinating completion of the work; compiling operations and personnel records such as work-hour and production records, inventory data, repair or maintenance statistics and test results; developing or implementing electronic maintenance programs or computerized information management systems; and designing equipment configurations to meet personnel needs.

zh.name: 机械安装与维修一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调机械师、安装工与修理工的活动；也可就建议的服务向客户提供咨询（不含班组或作业组长）：包括使用手工工具或量具等器具检查、测试与测量已完成的工作以核实是否符合标准或修理要求；检查与监督作业区域并检查工具与设备，并对员工开展安全培训以预防、发现与纠正不安全状况或违反程序与安全规则的行为；解读规格、图纸或工单，为员工制作样板并标出参考基准点；监督员工的工作量并复核工作表现；使用手工或电动工具、液压机或剪床或焊接设备等完成技能性修理或维护作业；计算材料、人工或外部承包商等因素的估算与实际成本；监控工具与零配件库存以及车间状况与维护以确保作业条件适当；申请工具与设备与替换零件等材料与物资；与管理人员、工程、质量控制、客户或工会代表等人员沟通以协调作业活动、解决员工申诉或识别与复核资源需求；根据作业优先级、设备数量与人员技能确定排班、顺序与任务分配；检查物件与系统或设施并分析信息以确定所需的安装、服务或修理；就与工作有关的问题向员工提供咨询并协助其改正技能不足；建议或发起招聘、晋升、调岗、解雇或纪律处分等人事措施；调查事故或伤害并编写调查结果报告；开展或安排安全、修理或维护技术、作业程序或设备使用方面的员工培训；制定、实施或评估维护政策与程序；与供应商或供货方会面讨论修理工作所用产品；参与预算编制与执行，协调采购与文档并监控部门支出；审阅、评估、接受并协调承包商工作投标的完成；汇总工时与生产记录、库存数据、修理或维护统计或测试结果等作业与人事记录；开发或实施电子维护程序或计算机信息管理系统；按人员需要设计设备配置。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Non-Retail Sales Workers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of sales workers other than retail sales workers; may perform budgeting, accounting and personnel duties in addition to supervision. Tasks include monitoring sales staff performance to ensure goals are met; assisting employees with difficult or complex duties; directing and supervising employees engaged in sales, inventory counts, checking cash receipts or providing specific services; listening to and resolving customer complaints about services, products or personnel; keeping purchasing, sales and requisition records; recruiting, training and evaluating personnel; communicating with company management to develop methods and procedures to increase sales, expand markets and promote business; preparing work schedules and assigning specific duties; attending company meetings to exchange product information and coordinate with other departments; visiting retailers and sales representatives to promote products and gather information; establishing merchandise pricing policies based on profitability requirements; preparing sales and inventory reports for management and budget departments; inspecting products purchased for resale or received for storage to determine condition; inspecting merchandise to ensure correct pricing and display and performance as advertised; analyzing sales territory details to assess growth potential and set quotas; counting inventory and replenishing stock at specified levels; coordinating promotions such as merchandise displays and advertising copy; and preparing leasing or rental agreements specifying charges and payment procedures for machinery, tools or other items.

zh.name: 非零售销售工人一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调零售销售以外销售人员的活动；除监督职责外，还可能承担预算、会计与人事等工作：包括监控销售人员绩效以确保达成目标；在员工执行困难或复杂职责时提供协助；指导与监督从事销售、盘点、核对现金收入或提供特定服务的员工；倾听并解决客户关于服务与产品或人员的投诉；保存与采购、销售和申购有关的记录；招聘、培训与评估人员；与公司管理人员沟通以制定提高销售、扩大市场与促进业务的方法与流程；制定并准备工作排班并把员工分配到具体职责；参加公司会议以交流产品信息并与其他部门协调工作；拜访零售商与销售代表以推广产品并收集信息；根据盈利要求制定商品定价政策；为管理层与预算部门编制销售与库存报告；检查为转售采购或为存储收到的产品以确定产品状况；检查商品以确保定价与陈列正确且功能与宣传相符；分析销售区域细节以评估其增长潜力并设定配额；盘点库存并在库存降至指定水平时补货；协调促销活动，如准备商品陈列与广告文案；编制租赁或租借协议，明确机械与工具或其他物品使用费用与付款程序。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Office and Administrative Support Workers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the work activities of clerical and administrative support personnel: supervise the work of office, administrative, or customer service employees to ensure compliance with quality standards, deadlines, and procedures and correct them when errors or problems arise; resolve customer complaints or answer customers' questions about policies and procedures; provide guidance to employees on handling difficult or complex problems or on defusing escalated complaints and disputes; review records or reports concerning production, payroll, shipping, and the like to verify details, monitor work activities, or evaluate performance; discuss performance problems with employees to identify causes and resolve them; prepare and issue work schedules, deadlines, and task assignments for office or administrative staff; recruit, interview, and select employees; explain and communicate work procedures and company policies to staff; evaluate employee performance and compliance and recommend corresponding personnel actions; train or instruct employees in job duties and company policies or arrange training; research, compile, and prepare reports, manuals, correspondence, or other materials as required by management or government agencies; implement company or departmental policies, procedures, and service standards together with management personnel; compute figures such as balances, totals, and commissions; coordinate activities with other supervisors or with other work units or departments; participate in the work of subordinates to improve efficiency or overcome difficult links in the work; advise management on issues such as staffing or procedural changes; develop or update procedures, policies, or standards; maintain records such as inventory, personnel, orders, supplies, and equipment maintenance; consult with managers or other personnel to resolve problems such as equipment performance, output quality, and work scheduling; develop work schedules based on budgets and workloads; analyze the financial activities of the establishment or department and provide input for budget preparation and preparation; design, implement, or evaluate employee training and development programs, customer service initiatives, or performance measurement standards; understand the terms of labor agreements and their impact on departmental operations; coordinate or perform activities related to transportation, receiving, distribution, or shipping; monitor inventory levels and requisition or purchase supplies as needed; plan or coordinate office services such as the procurement or organization of equipment or supplies, asset disposal, relocation, parking, maintenance, or security services; arrange necessary maintenance or repair work; and plan the layout of stockrooms, warehouses, or other storage areas after considering factors such as turnover, size, and weight.

zh.name: 行政办公支持一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调文书及行政支持人员的工作活动：监督办公室、行政或客户服务员工的工作以确保符合质量标准、截止期限与规程并在出错或出问题时纠正；解决客户投诉或解答客户关于政策与程序的疑问；就处理困难或复杂问题或化解升级的投诉与争议向员工提供指导；审阅生产与薪酬与运输等有关记录或报告以核实细节、监控工作活动或评估绩效；与员工讨论绩效问题以找出原因并解决；为办公室或行政人员编制并发布工作排班、截止期限与任务分派；招聘、面试与选拔员工；向员工解释并传达工作程序与公司政策；评估员工绩效与合规情况并建议相应人事处理；培训或指导员工的工作职责与公司政策或安排培训；按管理层或政府机构要求研究、汇总并编制报告、手册、函件或其他资料；与管理人员共同实施公司或部门政策、程序与服务标准；计算余额与合计与佣金等数字；与其他主管人员或其他工作单元或部门协调活动；参与下属的工作以提高效率或克服工作中的困难环节；就人员配置或程序变更等问题向管理层提出建议；制定或更新程序、政策或标准；维护库存与人员与订单与供应与设备维护等记录；与经理或其他人员协商解决设备性能与产出质量与工作排班等问题；根据预算与工作量制定工作排班；分析机构或部门的财务活动并为预算编制与准备提供输入；设计、实施或评估员工培训与发展计划、客户服务举措或绩效衡量标准；了解劳资协议条款及其对部门运作的影响；协调或执行与运输、收货、配送或运输有关的活动；监控库存水平并按需申购或采购供应品；规划或协调办公服务，如设备或供应品的采购或组织、资产处置、搬迁、停车、维护或安保服务；安排必要的维护或维修工作；在考虑周转率与尺寸与重量等因素的前提下规划库房与仓库或其他储存区域的布局。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Passenger Attendants
en.summary: Supervise and coordinate the activities of passenger attendants: enforce safety rules and regulations; resolve customer complaints about employee performance or the services provided; inspect materials and inventory and vehicles and equipment and facilities to ensure they are safe, defect-free, and meet specifications; train employees in operating procedures and functions and explain company policies; compute or estimate cash and compensation and transportation or staffing needs; inspect work areas or operating equipment to ensure they meet established standards for cleanliness or maintenance; recommend and implement measures to improve employee motivation and work methods or customer service; meet with managers or other supervisors to learn about changes affecting operations; explain the interests or special needs of specific groups to employees; observe and evaluate employee appearance and performance to ensure service quality and compliance with specifications; explain and demonstrate work tasks to new employees or assign training tasks to experienced employees; take disciplinary measures to address performance problems; analyze and record personnel or operations data and write reports on activities; confer with customers and supervisors and contractors or other personnel to exchange information or resolve problems; apply customer feedback to service improvement; participate in continuing education to keep up with industry trends and developments; request necessary supplies and equipment or services; direct or coordinate the activities of employees, such as flight or train crew members; and recruit and hire employees.

zh.name: 乘客服务员一线主管
zh.summary: 监督并协调乘客服务员的活动：执行安全规则与规程；解决客户关于员工表现或所提供服务的投诉；检查物料与库存与车辆与设备与设施以确保安全、无缺陷且符合规格；培训员工掌握操作规程与职能并解释公司政策；计算或估算现金与薪酬与运输或人员需求；检查工作区域或运行设备以确保在清洁或维护等方面符合既定标准；建议并实施提高员工积极性与工作方法或客户服务的措施；与经理或其他主管会面以了解影响运营的变化；向员工说明特定群体的利益或特殊需要；观察并评估员工的仪容与表现以确保服务质量并符合规格；向新员工解释并示范工作任务或向有经验的员工分配培训任务；为处理绩效问题采取纪律措施；分析与记录人员或运营数据并撰写有关活动报告；与客户与主管与承包商或其他人员商谈以交换信息或解决问题；将客户反馈应用于服务改进；参加继续教育以了解行业趋势与发展；申请必要的供应品与设备或服务；指导或协调员工的活动，如空中或车厢乘务人员；招聘与雇用员工。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Personal Service Workers
en.summary: Supervise and coordinate the activities of personal service workers: train employees in operating procedures and functions and explain company policies; meet with managers or other supervisors to learn about changes affecting operations; assign work schedules according to work needs to ensure the quality and timely delivery of services; recruit and hire employees; resolve customer complaints about employee performance or the services provided; take disciplinary measures to address performance problems; inspect work areas or operating equipment to ensure they meet established standards for cleanliness or maintenance; investigate employee complaints and resolve problems according to management rules and regulations; observe and evaluate employee appearance and performance to ensure service quality and compliance with specifications; direct or coordinate the activities of employees, such as hotel staff or hairstylists; participate in continuing education to keep up with industry trends and developments; inform management about issues such as employee disputes; schedule employee breaks to ensure adequate staffing of service personnel for each shift; apply customer feedback to service improvement; explain the interests or special needs of specific groups to employees; request necessary supplies and equipment or services; and direct marketing and advertising or other customer recruitment efforts.

zh.name: 个人服务工人一线主管
zh.summary: 监督并协调个人服务工人的活动：培训员工掌握操作规程与职能并解释公司政策；与经理或其他主管会面以了解影响运营的变化；按工作需求分配工作排班以确保服务的质量与及时交付；招聘与雇用员工；解决客户关于员工表现或所提供服务的投诉；为处理绩效问题采取纪律措施；检查工作区域或运行设备以确保在清洁或维护等方面符合既定标准；调查员工投诉并依管理规则与规定解决问题；观察并评估员工的仪容与表现以确保服务质量并符合规格；指导或协调员工的活动，如酒店员工或发型师；参加继续教育以了解行业趋势与发展；就员工争议等问题向管理层通报；安排员工休息以确保每个班次的服务人员配备充足；将客户反馈应用于服务改进；向员工说明特定群体的利益或特殊需要；申请必要的供应品与设备或服务；指导营销与广告或其他客户招募工作。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Police and Detectives
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of members of a police force: supervise and coordinate the investigation of criminal cases, provide guidance and professional opinions to investigators, and ensure that procedures are conducted in accordance with laws and regulations; prepare work schedules and assign tasks to subordinates; direct the collection, preparation, and handling of evidence and the personal property of persons in custody; investigate and resolve personnel problems within the organization and allegations of misconduct by employees; explain police operations to subordinates to assist them in performing their duties; maintain logs, prepare reports, and direct the preparation, processing, and maintenance of departmental records; inform personnel about changes in regulations and policies, the impact of new or revised laws, and new techniques in police work; train employees in proper police procedures; impose disciplinary action on employees who violate departmental rules; monitor and evaluate the work performance of subordinates and approve promotions and transfers; review the content of written orders to ensure compliance with legal requirements; conduct spot checks and order the detention of witnesses and suspects for questioning; cooperate with court personnel and officials of other law enforcement agencies as necessary and testify in court; meet with citizens and educational and community groups to conduct community programs and activities and discuss law enforcement issues; inspect facilities and supplies and vehicles and equipment to ensure compliance with standards; direct the release or transfer of persons in custody; requisition and issue equipment and supplies; develop, implement, and revise departmental policies and procedures; prepare press releases and reply to police correspondence; prepare budgets and manage departmental expenditures; and read and review subordinates' reports to ensure they meet legal standards and contain no errors.

zh.name: 警察与侦探一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调警察部队成员的活动：监督并协调刑事案件的侦查，向侦查人员提供指导与专业意见，并确保程序依法律与法规进行；编制工作排班并向下属分配任务；指导证据与在押人员个人财物的收集、准备与处理；调查并解决组织内的人员问题与对员工的失当行为指控；向下属说明警务运作以协助其履行职责；维护日志、编制报告并指导部门记录的准备、处理与维护；向人员通报法规与政策的变化、新订或修订法律的影响以及警务工作的新技术；按正当警务程序培训员工；对违反部门规章的员工给予纪律处分；监控并评估下属的工作绩效并批准晋升与调任；审阅书面命令内容以确保符合法律要求；实施突击检查并下令拘留证人与嫌疑人以接受询问；必要时与法院人员及其他执法机构官员合作并在法庭作证；与公民与教育及社区团体开会以开展社区项目与活动并讨论执法议题；检查设施与物资与车辆与设备以确保符合标准；指导在押人员的释放或移交；申请并发放设备与物资；制定、实施并修订部门政策与程序；编制新闻稿并回复警务函件；编制预算并管理部门经费支出；阅读并审阅下属报告以确保符合法律标准且没有错误。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Production and Operating Workers
en.summary: Directly supervise and coordinate the work of production and operating personnel, such as inspectors, precision workers, machine setters and operators, assemblers, fabricators, and plant and system operators (excluding team or work leaders): enforce safety and sanitation regulations; keep records of employee attendance and hours worked; inspect materials and products or equipment to detect defects or malfunctions; read and analyze charts and work orders and production schedules and other records and reports to determine production requirements and to evaluate current production estimates and outputs; develop and establish work schedules and task assignments and production sequences to meet production goals; confer with other supervisors to coordinate operations and activities within or between departments; explain specifications and drawings and work orders and company policies and procedures to workers; observe work and monitor indicators such as gauges and dials to ensure that operators conform to production or processing standards; direct and coordinate the activities of employees engaged in the production or processing of goods, such as inspectors and machine setters and fabricators; conduct employee training in equipment operations or work and safety procedures or assign training to experienced employees; evaluate employee performance; confer with management or subordinates to resolve worker problems and complaints and grievances; determine standards and budgets and production goals and quotas according to company policies and equipment and staffing availability and workload; compute labor and equipment requirements and production specifications using standard formulas; recommend or implement measures to motivate employees and to improve production methods or equipment performance or product quality or efficiency; maintain operations data such as hours worked and production and cost and prepare management reports of production results; requisition materials and supplies and equipment parts or repair services; set up and adjust machines and equipment; recommend or execute personnel actions such as hiring and evaluation and promotion; and plan and develop new products and production processes.

zh.name: 生产运营工人一线主管
zh.summary: 直接监督并协调生产与操作人员的工作，如检验员、精密工人、机器调试与操作员、装配工、制作工以及工厂和系统操作员（不含团队负责人或作业组长）：执行安全与卫生规范；保存员工出勤与工时记录；检查物料与产品或设备以发现缺陷或故障；阅读并分析图表与工单与生产排程与其他记录与报告以确定生产需求并评估当期产量估算与产出；制定并确立工作排班与任务分配与生产顺序以达成生产目标；与其他主管商谈以协调部门内或部门间的运营与活动；向工人解释规格与图纸与工单与公司政策与程序；观察作业并监控仪表与刻度等指标以确保操作员符合生产或加工标准；指导并协调从事货物生产或加工的员工（如检验员与机器调试员与制作工）的活动；开展设备操作或作业与安全程序的员工培训或将培训分配给有经验的员工；评估员工绩效；与管理层或下属商谈以解决工人问题与投诉与申诉；依公司政策与设备与人力可用性与工作量确定标准与预算与生产目标与定额；使用标准公式计算人工与设备需求与生产规格；建议或实施激励员工与改进生产方法或设备性能或产品质量或效率的措施；维护工时与产量与成本等运营数据并编制生产结果的管理报告；申购材料与用品与设备零件或维修服务；设置并调整机器与设备；建议或执行招聘与评估与晋升等人事处理；规划并开发新产品与生产流程。

en.name: First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers
