They arrange meals and routines, organize games and outings, help with homework, support habit formation and safety, and regularly communicate and hand over records to parents. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and U.S. statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 保姆
zh.summary: 保姆（O*NET 39-9011.01）在私人家庭中照护儿童，支持家长满足儿童的身体、情感、智力与社会需要：安排膳食与作息、组织游戏与外出、辅导作业、协助习惯养成与安全防护，并与家长定期沟通与交接记录。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nanosystems engineers
en.summary: Nanosystems engineers (O*NET 17-2199.09) design, develop, or supervise the production of materials, devices, and systems with unique molecular or macromolecular composition, applying nanoscale physics and electrical, chemical, or biological engineering principles; the work centers on design planning, synthesis and characterization, testing and validation, documentation and review, and coordination with suppliers and technicians. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupation scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and United States statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 纳米系统工程师
zh.summary: 纳米系统工程师（O*NET 17-2199.09）设计、开发或监督具有独特分子或大分子组成的材料、器件与系统的生产，应用纳米尺度物理以及电气、化学或生物工程原理；工作围绕设计规划、合成与表征、测试验证、文档与评审、供应商与技术员协调展开。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nanotechnology engineering technologists and technicians
en.summary: Nanotechnology engineering technologists and technicians (O*NET 17-3026.01) implement production processes under the supervision of nanotechnology engineering staff, operating commercial-scale equipment to produce and test nanoscale materials and devices, and use advanced microscopy equipment to manipulate nanoscale objects. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupation scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and United States statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 纳米技术工程技师与技术人员
zh.summary: 纳米技术工程技师与技术人员（O*NET 17-3026.01）在纳米工程人员监督下实施生产流程、操作商业规模设备生产与测试纳米尺度材料与器件、并用先进显微设备操作纳米级对象。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Natural sciences managers
en.summary: Natural sciences managers (O*NET 11-9121.00) plan, direct, or coordinate activities and research and development work in fields such as life sciences, physical sciences, mathematics, and statistics: setting objectives and budgets, organizing research projects, and managing personnel and compliance requirements. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupation scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and United States statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 自然科学领域经理
zh.summary: 自然科学领域经理（O*NET 11-9121.00）规划、指导或协调生命科学、物理科学、数学、统计学等领域的活动及其研发工作：制定目标与预算、组织研究项目、管理人员与合规要求。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Naturopathic physicians
en.summary: Naturopathic physicians (O*NET 29-1299.01) diagnose, treat, and help prevent disease using a practice system based on the individual's natural healing ability: collecting history and medication information, examining and assessing within the license and institutional authorization scope, explaining evidence and options, recording plans and monitoring responses, and referring when red flags or out-of-scope problems appear. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupation scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and United States statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 自然疗法医师
zh.summary: 自然疗法医师（O*NET 29-1299.01）使用基于个体自然恢复能力的实践体系诊断、治疗并帮助预防疾病：采集病史与用药信息、在执照与机构授权范围内检查与评估、解释证据与选择、记录计划并监测反应，并在出现红旗或范围外问题时转诊。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Network and computer systems administrators
en.summary: Network and computer systems administrators (O*NET 15-1244.00) install, configure, and maintain an organization's local area networks, wide area networks, data communication networks, operating systems, and physical and virtual servers, monitor the integrity and availability of systems and scheduled tasks (including backups), analyze network and server resource usage and control user access, and may also assist with network modeling, analysis, and planning coordination. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupation scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and United States statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 网络与计算机系统管理员
zh.summary: 网络与计算机系统管理员（O*NET 15-1244.00）安装、配置并维护组织的局域网、广域网、数据通信网络、操作系统与物理／虚拟服务器，监控系统与计划任务（含备份）的完整性和可用性，分析网络与服务器资源占用并控制用户访问，还可能协助网络建模、分析与规划协调。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Neurodiagnostic technologists
en.summary: Neurodiagnostic technologists (O*NET-SOC 29-2099.01) perform neuroelectrodiagnostic (END) examinations such as EEG, evoked potentials, polysomnography, and electronystagmography, and may conduct nerve conduction studies: collecting history and examination information, measuring and placing electrodes, recording and monitoring the patient, identifying artifacts, and organizing technical data and submitting a summary report to the physician. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupation scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and United States statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 神经诊断技师
zh.summary: 神经诊断技师（O*NET-SOC 29-2099.01）执行脑电图、诱发电位、多导睡眠图与眼震电图等神经电诊断（END）检查，可能实施神经传导研究：采集病史与检查信息、测量并安放电极、记录与监测患者、识别伪迹、整理技术数据并向医师提交汇总报告。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Neurologists
en.summary: Neurologists (O*NET-SOC 29-1217.00) diagnose, manage, and treat diseases and disorders of the brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nerves non-surgically: collecting history and family history, completing neurological examinations, ordering and interpreting laboratory and neuroimaging studies, making a differential diagnosis, developing and adjusting treatment plans, monitoring medication adverse effects, determining brain death, arranging supportive care and referrals, and communicating and recording with the multidisciplinary team. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupation scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and United States statistical scopes, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 神经科医师
zh.summary: 神经科医师（O*NET-SOC 29-1217.00）以非手术方式诊断、管理并治疗脑、脊髓与周围神经的疾病与病症：采集病史与家族史、完成神经系统检查、开具并解读实验室与神经影像检查、作出鉴别诊断、制定并调整治疗方案、监测药物不良反应、判定脑死亡、安排支持性照护与转诊，并与多学科团队沟通和记录。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Neuropsychologists
en.summary: Neuropsychologists integrate history, interviews, standardized tests, and behavior observations to explain cognitive and behavioral findings to referral teams. Clinical assessment and report sign-off depend on licensure, training, and facility authorization.

zh.name: 神经心理学家
zh.summary: 神经心理学家整合病史、访谈、标准化测验和行为观察，向转诊团队解释认知与行为表现。临床评估与签发报告依执照、训练和机构授权。

en.name: New accounts clerks
en.summary: New accounts clerks (O*NET-SOC 43-4141.00) handle account-opening stages at banks and other depository financial institutions: interviewing customers, verifying identity documents and materials, explaining account and service terms, entering account information into systems and filing records, handling counter payments, transfers and error correction as needed, and escalating abnormalities in customer identity or transactions under institutional procedures. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and US statistical definitions, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 新账户文员
zh.summary: 新账户文员（O*NET-SOC 43-4141.00）在银行及其他存款类金融机构负责开户环节：面谈客户、核验身份证件与资料、说明账户与服务条款、把账户信息录入系统并归档，同时按需承担柜面收付、转账与错误更正，并在客户身份或交易出现异常时按机构流程升级。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nondestructive testing specialists
en.summary: Nondestructive testing specialists (O*NET-SOC 17-3029.01) inspect structures and equipment for defects without damaging the inspected object. They select, calibrate and operate ultrasonic, radiographic, magnetic particle, penetrant, eddy current and acoustic emission testing equipment according to standards and procedures, interpret signals and images, evaluate results against codes, document methods and processes and prepare inspection reports, while meeting radiation and on-site work safety requirements. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and US statistical definitions, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 无损检测专员
zh.summary: 无损检测专员（O*NET-SOC 17-3029.01）在不破坏被检对象的前提下检查结构与设备缺陷：按标准与程序选择、校准并操作超声、射线、磁粉、渗透、涡流、声发射等检测设备，判读检测信号与图像，依据规范评估结果、记录方法与过程并编写检测报告，同时承担辐射与现场作业安全要求。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nuclear engineers
en.summary: Nuclear engineers (O*NET-SOC 17-2161.00) apply nuclear science and engineering principles to research, design and operations involving nuclear energy and waste: designing reactor cores, radiation shielding, and instrumentation and control equipment; monitoring nuclear facility operations and identifying designs and operations that violate safety regulations or endanger safety; initiating corrective actions or ordering reactor shutdown in emergencies; writing operating procedures and technical reports; participating in environmental compliance, waste disposal and decommissioning plans; and communicating with regulators, suppliers and review committees. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and US statistical definitions, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 核工程师
zh.summary: 核工程师（O*NET-SOC 17-2161.00）把核科学与工程原理用于核能与核废料相关问题的研究、设计与运行：设计反应堆堆芯、辐射屏蔽与仪控设备，监控核设施运行并识别违反安全法规或危及安全的设计与操作，在紧急情况下启动纠正措施或下令停堆，编写操作规程与技术报告，参与环境合规、废物处置与退役计划，并与监管机构、供应商和审查委员会沟通。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nuclear medicine technologists
en.summary: Nuclear medicine technologists (O*NET-SOC 29-2033.00) prepare, administer and measure radioisotopes under physician direction for diagnosis, treatment and tracer research: preparing radiopharmaceuticals and calculating and recording doses under requirements, operating gamma cameras, PET and other imaging equipment, processing quantitative study data such as cardiac function, explaining procedures and safety precautions to patients, performing equipment quality control, and storing drugs and disposing of radioactive waste under radiation safety procedures. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and US statistical definitions, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 核医学技师
zh.summary: 核医学技师（O*NET-SOC 29-2033.00）在医师指导下准备、施用并测量放射性同位素，用于诊断、治疗与示踪研究：制备放射性药物并按规定计算、记录剂量，操作伽马相机与 PET 等设备成像，处理心脏功能等定量研究数据，向患者解释程序与安全注意事项，执行设备质量控制，并按辐射安全程序储存药物、处置放射性废物。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nuclear monitoring technicians
en.summary: Nuclear monitoring technicians (O*NET-SOC 19-4051.02) collect and test samples to monitor nuclear experiment results and radioactive contamination of personnel, facilities and the environment: using detectors and instruments to determine radiation intensity and type in work areas, equipment or materials; monitoring personnel exposure and area radiation levels; calculating safe exposure times from site contamination readings and prescribed safety levels; collecting and analyzing air, water, gas or solid samples; installing and testing area radiation alarm equipment; providing initial response to alarms or abnormal events; guiding radiation safety procedures and protective equipment use; preparing contamination testing and decontamination reports and radiation work permits; and disposing of radioactive waste under procedures. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, preparation requirements, Chinese and US statistical definitions, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 核监测技术员
zh.summary: 核监测技术员（O*NET-SOC 19-4051.02）采集并检测样本，用于监测核实验结果以及人员、设施和环境的放射性污染：使用探测器与仪器测定工作区、设备或材料中辐射的强度与类型，监测人员受照量与区域辐射水平，按厂区污染读数与规定安全水平计算安全受照时间，采集并分析空气、水、气体或固体样本，安装与测试区域辐射异常报警设备，在报警或异常事件中先期响应，指导人员执行辐射安全程序与防护装备使用，编写污染检测、去污报告与放射工作许可，并按程序处置放射性废物。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、准备要求、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Power operators
en.summary: Power operators (O*NET-SOC 51-8011.00, Nuclear Power Reactor Operators) operate or control nuclear reactors from nuclear power plant main control rooms: moving control rods and regulating reactivity and power under standard procedures, monitoring coolant temperature and flow, and starting and stopping equipment; monitoring plant-wide operating parameters, recording operating data and performing periodic tests; determining causes of abnormalities and recommending or taking corrective action; implementing lockout, tagging and isolation to support maintenance; responding to accident conditions under emergency operating procedures; and participating in authorization and supervision of nuclear fuel handling, radiation monitoring and sampling. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, Chinese and US qualification and authorization boundaries, and wage and employment statistical definitions.

zh.name: 电力操作员
zh.summary: 电力操作员（O*NET-SOC 51-8011.00，Nuclear Power Reactor Operators）在核动力厂主控室操作或控制核反应堆：按标准程序移动控制棒、调节反应性与功率水平，监控冷却剂温度与流量，启动和停止设备；监视全厂系统运行参数、记录运行数据并执行定期试验；出现异常时判断原因、提出或执行纠正措施；实施锁定、挂牌与隔离等安全措施以支持检修，按应急运行程序处置事故工况，并参与核燃料操作、辐射与取样监测的授权与监督。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、中美资格与授权边界，以及工资与就业统计口径。

en.name: Nuclear Technicians
en.summary: Nuclear Technicians (O*NET-SOC 19-4051.00, Nuclear Technicians) assist nuclear physicists, nuclear engineers, or other scientists in laboratory, power generation, and electricity production activities: operating, testing, and maintaining nuclear equipment according to nuclear equipment operating policies and radiation worker procedures, performing surveillance tests to judge equipment safety status, monitoring reactor equipment performance and identifying inefficiencies, hazards, or maintenance needs, tagging equipment awaiting repair and implementing isolation, using detectors or other instruments to measure the intensity and type of radiation in work areas, equipment, or materials, calculating operating factors such as exposure time, dose, and gamma intensity using standard formulas, collecting and testing air, water, gas, or solid samples, performing decontamination, and setting up area radiation anomaly alarm devices. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupational scope, tasks, Chinese and U.S. statistical scope, and authorization boundaries.

zh.name: 核技术员
zh.summary: 核技术员（O*NET-SOC 19-4051.00，Nuclear Technicians）协助核物理学家、核工程师或其他科学家开展实验室、发电与电力生产活动：按核设备操作政策和辐射工作人员程序操作、测试与维护核设备，执行监视试验判断设备安全状态，监控反应堆设备性能并识别低效、隐患或检修需要，为待修设备挂牌并落实隔离，使用探测器或其他仪器测量工作区、设备或材料中辐射的强度与类型，按标准公式计算受照时间、剂量与伽马强度等运行因数，采集并检测空气、水、气体或固体样本，执行去污并设置区域辐射异常报警装置。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、中美统计口径与授权边界。

en.name: Nurse Anesthetists
en.summary: Nurse Anesthetists (O*NET-SOC 29-1151.00, Nurse Anesthetists) administer anesthesia, monitor patient vital signs, and supervise patients recovering from anesthesia, and may assist anesthesiologists, surgeons, other physicians, or dentists; this occupation in the United States requires a registered nurse with graduate professional education. The work includes pre-anesthesia screening and medical history assessment, developing an anesthesia nursing plan, obtaining informed consent, selecting and administering anesthesia and adjunct medications, performing regional anesthesia, managing the airway and mechanical ventilation, calibrating and testing anesthesia equipment, continuously monitoring vital signs with invasive and non-invasive techniques, handling peri-anesthesia emergencies, inserting peripheral or central venous and arterial catheters, evaluating post-anesthesia response and deciding on post-anesthesia care discharge, and teaching nursing staff and residents. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupational scope, tasks, China-U.S. admission differences, and statistical scope.

zh.name: 麻醉护士
zh.summary: 麻醉护士（O*NET-SOC 29-1151.00，Nurse Anesthetists）实施麻醉、监测患者生命体征并监护患者从麻醉中恢复，可协助麻醉医师、外科医师、其他医师或牙医；该职业在美国要求为接受过研究生专业教育的注册护士。工作内容包括麻醉前筛查与病史评估、制定麻醉护理计划、获取知情同意、选择与给予麻醉及辅助药物、实施区域麻醉、管理气道与机械通气、校准与测试麻醉设备、用侵入性与非侵入性技术持续监测生命体征、处置围麻醉期紧急情况、置入外周或中心静脉与动脉导管、评估麻醉后反应并决定麻醉后护理出院，并对护理人员与住院医师开展教学。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、中美准入差异与统计口径。

en.name: Nurse Midwives
en.summary: Nurse Midwives (O*NET-SOC 29-1161.00, Nurse Midwives) diagnose and coordinate all aspects of the birth process independently or within a medical team, and may provide gynecological care for healthy women; this occupation in the United States requires professional graduate nursing education. The work includes providing antenatal, intrapartum, postpartum, and newborn care, monitoring fetal development by listening to fetal heart tones, external uterine measurement, identifying fetal position, and estimating fetal size, recording health history and physical examination findings, performing vital sign, reflex, breast, and pelvic examinations, prescribing medications within the scope permitted by state regulations, ordering and interpreting diagnostic or laboratory tests, providing family planning services and individualized health management plans, initiating emergency interventions to stabilize patients, consulting or referring to specialists when the condition exceeds the scope of practice, educating patients, families, staff, and the community, and instructing student midwives and medical students. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupational scope, tasks, China-U.S. admission differences, and statistical scope.

zh.name: 护士助产士
zh.summary: 护士助产士（O*NET-SOC 29-1161.00，Nurse Midwives）独立或在医疗团队中诊断并协调分娩过程的各个方面，并可提供健康女性的妇科护理；该职业在美国要求接受专业的研究生护理教育。工作内容包括提供产前、产中、产后与新生儿护理，通过听胎心、外部子宫测量、识别胎位与估算胎儿大小监测胎儿发育，记录健康史与体格检查结果，执行生命体征、反射、乳房与盆腔检查，在州法规允许范围内开具药物，开具并解读诊断或实验室检查，提供计划生育服务与个性化健康管理计划，启动紧急干预以稳定患者，在病情超出执业范围时咨询或转诊专科人员，并对患者、家属、员工与社区开展教育以及指导实习助产士与医学生。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、中美准入差异与统计口径。

en.name: Nurse Practitioners
en.summary: Nurse Practitioners (O*NET-SOC 29-1171.00, Nurse Practitioners) diagnose and treat acute, episodic, or chronic illness independently or as a member of a healthcare team, with a focus on health promotion and disease prevention; they may order, perform, or interpret diagnostic tests such as laboratory work and imaging and may prescribe medications. This occupation in the United States requires a registered nurse with professional graduate education. This page uses only official sources to explain the occupational scope, tasks, China-U.S. admission differences, and statistical scope.

zh.name: 执业护士
zh.summary: 执业护士（O*NET-SOC 29-1171.00，Nurse Practitioners）独立或作为医疗团队的一员诊断并治疗急性、偶发性或慢性疾病，侧重健康促进与疾病预防；可开具、执行或解读实验室与影像等诊断检查，并可开具药物。该职业在美国须为接受专业研究生教育的注册护士。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、中美准入差异与统计口径。

en.name: Nursing assistants
en.summary: Nursing assistants (O*NET-SOC 31-1131.00, Nursing Assistants) provide or assist with basic care under the direction of licensed nursing staff, including monitoring health status, feeding, bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and patient transfer, in medical or nursing facilities, and may administer medication under direction and complete other health-related tasks. This page uses only official sources to explain occupational scope, tasks, China-U.S. access differences, and statistical measures.

zh.name: 护理员
zh.summary: 护理员（O*NET-SOC 31-1131.00，Nursing Assistants）在持证护理人员的指导下提供或协助基础照护，包括观察健康状况、喂食、沐浴、穿衣、仪容整理、如厕与患者转运等，工作场所为医疗机构或护理机构，并可能在指导下给药及完成其他健康相关任务。本页只用官方来源说明职业范围、任务、中美准入差异与统计口径。

en.name: Obstetricians and gynecologists
en.summary: Obstetricians and gynecologists (O*NET-SOC 29-1218.00, Obstetricians and Gynecologists) provide medical care related to pregnancy and childbirth, diagnose, treat, and help prevent diseases of women, especially those affecting the reproductive system, and may also provide general care for women and take on obstetric and gynecological surgery; in the United States, medical school education and residency training must be completed and a state license to practice obtained, while in mainland China licensed physician qualification and completed registration are required, and techniques such as midwifery also require a special maternal and child health technical service license.

zh.name: 妇产科医师
zh.summary: 妇产科医师（O*NET-SOC 29-1218.00，Obstetricians and Gynecologists）提供与妊娠和分娩相关的医疗照护，诊断、治疗并帮助预防女性疾病，尤其是影响生殖系统的疾病，也可提供女性一般照护并承担妇产科手术；美国须完成医学院教育与住院医师培训并取得州级行医许可，中国大陆须取得执业医师资格并完成注册，开展助产等技术还需专项母婴保健技术服务许可。

en.name: Occupational health and safety specialists
en.summary: Occupational health and safety specialists (O*NET19-5011.00) analyze work environments, design occupational health and safety programs, check compliance, and investigate accidents. In the United States JobZone4 requires considerable preparation; scope of responsibility｜some U.S. employers require or prefer professional certification, and certification is not a government license. In mainland China, safety management personnel assessment, registered safety engineer requirements, and institutional post authorization are verified by industry and post, and not all occupational health posts uniformly require a registered safety engineer; only after obtaining the qualification certificate and completing registration may one practice under the name of registered safety engineer. Testing and evaluation of occupational disease hazard factors are undertaken by occupational health technical service institutions with the corresponding qualification accreditation, while routine monitoring, medical health examinations, and occupational disease diagnosis follow separate rules and must not be lumped into one category.

zh.name: 作业健康专员
zh.summary: 作业健康专员（O*NET19-5011.00）分析工作环境，设计职业健康安全方案，检查合规与调查事故。美国JobZone4需相当准备；责任边界｜美国部分雇主要求或优先专业认证，认证不等政府许可。中国大陆按行业与岗位核安全管理人员考核、注册安全工程师要求及机构岗位授权，不把所有职业健康岗位一律要求注安师；取得资格证书后经注册才可用注册安全工程师名义执业。职业病危害因素检测、评价由有相应资质认可的职业卫生技术服务机构承担，日常监测、医疗健康检查和职业病诊断另有规则，不能混为一类。

en.name: Occupational therapists
en.summary: Occupational therapists identify meaningful daily tasks with clients, such as grooming, dressing or returning to school. They observe where a task breaks down, plan practice or environmental changes, and check participation over time. Mainland hiring and U.S. licensing are separate.

zh.name: 作业治疗师
zh.summary: 作业治疗师和当事人一起确定想恢复的日常活动，例如洗漱、穿衣或返校。工作是观察哪些步骤卡住、提出适合的训练或环境调整，并复核是否更能安全参与。大陆招聘条件和美国州许可分别查。

en.name: Occupational therapy aides
en.summary: Occupational therapy aides prepare treatment areas and equipment, escort patients, clean, and handle appointments and forms under the direction of a therapist or occupational therapy assistant; they do not independently develop or implement treatment plans.

zh.name: 作业治疗辅助员
zh.summary: 作业治疗辅助员在治疗师或作业治疗助理指导下准备治疗区域和器材、迎送患者、清洁及处理预约和表单；不独立制定或实施治疗计划。

en.name: Occupational therapy assistants
en.summary: Occupational therapy assistants implement activity training under the direction of an occupational therapist, observe client responses, record progress, and give feedback so the plan can be adjusted; education, certification, and state licensure are verified locally.

zh.name: 作业治疗助理
zh.summary: 作业治疗助理在作业治疗师指导下实施活动训练、观察参与者反应、记录进展并反馈以调整计划；教育、认证和州许可按所在地核。

en.name: Office machine operators (except computer)
en.summary: Non-computer office machine operators use work orders to operate high-speed copying, scanning, and binding equipment, verify originals and paper specifications, check page order and print quality, record output, consumables, and backlog, and deliver finished products; faults or confidentiality issues must be stopped and escalated.

zh.name: 办公设备操作员（计算机除外）
zh.summary: 非计算机办公设备操作员按工单操作高速复印、扫描、装订等设备，核原件和纸张规格，检查页序与印刷质量，记录产量、耗材和积压并交付成品；故障或保密问题须停止并升级。

en.name: Construction equipment operator
en.summary: Operate powered construction equipment such as excavators, bulldozers, graders, and loaders to excavate, move, and grade; follow site safety rules, inspect equipment, and coordinate with ground personnel.

zh.name: 工程机械操作员
zh.summary: 操作挖掘机、推土机、平地机、装载机等动力施工设备完成挖掘、搬运和整平；遵守现场安全规则，检查设备并与地面人员协调。

en.name: Operations research analyst
en.summary: Use mathematical modeling, optimization, simulation, and data analysis to help organizations compare options under constraints such as cost, time, resources, and logistics, and explain assumptions and limitations to decision makers.

zh.name: 运筹分析师
zh.summary: 用数学建模、优化、仿真和数据分析帮助机构在成本、时间、资源及物流等约束下比较方案，并向决策者解释假设和局限。

en.name: Dispensing optician
en.summary: Measure the customer's face and pupillary distance based on a written optical prescription, help select frames and lenses, send work orders to the laboratory, verify finished-glasses parameters, and adjust the fit; does not independently diagnose or prescribe.

zh.name: 配镜师
zh.summary: 依据书面光学处方测量顾客面部与瞳距，帮助选择镜架和镜片，向实验室下达加工单，核成镜参数并调整佩戴；不独立诊断或开处方。

en.name: Optometrist
en.summary: This page describes U.S. Optometrists, O*NET 29-1041.00: examining the eyes and visual system, diagnosing and managing conditions within state-authorized practice, and prescribing corrective lenses. Medication and some procedural permissions vary by state; care beyond the practitioner’s scope or expertise requires referral.

zh.name: 验光师
zh.summary: 本页按美国O*NET 29-1041.00介绍Optometrists：检查眼和视觉系统，在州许可范围内诊断、管理和治疗相关问题，并开具矫正镜片处方。药物及部分操作权限因州而异；超出本人执业范围或经验时转诊。

en.name: Orthodontist
en.summary: Orthodontists assess teeth, jaw, and facial structures, develop dentofacial deformity treatment plans based on history, examinations, and imaging, install and adjust appliances, and follow up efficacy and risks. The U.S. O*NET 29-1023.00 occupational description cannot directly replace Chinese physician practice registration and organizational diagnostic and treatment authority requirements.

zh.name: 正畸医师
zh.summary: 正畸医师评估牙齿、颌骨与面部结构，结合病史、检查和影像制定牙颌畸形治疗计划，安装并调整矫治装置，随访疗效及风险。美国 O*NET 29-1023.00 的职业描述不能直接替代中国医师执业注册与机构诊疗权限要求。

en.name: Orthotist and prosthetist
en.summary: Orthotists and prosthetists measure, design, fit, and adjust orthoses or prostheses based on prescriptions and patient assessment, check fit, function, and comfort, guide use, and keep continuous records; clinical duties are constrained by local qualifications and organizational authorization.

zh.name: 矫形器与假肢师
zh.summary: 矫形器与假肢师依据处方和患者评估，测量、设计、试配与调整支具或假肢，核查贴合、功能和舒适度，指导使用并持续记录；临床职责受所在地资格和机构授权约束。

en.name: Hand packer
en.summary: According to orders and packaging specifications, manually inspect, meter, sort, box, seal, and label products, record quantities and anomalies, and deliver verifiable parcels or batches.

zh.name: 手工包装工
zh.summary: 按订单和包装规范，人工检查、计量、分拣、装箱、封口和贴标产品，记录数量与异常，交付可核对的包裹或批次。

en.name: Painters, Construction and Maintenance.
en.summary: Protect the site per the work order, clean, patch, and sand the substrate, and after choosing the coating apply it with a brush, roller, or spray gun, then inspect adhesion, coverage, and surface quality and clean up and hand over.

zh.name: 建筑与维护油漆工
zh.summary: 按工单保护现场、清理修补并打磨基层，选择涂料后用刷、滚筒或喷枪施涂，检查附着、覆盖和表面质量并清理交付。

en.name: Paralegals and legal assistants
en.summary: Paralegals check facts, research legal sources, organize case files and prepare drafts for a lawyer to review. The assignments and authority depend on the employer and jurisdiction.

zh.name: 律师助理与法律助理
zh.summary: 律师助理核对事实、做法规和案例检索、整理证据与案卷，并把草稿交负责律师复核。大陆受聘助理、申请律师执业实习和持证执业是不同阶段，工作范围要按岗位和当地规则核。

en.name: Parking attendant.
en.summary: Receives vehicle owners at parking lots or garages, issues or verifies tickets, directs spaces, parks and retrieves vehicles, charges fees, and handles keys and vehicle handoff; follows on-site traffic and cashiering procedures to prevent collisions, wrong vehicles, and property loss.

zh.name: 停车服务员
zh.summary: 在停车场或车库接待车主、发放或核对票据，指引车位、停取车辆、收费并处理钥匙与车辆交接；按场地交通和收银流程防止碰撞、错车与财物损失。

en.name: Parts salesperson.
en.summary: At a repair shop or parts store, verifies replacement parts against the customer's equipment, vehicle, old part number, and fault description and confirms compatibility, stock, price, payment, shipping, and returns; difficult fitment must be verified with technicians or suppliers.

zh.name: 零部件销售员
zh.summary: 在维修店或配件门店根据客户设备、车辆、旧件编号和故障描述核对替换件，确认兼容性、库存、价格、付款、发货与退换；疑难适配须向技术人员或供应商核实。

en.name: Patient Representatives
en.summary: Patient representatives help patients understand services and policies, identify barriers to care, coordinate communication among patients, families, and care teams, and refer to appropriate resources; clinical decisions remain with clinical staff.

zh.name: 患者代表
zh.summary: 患者代表协助患者理解服务和政策、识别就医障碍，协调患者、家属与医疗团队的沟通，并转介适当资源；诊疗决定由临床人员负责。

en.name: Patternmakers, Metal and Plastic
en.summary: Metal and plastic patternmakers plan the sequence from drawings, measure, machine, assemble, and repair casting patterns, core boxes, or templates, and check dimensions with measuring tools; machine tool and welding work must follow training and on-site safety procedures.

zh.name: 金属与塑料模样制作工
zh.summary: 金属与塑料模样制作工按图纸规划工序，制作、装配和修整铸造模样、芯盒或型板，再用量具复核尺寸。实际机床和焊接操作须遵守培训与现场授权。

en.name: Paving, Surfacing, and Tamping Equipment Operators
en.summary: Paving, surfacing, and tamping equipment operators (O*NET 47-2071.00) run asphalt or concrete paving, leveling, and compacting equipment, working to road elevation, thickness, and the construction plan alongside dump trucks and ground personnel, checking equipment condition and recording anomalies. Before work, on-site traffic control, equipment training, and employer authorization should be verified.

zh.name: 铺路与压实设备操作员
zh.summary: 铺路与压实设备操作员（O*NET 47-2071.00）操作沥青或混凝土摊铺、整平与压实设备，按路面标高、厚度和施工方案与运料车、地面人员协作，检查设备状态并记录异常。工作前应核对现场交通管制、设备培训和雇主授权。

en.name: Payroll and Timekeeping Clerks
en.summary: Payroll and timekeeping clerks (O*NET 43-3051.00) verify attendance, hours, and pay adjustments, enter payroll data, compute wages and deductions, review discrepancies, and produce pay statements, period-end reports, and handoff records. Specific taxes, social insurance, and payment approvals must follow the target jurisdiction's rules and employer authorization.

zh.name: 薪资与考勤文员
zh.summary: 薪资与考勤文员（O*NET 43-3051.00）核对出勤、工时和工资调整，录入薪资数据，计算工资与扣款，复核差异并形成工资单、期末报表和交接记录。具体税费、社保与付款批准须依目标地区规则及雇主授权执行。

en.name: Penetration Testers
en.summary: Penetration testers (O*NET 15-1299.04), under prior written authorization with a defined scope and stop conditions, simulate attacks to find security weaknesses in networks, applications, and systems; they record re-checkable evidence, risk impact, and remediation advice, and re-test with system owners. Testing real systems without authorization is not part of the exercise on this page.

zh.name: 渗透测试员
zh.summary: 渗透测试员（O*NET 15-1299.04）在事先书面授权、明确范围和停止条件下，模拟攻击以发现网络、应用与系统的安全弱点；记录可复核证据、风险影响和修复建议，并与系统所有者复测。未经授权的真实系统测试不属于本页练习。

en.name: Personal Care Aides
en.summary: Personal care aides (O*NET 31-1122.00) help people with illness or disability complete daily activities such as eating, bathing, dressing, toileting, and walking per a service plan, and may also assist with meal preparation, light housework, and social participation. Personal care posts generally provide non-medical services; health-related procedures must be verified separately under local systems, employer authorization, and professional supervision.

zh.name: 个人护理辅助员
zh.summary: 个人护理辅助员（O*NET 31-1122.00）按服务计划协助有疾病或残障的人完成进食、洗浴、穿衣、如厕和行走等日常活动，也可能协助备餐、轻度家务与社会参与。个人护理岗位一般提供非医疗服务；健康相关操作须按当地制度、雇主授权与专业监督另核。

en.name: Personal Financial Advisors
en.summary: Personal financial advisors review clients’ goals, cash flow and tolerance for risk before discussing options and follow-up. In a review, they separate changes in the client’s circumstances from assumptions in the original plan.

zh.name: 个人理财顾问
zh.summary: 个人理财顾问先梳理客户的目标、收支和风险承受能力，再讨论方案和后续复核。定期会谈需要区分客户情况变化与原方案的假设。

en.name: Pest control workers
en.summary: Pest control workers inspect sites for signs of pest activity, perform assigned work and record locations and outcomes. A follow-up worker needs to be able to find the same inspection point from the record.

zh.name: 虫害防治人员
zh.summary: 虫害防治人员检查场所、寻找虫害活动迹象，按现场安排处理并记录位置和结果。复访人员要能凭记录找到同一检查点。

en.name: Pesticide handlers, sprayers, and applicators, vegetation
en.summary: Vegetation pesticide applicators work in assigned areas and record the plots, materials and site conditions. Clear boundaries and job records help a supervisor confirm the area covered.

zh.name: 植被农药施用人员
zh.summary: 植被施药作业人员按指派区域作业，并记录地块、材料和现场条件。清楚的地块边界与作业记录便于主管核对完成范围。

en.name: Petroleum engineers
en.summary: Petroleum engineers use well information and production data to assess recovery and evaluate development or production designs. A proposal needs to identify its observations and assumptions.

zh.name: 石油工程师
zh.summary: 石油工程师结合井资料和生产数据，分析采出表现，设计或评估开发与生产方案。交付方案时要说明依据哪些观测、采用哪些假设。

en.name: Petroleum pump system operators, refinery operators, and gaugers
en.summary: These roles cover petroleum transfer, refinery operations and tank gauging. Operators monitor instruments and equipment under site procedures and hand off readings, changes and open questions.

zh.name: 石油泵系统操作员与炼油厂计量员
zh.summary: 这一组岗位分别涉及油品输送、炼厂运行与储罐计量。操作员按站点要求监看仪表和设备状态，交班时交代读数、变化及待复核项。

en.name: Pharmacists
en.summary: Pharmacists review prescriptions, dispense or oversee dispensing, and counsel patients. A prescription discrepancy calls for checking the record and contacting the appropriate clinician through the workplace process.

zh.name: 药剂师
zh.summary: 药师审核处方、调配或监督调配，并向患者解释用药信息。发现处方疑点时，药师核对记录并按工作流程联系相关临床人员。

en.name: Pharmacy aides
en.summary: Pharmacy aides support stock, incoming deliveries and counter administration. They keep supplies and records organized and route patients’ medication questions to a pharmacist.

zh.name: 药房助理
zh.summary: 药房助理承担库存、到货记录和柜台事务等支持工作，帮助维持物料与记录清晰，并把患者用药问题转交药师。

en.name: Pharmacy technicians
en.summary: Pharmacy technicians enter prescription information, manage inventory and assist with dispensing preparation within their workplace scope. Questions that need clinical judgment go to the pharmacist.

zh.name: 药房技术员
zh.summary: 药房技术人员按工作场所授权录入处方信息、管理药品库存并协助准备调配。需要临床判断的疑问要交给药师处理。

en.name: Philosophy and Religion Teachers, Postsecondary
en.summary: Postsecondary philosophy and religion teachers build courses and discussions around texts, concepts and scholarship. They assess how accurately students read sources, construct arguments and respond to objections.

zh.name: 高校哲学与宗教学教师
zh.summary: 高校哲学与宗教学教师围绕原典、概念和研究文献组织课程与讨论，评阅学生能否准确理解材料、提出论点并回应异议。

en.name: Phlebotomists
en.summary: Phlebotomists (O*NET 31-9097.00) collect blood samples for testing, transfusion, donation, or research, check patient identities and sample labels, hand samples over, explain procedures to patients, and observe adverse reactions. Working with patient identities, test or collection requests, sample labels, times, and handover records, they produce identity-to-sample matching records, incident reports, and traceable handovers. Invasive blood collection, infection prevention, and adverse reaction management must be performed by trained and authorized personnel under institutional procedures. Work settings, qualifications, and final responsibility must be checked against local and institutional rules.

zh.name: 采血技师
zh.summary: 采血员（O*NET 31-9097.00）为检验、输血、捐献或研究采集血液样本，核患者身份、样本标签并交接，向患者解释流程和观察异常反应，围绕患者身份、检验或采样申请、样本标签、时间和交接记录形成身份与样本对应记录、异常报告和可追溯交接；侵入性采血、感染防护和不良反应处理须由受训且获授权人员按机构规程实施。岗位场景、资格和最终责任须按所在地及机构制度核对。

en.name: Photographers
en.summary: Photographers plan and produce still images for clients, publications or records. They clarify the brief, light and frame the shot, select and edit photos, retain originals and deliver approved files. Try the A1–A5 product-photo brief to see how those decisions fit together.

zh.name: 摄影师
zh.summary: 摄影师把用途、光线和构图转成可交付的静态照片。工作包括定拍摄清单、布光试拍、选片修整、保存原片，以及按授权和规格交图。先用 A1–A5 试做商品图交付，再对照商业摄影、影视摄像和冲印的实际岗位。

en.name: Photonics Engineers
en.summary: Photonics engineers turn optical performance needs into designs and test requirements. Prototype data helps them identify which specifications are met and where a design needs revision.

zh.name: 光子学工程师
zh.summary: 光子工程师把光学系统的性能需求转成设计和测试要求，再用原型数据判断哪些指标达标、哪些需要修改。

en.name: Photonics Technicians
en.summary: Photonics technicians help set up and maintain optical test equipment, check calibration status and record samples and readings against the designated procedure. Engineers use those records to trace measurement conditions.

zh.name: 光子学技术员
zh.summary: 光子技术员协助搭建和维护光学测试装置，检查校准状态，按指定版本记录样件和读数。记录要让工程人员能追溯测量条件。

en.name: Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Physicians
en.summary: Physical medicine and rehabilitation physicians assess movement and daily function, set rehabilitation goals and coordinate with the therapy team. Follow-up combines the task conditions with recorded measures of function.

zh.name: 物理医学与康复医师
zh.summary: 康复医学医师评估活动和日常功能，制定康复目标并与治疗团队协调。复诊时结合任务条件和测量记录判断功能变化。

en.name: Physical therapist assistants
en.summary: U.S. physical therapist assistants deliver assigned care under a physical therapist’s supervision, observe changes and report back. Similar mainland job titles can mean helping a rehabilitation technician or operating equipment only. Check the actual job and local credentials before choosing training.

zh.name: 物理治疗师助理
zh.summary: 美国物理治疗师助理（PTA）在物理治疗师监督下实施指定治疗、观察变化并报告。大陆招聘里相近名称的助理，可能协助物理因子治疗，也可能只操作设备；选课程前先核目标岗位和当地资格。

en.name: Physical therapists
en.summary: Physical therapists assess function, agree on goals, provide treatment and reassess movement. Consider whether you want to communicate closely with patients, document responses and adjust plans. U.S. PT and mainland hospital rehabilitation roles overlap in duties; verify qualifications separately.

zh.name: 物理治疗师
zh.summary: 物理治疗师通过功能评估、目标、治疗与复测帮助患者改善活动。选择职业时先看能否持续与患者沟通、记录反应、调整计划，再核各地资格。美国 PT 与大陆医院的康复治疗师按任务对照。

en.name: Physician assistants
en.summary: Physician assistants assess patients, document care and participate in follow-up within applicable practice rules and team arrangements. Pending results go to the authorized clinician for review.

zh.name: 医师助理
zh.summary: 医师助理在适用执业范围和团队安排内评估患者、记录诊疗信息并参与后续照护。待复核的结果应交给有权限的临床人员。

en.name: Physicists
en.summary: Physicists study physical phenomena using mathematical models, experiments or computation. They document measurement conditions and uncertainty so colleagues can evaluate the findings.

zh.name: 物理学家
zh.summary: 物理学家借助数学模型、实验或计算研究物理现象。整理数据时，他们要交代测量条件和不确定性，使同事能够复核结论。

en.name: Pile driver operators
en.summary: Pile driver operators run pile driving rigs according to the construction plan and site signals, driving piles into the foundation to support buildings, bridges, or wharves. The core is pre-shift inspection, pile position and hammer position control, observing abnormalities, and stopping work on instruction; paper exercises must not be treated as authorization to operate real equipment.

zh.name: 打桩机操作员
zh.summary: 打桩机操作员按施工方案和现场信号操纵桩机，将桩沉入地基以支撑建筑、桥梁或码头。核心是班前点检、桩位与锤位控制、观察异常并按指令停机；不能把纸面练习当真实设备操作授权。

en.name: Pipelayers
en.summary: Pipelayers lay pipe sections in trenches or in drainage and municipal water supply projects, verify the trench subgrade elevation, pipe position, and joint sealing, and backfill according to the construction plan. Real trench, lifting, and underground utility work must follow on-site safety rules; paper exercises do not constitute operating authorization.

zh.name: 管道铺设工
zh.summary: 管道铺设工在沟槽或排水、市政供水工程中铺设管段，核沟槽基底标高、管道位置与接头密封，并按施工方案回填。真实沟槽、吊装和地下设施作业必须遵守现场安全制度；纸面练习不构成操作授权。

en.name: Plasterers and stucco masons
en.summary: Plasterers and stucco masons check substrates, protect adjacent surfaces and apply and finish coats to the job specification. Review includes comparing the finished appearance with the specified sample.

zh.name: 抹灰与灰泥工
zh.summary: 抹灰与灰泥施工人员检查基层、保护相邻表面，再按工单完成分层抹面和收面。验收关注表面观感与指定样板是否一致。

en.name: Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters
en.summary: Plumbers, pipefitters, and steamfitters assemble, install, and repair piping that carries water, steam, air, or gas according to drawings, working with pipe fittings, valves, equipment, and connection points, and checking and recording abnormalities. Pressurized, gas, hot work, and confined space tasks must be carried out according to local regulations, project authorization, and safety procedures; paper exercises do not constitute an operating qualification.

zh.name: 管道工、配管工与蒸汽管安装工
zh.summary: 管道工、配管工与蒸汽管安装工按图纸装配、安装、维修输送水、蒸汽、空气或气体的管路，处理管件、阀门、设备和连接点，并检查记录异常。带压、燃气、热作业及狭小空间等任务必须按所在地制度、项目授权和安全程序执行；纸面练习不构成操作资格。

en.name: Podiatrists
en.summary: Podiatrists (US 29-1081) diagnose and treat problems of the foot, ankle, and lower extremities, may combine history, examination, imaging, and laboratory tests to plan care, provide non-surgical or surgical treatment, and refer out when signs of systemic disease appear. The US DPM, residency training, and state licenses do not automatically correspond to Chinese physician qualifications; paper exercises do not constitute authorization to diagnose or treat.

zh.name: 足病医生
zh.summary: 足病医生（美国29-1081）诊断和治疗足、踝及下肢相关问题，可结合病史、检查、影像与化验制定方案，提供非手术或手术治疗，并在发现全身性疾病线索时转诊。美国DPM、住院培训与州执照不自动对应中国医师资格；纸面练习不构成诊疗授权。

en.name: Poets, Lyricists, and Creative Writers
en.summary: Poets, lyricists and creative writers develop themes into poems, lyrics or other texts. Revision shapes rhythm, point of view and wording to fit the form.

zh.name: 诗人、作词人与创意写作者
zh.summary: 诗人、歌词作者和创意写作者把主题发展成诗歌、歌词或其他文本，并通过改稿调整节奏、视角和措辞。不同体裁对声音和结构的要求不同。

en.name: Police and Sheriff's Patrol Officers
en.summary: Police and sheriff’s patrol officers respond to incidents in their jurisdiction, support scene safety and document actions taken. A handoff ties times and locations to the source of each observation.

zh.name: 警察与治安巡逻官
zh.summary: 警察与治安官巡逻人员回应辖区事件、维持现场安全并记录处置经过。交班资料需把事件时间、地点和观察来源对应起来。

en.name: Police Identification and Records Officers
en.summary: Police identification and records officers work with evidence identifiers, examination records and transfer information. Records let later staff trace the item ID and time of receipt.

zh.name: 警察鉴定与记录官员
zh.summary: 警务鉴识与记录人员处理证据标识、检验记录和移交信息。记录必须让后续人员追溯物品编号及接收时间。

en.name: Political Science Teachers, Postsecondary
en.summary: Postsecondary political science teachers teach institutions, behavior and ideas, and help students formulate and test arguments with evidence. Comparisons require attention to the time and institutional context of a source.

zh.name: 高校政治学教师
zh.summary: 高校政治学教师讲授政治制度、行为与思想，并指导学生用材料提出和检验论点。课堂比较通常需要说明材料的时间和制度背景。

en.name: Political Scientists
en.summary: Political scientists study institutions, policies and public opinion. They answer research questions with documents, surveys or comparative evidence. Choose a role by its output: academic research, a policy memo or survey data. Check education, research permissions and publication responsibilities separately.

zh.name: 政治学家
zh.summary: 政治学家研究制度、政策与公共意见，用文献、调查或比较资料回答可检验的问题。选方向时先看你要交学术研究、政策备忘录，还是调查数据；各岗位的学历、研究权限和发布责任分别核。

en.name: Postal Service Clerks
en.summary: Postal service clerks accept mail and parcels at the post office counter, weigh items and verify postage, handle stamp and other postal product transactions, check mail status, and sort or hand over mail by destination. Accurate charging, protecting user information, pausing on anomalous items, and escalating per agency procedures are key responsibilities; USPS position conditions and Chinese postal institution requirements must be verified separately.

zh.name: 邮政服务文员
zh.summary: 邮政服务文员在邮局柜台收寄邮件和包裹，称重核资费、办理邮票与其他邮政产品交易、检查邮件状态并按目的地分拣或交接。准确计费、用户信息保密、异常件暂停与按机构流程升级是关键责任；美国 USPS 岗位条件与中国邮政机构要求须分别核对。

en.name: Postal Service Mail Carriers
en.summary: Postal service mail carriers deliver and collect mail on established routes on foot or by vehicle, sort and scan by address and sequence, handle mail requiring a signature, and hand over undelivered and exception items. Routes, weather, accurate delivery and user information protection are the core constraints; US USPS conditions and Chinese postal institution rules are checked separately.

zh.name: 邮政服务邮件投递员
zh.summary: 邮政服务邮件投递员按既定路线步行或驾车递送与收取邮件，依地址和顺序分拣、扫描，办理需要签收的邮件，并把未完成投递和异常件交接。路线、天气、准确交付与用户信息保护是核心约束；美国 USPS 条件与中国邮政机构规则分别核对。

en.name: Postal Service Mail Sorters, Processors, and Processing Machine Operators
en.summary: Postal service mail sorters, processors and machine operators inspect mail labels and status at postal processing centres, sort by destination and established routing rules manually or with equipment, and load, sack, label and record handovers. When unidentifiable mail or equipment jams appear, they pause, recheck or escalate according to training and authority; USPS positions and Chinese institution rules must be checked separately.

zh.name: 邮政服务邮件分拣员、处理员、机器操作员
zh.summary: 邮政服务邮件分拣、处理及设备操作员在邮政处理中心检查邮件标签与状态，按目的地和既定分路规则手工或借设备分拣，装卸、封袋、贴标并记录交接。发现无法识别的邮件或设备卡件时按训练和权限暂停、复核或升级；美国 USPS 岗位与中国机构规则须分别核对。

en.name: Postmasters and Mail Superintendents
en.summary: Postmasters and mail superintendents oversee a post office or mail operation. They schedule staff, coordinate mail processing and handoffs, resolve complaints, train employees, and report issues. Responsibilities and approval authority vary by facility.

zh.name: 邮局主管
zh.summary: 邮局主管负责让网点或邮政作业团队按计划运行：排班、核对考勤，处理投诉与异常，监督邮件交接，培训员工并报告问题。大陆的邮政支局长和投递部经理可以用来理解相邻职责，任命和权限依机构。

en.name: Potters, Manufacturing
en.summary: Potters, manufacturing operate pug mills, potter's wheels, forming equipment and kilns to turn clay into pottery, stoneware or other ceramic products, and must control forming, drying, glazing, firing and inspection. O*NET 51-9195.05 describes the specific potter tasks; for US wages and employment only broader BLS 51-9195 data were obtained, so the broad occupation values cannot be called potter-specific.

zh.name: 陶器制造工
zh.summary: 陶器制造工操作练泥机、陶轮、制坯和窑炉等设备，将黏土加工成陶器、炻器或其他陶瓷制品，需控制成形、干燥、施釉、烧成与检验。O*NET 51-9195.05描述陶工具体任务；美国工资与就业只取得BLS 51-9195较宽职业数据，不能把宽职业数值称为陶工专属。

en.name: Pourers and Casters, Metal
en.summary: Metal pourers and casters (O*NET 51-4052.00) control the flow of molten metal into molds to produce castings or ingots. Their work includes checking the mold and coordinating the handover with the furnace team. Real pouring, molten-metal handling and lifting require site procedures and authorization.

zh.name: 金属浇注与铸造工
zh.summary: 金属浇注与铸造工（O*NET 51-4052.00）控制熔融金属流入铸型，形成铸件或铸锭。工作包括核铸型状态、与熔炼班组交接。实际浇注、熔融金属处置和起重按现场规程与授权执行。

en.name: Power Distributors and Dispatchers
en.summary: Power distributors and dispatchers monitor the system and coordinate distribution activity and clearances. Their logs tell the next shift what has been confirmed and what still needs review.

zh.name: 电力调度员
zh.summary: 电力输配调度员监视系统状态，协调输配运行及工作许可交接。状态记录要让下一班知道哪些事项已确认、哪些仍待复核。

en.name: Power Plant Operators
en.summary: Power plant operators monitor generating equipment and instrument readings, record changes under site procedures and hand them off to the crew. An unusual reading should be traceable to its source point and time.

zh.name: 发电厂操作员
zh.summary: 电厂运行人员监看发电设备和仪表状态，按站点流程记录变化并与班组交接。异常读数应能追溯到原始点位和时点。

en.name: Precision Agriculture Technicians
en.summary: Precision agriculture technicians organize field boundaries, sampling points and yield data into traceable maps and records. Agricultural teams use them to study variation across a field.

zh.name: 精准农业技术员
zh.summary: 精准农业技术员把地块边界、采样点和产量等数据组织成可追溯的地图和记录，供农业团队分析田间差异。

en.name: Prepress Technicians and Workers
en.summary: Prepress technicians turn the text, images, fonts, and layout of a design file into a printable file, performing file preflight, proofing, and quality control, with some positions making printing plates. O*NET 51-5111.00 lists proofing, proofreading, layout, font and image file checking, and plate making as tasks. File release follows customer confirmation, equipment specifications, and in-plant procedures, and a screen preview cannot replace the printed result.

zh.name: 印前技术员与工人
zh.summary: 印前技术员把设计稿的文字、图像、字体和版式整理为可印刷文件，执行文件预检、校样和质量控制，部分岗位制作印版。O*NET 51-5111.00列打样、校对、排版、字体图像文件检查与制版为任务。文件放行要按客户确认、设备规格与厂内流程，不能以屏幕预览代替印刷结果。

en.name: Pressers, Textile, Garment, and Related Materials
en.summary: Pressers smooth and shape textiles and garments with hand irons, steam, or pressing equipment, handling, inspecting, and handing over finished pieces according to material and work order. O*NET 51-6021.00 and BLS 51-6021 are a standalone occupation; tasks may also include stain removal, machine cleaning and maintenance, or joining materials, with the actual division of labor depending on the site. Fabric and equipment processes must be verified through training and are not released on paper records alone.

zh.name: 烫工
zh.summary: 烫工用手工熨斗、蒸汽或压烫设备抚平、定型纺织品和服装，按材料与工单处理、检验并交接成品。O*NET 51-6021.00与BLS 51-6021为独立职业；任务也可含去渍、机器清洁维护或缝接材料，实际分工按场所。面料与设备工艺须经训练核查，不凭纸面记录放行。

en.name: Preventive Medicine Physicians
en.summary: Preventive medicine physicians identify preventable risks in individuals or populations and plan and evaluate prevention efforts. Clinical and population duties vary by setting.

zh.name: 预防医学医师
zh.summary: 预防医学医生从个人或群体资料中识别可预防风险，提出干预目标并评估效果。临床和群体职责随机构而异。

en.name: Print binding and finishing workers
en.summary: Print binding and finishing workers check materials and equipment against the work order, set cutting, folding, collating, binding, and surface finishing parameters, run a trial, then process in batches and spot-check dimensions, page order, and binding strength. When jams, unusual noises, misalignment, or adhesive binding defects occur, stop the machine first and troubleshoot, record, and escalate under the authorized procedure; never bypass machine guarding to handle a mechanical fault while the equipment is running.

zh.name: 装订工
zh.summary: 装订与印后工按工单检查材料和设备，设置裁切、折页、配页、装订及表面处理参数，试运行后批量加工并抽检尺寸、页序和牢固度。出现卡纸、异响、偏位或胶装缺陷时先停机并按授权流程排查、记录和升级；不能越过设备防护处理运行中的机械故障。

en.name: Printing press operators
en.summary: Printing press operators read production work orders, check paper and ink, and set plate, ink feed, registration, and sheet feed parameters; they start the press and pull a trial proof, check ink color, density, and registration position, and keep spot-checking and recording anomalies during the production run. On jams, unusual noises, or guard failure, they stop the press according to on-site procedure and hand it to authorized personnel.

zh.name: 印刷机操作员
zh.summary: 印刷机操作员读生产工单、核纸张和油墨，设置印版、供墨、套印和进纸参数；开机拉取试印样张，检查墨色、密度与套印位置，批量运行中持续抽检并记录异常。卡纸、异响或防护失效时按现场规程停机并交获授权人员处理。

en.name: Private detectives and investigators
en.summary: Private investigators gather, verify, and report information within the assignment and local authority. Much of the work is tracing sources and timelines.

zh.name: 私家侦探与调查员
zh.summary: 私人调查岗位按委托和当地权限收集、核查并报告信息，工作重点是来源、时间线和事实区分。

en.name: Probation officers and correctional treatment specialists
en.summary: Probation and correctional treatment roles track case conditions, services, and progress, then submit records or recommendations to authorized staff.

zh.name: 缓刑官与惩教治疗专员
zh.summary: 缓刑监督与矫正支持岗位按机构要求跟踪个案条件、服务与进展，并向有权人员提交记录或建议。

en.name: Procurement clerks
en.summary: Procurement clerks prepare orders, check quotes and delivery terms, and track delivery or invoice discrepancies. Some help compare bids or buy goods. Approval and payment authority depend on the employer.

zh.name: 采购文员
zh.summary: 采购文员按流程整理请购和订单，核报价、数量与交期，跟进到货或发票差异。有些岗位也协助比价采购；具体审批和付款权限看雇主授权。

en.name: Producers and directors
en.summary: Producers and directors coordinate content goals, creative decisions, teams, and production resources. Responsibilities vary across projects.

zh.name: 制片人与导演
zh.summary: 制片与导演岗位协调内容目标、创意取舍、团队与制作资源，分工随项目而异。

en.name: Production planning and expediting clerks
en.summary: Production planning and expediting clerks coordinate work orders and material flow between departments according to the production schedule, distribute and adjust schedules, check progress and completion dates with supervisors, and compile records of inventory, cost, bottlenecks, and delays. Schedule changes must note resource conditions and the approver, and expediting must not replace safety or quality judgment.

zh.name: 生产计划与催单文员
zh.summary: 生产计划与催单文员按照生产日程协调部门间的工单和物料流转，分发与调整排程，向主管核进度和完工日期，并整理库存、成本、瓶颈与延误记录。排程变更须标资源条件和批准人，不能用催单替代安全或质量判断。

en.name: Proofreaders and copy markers
en.summary: Proofreaders and copy markers compare the original manuscript with the typeset proof, mark errors in spelling, punctuation, grammar, numbers, layout, and omissions, verify whether changes have been implemented, and then pass items needing a decision to the author or editor. The occupation centers on finding and marking errors, while rewriting and final approval of facts rest with content editing.

zh.name: 校对员与校样标注员
zh.summary: 校对员与校样标注员对照原稿和排版校样，标记拼写、标点、语法、数字、版式与遗漏错误，核实改动是否已实施，再将待决定事项交作者或编辑。该职业以找错和标注为核心，内容编辑的重写和事实最终批准另有责任。

en.name: Property, real estate, and community association managers
en.summary: Property and community association managers coordinate ongoing operations, which may include resident requests, repairs, budgets, and service providers. Asset type and approval authority vary by role.

zh.name: 物业、房地产与社区协会经理
zh.summary: 物业、房地产及社区协会管理人员统筹物业持续运营，可能处理租户或业主请求、维修安排、预算和服务方。具体资产类型和审批权随岗位而异。

en.name: Prosthodontists
en.summary: Prosthodontists assess oral function, plan restorations, and coordinate fittings and follow-up with laboratory and clinical teams.

zh.name: 口腔修复专科医师
zh.summary: 口腔修复专科医生评估口腔功能，制定修复方案，安排试戴和随访，并与技工及临床团队核对需求。

en.name: Psychiatric Aides
en.summary: Psychiatric aides help with daily activities under nursing and medical staff direction and report observations during handoff. Duties depend on the setting.

zh.name: 精神科护理助理
zh.summary: 精神科护理辅助岗位按护理与医疗团队分工协助日常活动，观察变化并交班，具体任务以所在机构为准。

en.name: Psychiatric Technicians
en.summary: Psychiatric technicians monitor patient status, carry out assigned support tasks, and document changes. Clinical duties and reporting authority vary by employer and location.

zh.name: 精神科技师
zh.summary: 精神科技术人员按团队安排观察状态、执行获授权的支持任务并记录变化。临床操作和汇报权限随地区及雇主而异。

en.name: Psychiatrists
en.summary: Psychiatrists conduct medical assessments, diagnose and treat mental disorders, and work with teams to follow safety, functioning, and treatment goals.

zh.name: 精神科医师
zh.summary: 精神科医生在执业范围内进行医学评估、诊断和治疗，并与团队随访安全、功能与治疗目标。

en.name: Public Relations Managers
en.summary: Public relations managers develop and manage an organization's external communication strategy, determining target audiences, core messages, media relations, and crisis response procedures; they direct teams in producing press materials, responding to public concerns, and obtaining leadership approval for sensitive releases. The role centers on strategy, resources, and reputation risk decisions and is not equivalent to writing a single article.

zh.name: 公共关系经理
zh.summary: 公共关系经理制定并管理组织的对外沟通策略，确定目标受众、核心信息、媒体关系和危机应对流程；指导团队制作新闻材料、回应公众关切，并与领导层核准敏感发布。岗位重在策略、资源和声誉风险决策，不等同单篇稿件撰写。

en.name: Public Relations Specialists
en.summary: Public relations specialists shape and maintain the public image of an organization or individual, verify data, write press releases and media Q&A, respond to media information requests, update website and social platform content, and maintain community and media relationships. Important statements, sensitive data disclosure, and organizational commitments are approved by authorized personnel.

zh.name: 公共关系专员
zh.summary: 公共关系专员为组织或个人塑造并维护公众形象，核实资料、撰写新闻稿和媒体问答，回应媒体信息请求，更新网站与社交平台内容，并维护社区和媒体关系。重要声明、敏感资料披露与组织承诺依获授权人员审批。

en.name: Pump Operators, Except Wellhead Pumpers
en.summary: Pump operators monitor material transfers, equipment status, and operating records. Handoffs distinguish readings, anomalies, and actions requiring authorization.

zh.name: 泵操作员（井口泵除外）
zh.summary: 泵操作岗位按工艺要求监看介质输送、设备状态和运行记录。交接时区分现场读数、异常和授权处置。

en.name: Purchasing Managers
en.summary: Purchasing managers set purchasing and contract procedures, lead purchasing staff, and review suppliers, contracts, budgets, and delivery terms. They approve decisions within delegated limits. U.S. 11-3061.00 includes some wholesale or retail merchandising managers.

zh.name: 采购经理
zh.summary: 采购经理制定采购与合同规程，组织采购人员，复核供应商、合同、预算和交付条件，并在受委托范围内审批。美国 11-3061.00 包括部分批发或零售采购管理岗位。

en.name: Quality Control Analysts
en.summary: Quality control analysts test raw materials, bulk intermediates, and finished products using standard methods, compare results with specifications and control limits and propose release recommendations, and also calibrate and maintain equipment, record data, write deviation reports, and take part in out-of-specification investigations. This page uses the precise US O*NET occupation 19-4099.01; the US wages and employment projections only go up to the BLS SOC 19-4099 "other life, physical, and social science technicians" broad category and are not a dedicated 19-4099.01 value, so the two cannot be substituted for each other. For China no verifiable precise occupational wage was obtained, and the insufficient-evidence marker is retained.

zh.name: 质量控制分析师
zh.summary: 质量控制分析师按标准方法测试原材料、散装中间体和成品，把结果与规格和控制限比较并提出放行建议，同时校准与维护设备、记录数据、撰写偏差报告并参与超标调查。本页采用美国 O*NET 19-4099.01 精确职业；美国工资与就业预测只到 BLS SOC 19-4099「其他生命、物理与社会科学技术人员」大类，不是 19-4099.01 单列值，两者不能互相替换。中国区未取得可核验的精确职业工资，保留证据不足标记。

en.name: Quality control systems manager
en.summary: Quality control systems managers plan, direct, or coordinate quality assurance programs: they set quality control policies, control the quality of laboratory and production work, maintain quality system documents, and drive production stops and correction when serious defects appear. This page uses the US O*NET detailed occupation Quality Control Systems Managers (11-3051.01); the US wages and employment use the SOC 11-3051 category (industrial production managers) that contains this occupation, not a narrower single-occupation value. No verifiable wage for the detailed occupation was obtained for China, and an insufficient evidence marker is retained.

zh.name: 质量控制系统经理
zh.summary: 质量控制系统经理规划、指导或协调质量保证计划：制定质量控制政策，控制实验室与生产工作的质量，维护质量体系文件，并在出现严重缺陷时推动停止生产与纠偏。本页采用美国 O*NET 精确职业 Quality Control Systems Managers（11-3051.01）；美国工资与就业使用包含本职业的 SOC 11-3051 大类（工业生产经营经理）口径，不是更窄的单列职业值。中国区未取得可核验的精确职业工资，保留证据不足标记。

en.name: Radiologic Technologists and Technicians
en.summary: Radiologic technologists and technicians carry out X-ray, CT and other imaging work under examination requests and applicable protocols: identity and site checks, patient preparation and positioning, authorized exposure settings, image acquisition, technical image-quality evaluation and documentation. Technical evaluation is not disease diagnosis. Contrast-related duties require applicable legal and professional conditions and physician guidance. U.S. wages use exact occupation 29-2034; this page’s employment overview uses the combined radiologic and MRI group. Mainland China education, recruitment, professional-title qualifications and applicable radiation-worker requirements are considered separately; exact national or city occupational wages remain unavailable.

zh.name: 放射技师与技术员
zh.summary: 放射技师与技术员按检查申请和适用规程开展X光、CT等成像工作，包括身份与部位核对、患者准备与摆位、获准范围内的曝光条件设置、图像采集、技术图像质量评价及记录。技术质量评价不等于疾病诊断；造影相关任务须符合法律、专业条件及医师指导。美国工资采用29-2034精确职业口径，本页就业概览采用放射与MRI合并组。大陆部分分别解释教育、招聘、卫生专业技术资格和适用的放射工作人员要求，尚无可用的本职业全国或城市精确工资。

en.name: Rail Car Repairer
en.summary: Rail car repairers diagnose, adjust, repair or overhaul railroad rolling stock, mine cars or rail transit vehicles: inspect bodies, roofs, doors, bearings, seals, wheels, couplers and other components for defects and wear; remove or replace faulty and worn parts; repair, fabricate and install steel or wooden fittings according to drawings; service electrical controls for propulsion and braking systems; install car ends, crossmembers and interiors and adjust car bodies; test and adjust units before and after repair; record vehicle conditions and maintenance work and perform scheduled maintenance. This page uses the exact U.S. O*NET occupation Rail Car Repairers (49-3043.00). U.S. wages use its OEWS percentiles; unavailable industry-specific medians retain an insufficient-evidence label. No verifiable occupation-specific wage data were obtained for China, so that insufficient-evidence label is also retained.

zh.name: 铁路车辆修理工
zh.summary: 铁路车辆修理工诊断、调整、修理或大修铁路机车车辆、矿车或轨道交通车辆：检查车体、车顶、车门与轴承、密封、车轮、车钩等部件的缺陷与磨损；拆卸或更换故障与磨损部件；按图纸修理、制造并安装钢制或木制配件；检修推进与制动系统的电气控制；安装车端、横梁与车内装修并调整车体；在修理前后测试与调整机组；记录车况与维修工作并执行计划保养。本页采用美国 O*NET 精确职业 Rail Car Repairers（49-3043.00）；美国工资按其 OEWS 分位给出，行业分列中位数未取得时保留证据不足。中国区未取得可核验的精确职业工资，保留证据不足标记。

en.name: Maintenance operators
en.summary: Track equipment operators install and maintain rails, switches, and ballast. Identify the exact track section and record the defect before handing it off. Ask who operates the equipment, checks the repair, and authorizes reopening.

zh.name: 维护操作员
zh.summary: 线路铺设与维护设备岗位维护轨距、轨面及道床状态，工作从识别具体区段和记录缺陷开始。先分清设备操作、复测与恢复线路使用各由谁负责。

en.name: Rail yard engineers, dinkey operators, and hostlers
en.summary: Rail yard engineers and related operators move locomotives within yards or industrial sites. Their work includes equipment checks and confirming signals and switching instructions with ground crews.

zh.name: 工程师操作员
zh.summary: 调车机车司机及相关设备操作岗位负责站场内机车移动。上岗前检查设备、确认所接收的信号和调车指令，与地面人员核对交接。

en.name: Railroad brake, signal, and switch operators
en.summary: This occupational group supports train and yard movements by checking signals, car connections, and brake tests and handing off exceptions. Actual duties depend on the operator and assignment.

zh.name: 铁路、信号、操作员
zh.summary: 这组岗位从地面或列车侧配合调车，重点是核对信号、连接状态和制动测试，并把异常交给负责人员。具体岗位覆盖哪些任务，以单位分工为准。

en.name: Railroad Conductors and Yardmasters
en.summary: U.S. O*NET 53-4031.00 groups two work settings: conductors coordinate crews on passenger or freight trains, while yardmasters review schedules and switching sequences and coordinate work in the yard. Duties may overlap. In mainland China, check on-board passenger service, station operations and switching as separate roles.

zh.name: 铁路列车长与调车场主管
zh.summary: 美国 O*NET 53-4031.00 把两种工作归在一项：列车长协调客运或货运列车上的乘务组，调车场主管核对列车计划和调车顺序、协调场内作业。两类工作可能交叉；大陆的客运列车长、车站行车与调车工种应分别核职责。

en.name: Range Managers
en.summary: Range managers track vegetation, land use, and long-term productivity, compare management options, and document follow-up monitoring.

zh.name: 牧场资源经理
zh.summary: 草地管理岗位跟踪植被、土地利用和长期生产条件，比较管理方案并记录后续监测。

en.name: Real Estate Brokers
en.summary: Real estate brokers may handle transactions and run a brokerage, review files, or supervise agents. Check whether the role includes responsibility for office operations and transaction oversight.

zh.name: 房地产经纪人
zh.summary: 房地产经纪负责人既参与交易，也可能经营经纪业务、复核文件并指导销售人员。先看岗位是否承担办公室与代理流程责任。

en.name: Real Estate Sales Agents
en.summary: Real estate sales agents match client needs to property listings, arrange viewings, and follow up on offers and paperwork. Local rules and employer procedures determine who can confirm terms or make commitments.

zh.name: 房地产销售
zh.summary: 房地产销售代理把客户需求、房源资料和交易时间线对起来，安排看房并跟进报价和材料。谁能确认条款和承诺，由当地制度及雇主分工决定。

en.name: Receptionists and Information Clerks
en.summary: Receptionists and information clerks both answer questions. Compare visitor-facing reception with finding and providing information through directories, calls, or service requests.

zh.name: 前台接待与信息文员
zh.summary: 接待与信息文员都回应询问。本页比较现场来访接待与通过目录、电话或工单查答信息的任务。

en.name: Recreation Workers
en.summary: Recreation workers organize group activities, prepare materials, adapt sessions to participants, and collect feedback.

zh.name: 休闲活动从业人员
zh.summary: 文体活动工作人员组织群体活动、准备材料，按参与者兴趣与条件调整流程并跟踪反馈。

en.name: Recreational Therapists
en.summary: Recreational therapists select and adapt activities within care plans, observe participation, and document progress for the team.

zh.name: 娱乐治疗师
zh.summary: 康乐治疗岗位在机构计划内选择活动、调整参与方式，观察进展并向团队记录反馈。

en.name: Recreational vehicle service technicians
en.summary: Recreational vehicle service technicians inspect, diagnose, and repair the electrical, gas, water supply, HVAC, chassis, and body systems of travel trailers and other recreational vehicles. The work starts with a customer repair request and work order and finishes after isolating hazards, checking manuals and taking measurements, making the repair, function retesting, recording, and handover explanation; gas, electrical, and brake problems beyond training or authorization must be stopped and escalated.

zh.name: 房车维修技师
zh.summary: 房车维修技师检查、诊断并修理旅行拖车等休闲车辆的电气、燃气、供水、暖通、底盘和车身系统。工作从客户报修与工单开始，经隔离风险、查手册与测量、修复、功能复测、记录和交车说明完成；超出培训或授权的燃气、电气、制动问题须停工并升级。

en.name: Recycling and reclamation workers
en.summary: Recycling and reclamation workers sort paper, plastic, metal, glass, and other recyclables by material, remove items unsuitable for the process, and bale, move, weigh, and record the destination per on-site procedures. Equipment, vehicles, and suspected hazardous materials must be handled by trained, authorized personnel; when something is abnormal, stop work first, isolate, and escalate.

zh.name: 回收与再利用工
zh.summary: 回收与再利用工按材质分拣纸、塑料、金属和玻璃等可回收物，清除不适合该流程的物品，按现场程序打包、搬运、称重并记录去向。设备、车辆和疑似危险物质须由受训获授权人员处理；发现异常先停工、隔离并升级。

en.name: Recycling coordinators
en.summary: Recycling coordinators supervise municipal or corporate curbside collection and drop-off recycling programs: they arrange routes and staffing, verify collection and delivery records, handle service requests, train workers, and coordinate safety and compliance. Specific budget, contract, equipment, and on-site disposal authority depends on the employer and location.

zh.name: 回收协调员
zh.summary: 回收协调员监督市政或企业的路边收集与投放点回收项目：安排路线与人员、核对收运和交付记录、处理服务请求，培训作业人员并协调安全与合规。具体预算、合同、设备和现场处置权限取决于雇主与所在地。

en.name: Refractory materials repairers (except brickmasons)
en.summary: Refractory materials repairers inspect and repair heat-resistant linings in equipment such as furnaces and kilns, then document materials, locations, and inspection status.

zh.name: 耐火材料修复工（不含砌砖工）
zh.summary: 耐火材料修理岗位按工单检查和修补炉窑等设备的耐火层，交接材料、位置及验收状态。

en.name: Refuse and recyclable material collectors
en.summary: Refuse and recyclable material collectors pick up materials along routes and document missed stops or exceptions. Driving, sorting, and facility duties vary by assignment.

zh.name: 垃圾与可回收材料收集员
zh.summary: 垃圾与可回收物收运岗位按路线收集容器内物料，记录漏收、异常或需交接的点位。驾驶、分类和设施分拣按岗位分工。

en.name: Regulatory affairs managers
en.summary: Develops product regulatory strategy and filing plans, coordinates review of materials submitted to regulatory agencies, responds to regulatory questions, and coordinates development, quality, production, and marketing teams. The specific product, market, and applicable rules determine the submission requirements; a manager title does not automatically confer legal opinion, product release, or regulatory sign-off authority.

zh.name: 法规事务经理
zh.summary: 制定产品法规策略和申报计划，统筹审阅向监管机构提交的材料，回应监管问题并协调开发、质量、生产与市场团队。具体产品、市场和适用规则决定提交要求；经理头衔不自动取得法律意见、产品放行或监管签署权。

en.name: Regulatory affairs specialists
en.summary: Coordinates, prepares, and reviews domestic and international regulatory filing materials, maintains regulatory versions and technical archives, and follows up on agency inquiries, inspections, and product changes. The specific product and jurisdiction determine the submission requirements; a specialist title does not automatically confer legal opinion, release, or sign-off authority.

zh.name: 法规事务专员
zh.summary: 协调、编制与审阅国内外监管申报材料，维护法规版本和技术档案，跟进机构问询、检查及产品变更。具体产品和法域决定提交要求；专员职称不自动赋予法律意见、放行或签署权限。

en.name: Rehabilitation counselors
en.summary: Rehabilitation counselors work with clients to identify barriers to education, employment, and community participation, then plan goals, resources, and reviews.

zh.name: 康复咨询师
zh.summary: 康复辅导人员与服务对象核对参与学习、工作和社区生活的障碍，讨论目标、资源与复核安排。

en.name: Reinforcing iron and rebar workers
en.summary: Rebar workers position and secure reinforcing bars or mesh for concrete according to drawings, then record dimensions, locations, and open checks.

zh.name: 钢筋工
zh.summary: 钢筋工按图纸定位和固定混凝土用钢筋或钢网，交接尺寸、位置及待核节点。

en.name: Remote Sensing Scientists and Technologists
en.summary: Remote sensing scientists and technologists combine satellite, aerial, or ground sensor data with other geographic information, design analysis methods, validate results, and interpret resource, environmental, or urban problems. This page corresponds to O*NET 19-2099.01; public wage and employment statistics only go up to the broad 19-2099 category.

zh.name: 遥感科学家与技术专家
zh.summary: 遥感科学家与技术专家将卫星、航空或地面传感器数据与其他地理信息结合，设计分析方法、验证结果并解释资源、环境或城市问题。本文对应O*NET 19-2099.01；公开工资和就业统计只到19-2099宽类。

en.name: Remote Sensing Technicians
en.summary: Remote sensing technicians assist scientists in using remote sensing technology, collecting spatial data, processing and fusing imagery, and checking the completeness and accuracy of system data; some positions take part in flight planning or sensor configuration. This page covers O*NET 19-4099.03. The U.S. wage statistics and employment projections apply to the broader BLS group 19-4099.

zh.name: 遥感技术员
zh.summary: 遥感技术员协助科学家使用遥感技术，采集空间数据、处理与融合影像，并检查系统数据的完整性和准确性；部分岗位参与飞行规划或传感器配置。本文对应 O*NET 19-4099.03；美国工资统计与就业预测均为 BLS 19-4099 宽类口径。

en.name: Residential Advisors
en.summary: Residential advisors coordinate resident needs, supplies, repairs, and referrals and maintain handoff records.

zh.name: 住宿辅导员
zh.summary: 住宿管理与支持岗位协调住户日常事务、物资、维修和转介，保留交班记录。

en.name: Respiratory Therapists
en.summary: Respiratory therapists assess respiratory-care needs, check equipment, document observations, and hand off changes within team plans and authority.

zh.name: 呼吸治疗师
zh.summary: 呼吸治疗师在团队计划和授权下评估呼吸照护需要，检查设备、记录观察并交接变化。

en.name: Retail Loss Prevention Specialists
en.summary: Retail loss prevention specialists check inventory discrepancies in stores or distribution, patrol for merchandise and entrance and exit risks, inspect loss prevention processes and monitoring equipment, and record, investigate, and escalate anomalies as authorized. Incident handling must balance customer and employee safety with the integrity of evidence; on-site detention authority must be verified against local law and employer policy.

zh.name: 零售防损专员
zh.summary: 零售防损专员在商店或配送环节核库存差异、巡查商品与出入口风险、检查防损流程及监控设备，并依授权记录、调查和升级异常。事件处置要兼顾顾客、员工安全与证据完整；现场拦截权限须按当地法律和雇主制度核实。

en.name: Retail Salespersons
en.summary: Retail salespersons work directly with customers to compare products, check stock and prices, and follow up within store policy.

zh.name: 零售销售员
zh.summary: 零售销售员直接与顾客沟通，比较商品、核库存和价格，按门店授权跟进售后。

en.name: Riggers
en.summary: Riggers prepare, inspect, and maintain rigging for lifting or setup. Signaling, equipment operation, and approval depend on the work assignment.

zh.name: 索具工
zh.summary: 索具工为吊运或布置作业准备、检查和维护索具。现场指挥、设备使用和批准按作业分工。

en.name: Robotics Engineers
en.summary: Robotics engineers (O*NET 17-2199.08) design, develop, debug, and test robotic systems, handling sensor signals, control programs, end effectors, and system integration; delivery requires verification, risk assessment, and confirmation by authorized personnel.

zh.name: 机器人工程师
zh.summary: 机器人工程师（O*NET 17-2199.08）设计、开发、调试和测试机器人系统，处理传感器信号、控制程序、末端执行器与系统集成；交付须经验证、风险评估和有权限人员确认。

en.name: Robotics Technicians
en.summary: Robotics Technicians (O*NET 17-3024.01) install, program, troubleshoot, test, and maintain robotic equipment and related automation systems, handling sensor signals, control programs, end effectors, and system integration; deliverables must be verified, risk-assessed, and confirmed by authorized personnel.

zh.name: 机器人技术员
zh.summary: 机器人技术员（O*NET 17-3024.01）安装、编程、排障、测试和维护机器人设备及相关自动化系统，处理传感器信号、控制程序、末端执行器与系统集成；交付须经验证、风险评估和有权限人员确认。

en.name: Rock Splitters, Quarry
en.summary: Quarry rock splitters separate rough stone blocks and record material and dimensions for processing or handoff.

zh.name: 采石工
zh.summary: 采石场石材劈裂岗位从采场分离粗石块，按材料和尺寸记录后续加工或交接。

en.name: Rolling Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
en.summary: Rolling machine workers set up or monitor metal or plastic forming and track batches, dimensions, and inspection results.

zh.name: 金属轧制工
zh.summary: 轧制设备岗位按工单设置或监看金属、塑料成形，跟踪批次、尺寸与检验结果。

en.name: Roof Bolters, Mining
en.summary: Mining roof bolters install supports under site plans and record locations and inspection status. Authorized staff confirm support status.

zh.name: 矿山顶板锚杆工
zh.summary: 矿山锚杆安装岗位按现场计划使用支护设备并记录安装位置与检查状态，支护确认由有权角色负责。

en.name: Roofers
en.summary: Roofers install, maintain, or repair roofing materials to project requirements and record work areas and inspection status.

zh.name: 屋面工
zh.summary: 屋面施工岗位按项目要求安装、维护或修补屋面材料，并在交接中标明施工区域和检查状态。

en.name: Rotary Drill Operators, Oil and Gas
en.summary: Oil and gas rotary drill operators operate or monitor drilling equipment and document shift conditions and anomalies for handoff.

zh.name: 石油天然气旋转钻机操作工
zh.summary: 油气旋转钻机岗位操作或监看钻进设备，跟踪班次、工况和异常并按程序交接。

en.name: Roustabouts, Oil and Gas
en.summary: Oilfield roustabouts support equipment assembly, materials handling, and repair tasks as assigned and route issues that need specialist attention.

zh.name: 油气井场杂务工
zh.summary: 油气现场辅助岗位按分工支持设备组装、物料和维修任务，及时记录需由专业人员处理的事项。

en.name: Sailors and Marine Oilers
en.summary: Sailors and marine oilers cover different shipboard assignments. Check deck and engine-room duties, watches, and credentials for the vessel and route.

zh.name: 水手与轮机加油工
zh.summary: 水手和船舶加油机工涵盖不同船上分工。甲板和机舱任务、值班和证书须按船型、航区及雇主核对。

en.name: Sales Engineers
en.summary: Sales engineers sell commercial products or services that require an engineering-degree level of technical background, clarify customer technical requirements, prepare proposals, organize demonstrations or trials, explain technical and commercial terms, and hand over verified capabilities and unresolved risks to the sales and delivery teams.

zh.name: 销售工程师
zh.summary: 销售工程师销售需要工程学位水平技术背景的商业产品或服务，澄清客户技术需求、准备方案、组织演示或试用、解释技术与商业条件，并把已验证能力和未解决风险交给销售及交付团队。

en.name: Sales Managers
en.summary: Sales managers set territories and goals, coach staff, and adjust assignments using sales and customer information.

zh.name: 销售经理
zh.summary: 销售经理负责区域、目标、人员辅导与跟踪，依据实际销售和客户信息调整分工。

en.name: Sales Representatives of Services, Except Advertising, Insurance, Financial Services, and Travel
en.summary: Service sales representatives learn client needs, explain scope and terms, and coordinate quotes and handoffs. Authority to make commitments depends on the service.

zh.name: 服务销售代表（广告、保险、金融与旅游除外）
zh.summary: 服务销售代表了解客户需求，解释服务范围和条件，协调报价及后续交接。不同服务的承诺权限各异。

en.name: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing, Except Technical and Scientific Products
en.summary: Wholesale and manufacturing sales representatives explain products, quantities, and prices to business customers and coordinate supply, orders, and follow-up.

zh.name: 批发与制造业销售代表（非技术与科学产品）
zh.summary: 批发与制造销售代表向企业客户解释商品、数量和价格，协调供货、订单与售后。

en.name: Sales representatives, wholesale and manufacturing, technical and scientific products
en.summary: This occupation represents wholesalers or manufacturers selling goods that require technical or scientific knowledge, explains product specifications and uses, demonstrates products, provides ongoing technical support, prepares quotes, orders and sales contracts, works with engineers and arranges installation and testing; sales representatives are not automatically regarded as sales engineers or product design owners.

zh.name: 批发与制造业销售代表（技术与科学产品）
zh.summary: 本职业代表批发商或制造商销售需要技术或科学知识的商品，解释产品规格和用途，演示产品、提供持续技术支持，准备报价订单与销售合同，协同工程人员并安排安装测试；不把销售代表自动视为销售工程师或产品设计负责人。

en.name: Sawing machine setters, operators and tenders, wood
en.summary: Wood sawing machine workers prepare materials and set up or monitor cutting, documenting dimensions and rework needs.

zh.name: 制材工
zh.summary: 木材锯切设备岗位按工单准备材料、设置或监看切割，并记录尺寸与返工需求。

en.name: School bus monitors
en.summary: School bus monitors help students board and exit, maintain order, and report missed handoffs or incidents. Driving and emergency roles follow the operator’s procedures.

zh.name: 校车监督员
zh.summary: 随车照管人员协助学生上下车、关注乘车秩序，并记录未交接或乘车异常。驾驶与应急分工按运行单位要求。

en.name: School psychologists
en.summary: School psychologists gather evidence about learning, behavior, and development and work with schools and families to assess and review supports. Professional authority depends on the setting.

zh.name: 学校心理学家
zh.summary: 学校心理学岗位围绕学习、行为和发展问题收集证据，与学校和家庭协作评估及复核支持措施。具体专业权限以当地和雇主为准。

en.name: Search marketing strategists
en.summary: Search marketing strategists analyze query intent, landing pages, and outcome measures, then propose changes they can test.

zh.name: 搜索营销策略师
zh.summary: 搜索营销策略岗位分析查询意图、页面承接和结果指标，提出可验证的优化假设。

en.name: Secretaries and administrative assistants, except legal, medical and executive
en.summary: General administrative support includes scheduling, routine correspondence, file routing, and calls. Specialized legal, medical, or executive workflows have separate requirements.

zh.name: 行政秘书与行政助理（法律、医疗、行政主管除外）
zh.summary: 一般行政支持岗位负责日程、例行文书、文件流转和来电。明确区分通用办公室流程和专业岗位流程。

en.name: Securities, Commodities, and Financial Services Sales Agents
en.summary: Securities, commodities, and financial services sales roles serve individuals or institutions. Product explanations, transactions, and suitability obligations vary by role and jurisdiction.

zh.name: 证券、商品与金融服务销售代理
zh.summary: 证券、商品与金融服务销售岗位服务个人或机构客户。产品解释、交易和适当性要求随岗位与监管环境而异。

en.name: Security and Fire Alarm Systems Installers
en.summary: Security and fire alarm systems installers (O*NET 49-2098) install, program, maintain and repair alarm equipment per work orders and drawings, test circuits, sensors, backup batteries and alarm functions, and explain use and false alarm handling to clients. Construction, fire and electrical requirements follow local codes and authorization.

zh.name: 安全消防系统安装工
zh.summary: 安防与火警系统安装员（O*NET 49-2098）按工作单和图纸安装、编程、维护和修理报警设备，测试电路、传感器、备用电池及告警功能，并向客户说明使用与误报处理。施工、消防和电气要求按所在地规范及授权执行。

en.name: Security Guards
en.summary: Security guards (O*NET 33-9032) patrol or monitor premises, verify entry and exit permissions, watch for theft, violence and rule violations, and record and report anomalies. Specific response, equipment and training follow local and employer rules; this occupation is not the same as police or security and fire alarm systems installers.

zh.name: 安全警卫
zh.summary: 安全警卫（O*NET 33-9032）巡查或监控场所，核对出入权限，观察盗窃、暴力及规则违规风险，记录并报告异常。具体处置、装备和培训依所在地与雇主规定；本职业不等同警察或安防系统安装员。

en.name: Security Management Specialists
en.summary: Security management specialists (O*NET 13-1199.07) assess an organization's physical security threats, design and improve security systems and processes, conduct audits, propose countermeasures and follow up on them. U.S. wages and employment are available only as the broad 13-1199 aggregate and cannot be treated as standalone data for this occupation.

zh.name: 安全管理专员
zh.summary: 安全管理专员（O*NET 13-1199.07）评估组织的实体安全威胁，设计和改进安全系统与流程，开展审计、提出对策并跟进措施。美国工资与就业仅有 13-1199 宽职业汇总，不能当作本职业单列数据。

en.name: Security Managers
en.summary: Security managers oversee an organization’s security work, personnel, and resources. They review control implementation and escalate decisions through the organization’s procedures.

zh.name: 安全经理
zh.summary: 安保经理统筹组织的安保工作、人员和资源，核风险与控制的实施并按制度升级决策。

en.name: Segmental Pavers
en.summary: Segmental pavers lay out, cut, and install paving units, documenting edges, coverage, and areas awaiting review.

zh.name: 块状铺路工
zh.summary: 块材铺装岗位按项目布局放样、切配和铺设铺块，记录边缘、铺装范围与待复核位置。

en.name: Self-Enrichment Teachers
en.summary: Self-enrichment teachers lead hobby or leisure classes, using demonstrations, practice, and feedback to help learners complete a concrete project or activity.

zh.name: 自我提升课程教师
zh.summary: 兴趣课程教师教休闲或个人兴趣活动，通常通过示范、练习和反馈让学习者完成一件具体作品或动作。

en.name: Semiconductor Processing Technicians
en.summary: Semiconductor processing technicians (O*NET 51-9141.00) clean and load and unload wafers per work orders, operate specialised equipment, monitor parameters and inspect and record defects.
