U.S. 2025 wages and 2025–2035 employment come from the 51-9141 occupational line; Chinese urban unit averages are industry background only and are not this occupation's precise wage.

zh.name: 半导体加工技术员
zh.summary: 半导体加工技术员（O*NET 51-9141.00）按工单清洁、装卸晶圆、操作专用设备、监视参数并检验与记录缺陷。美国 2025 工资与 2025–2035 就业来自 51-9141 职业行；中国城镇单位均值仅作行业背景，不是本职业精确工资。

en.name: Separating, Filtering, Clarifying, Precipitating, and Still Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
en.summary: Separation and filtration equipment workers set up or monitor process equipment and record batches, samples, and anomalies. Materials and processes vary by industry.

zh.name: 分离、过滤、澄清、沉淀及蒸馏设备操作员
zh.summary: 分离和过滤等设备岗位按工艺要求设置或监看设备，记录批次、取样和异常，具体介质与流程随行业而异。

en.name: Septic Tank Servicers and Sewer Pipe Cleaners
en.summary: Septic and sewer maintenance workers inspect, clean, or repair designated systems and record blockages, work performed, and follow-up checks.

zh.name: 化粪池维护及下水管道清洁工
zh.summary: 化粪池及排水管维护岗位检查、清理或修理指定设施，记录堵塞位置、已做工作及复核事项。

en.name: Service Unit Operators, Oil and Gas
en.summary: Oil and gas service unit operators support work on producing wells or assist with well obstructions under an approved plan, documenting equipment, conditions, and handoffs.

zh.name: 石油天然气井服务机组操作员
zh.summary: 油气井服务设备操作岗位按作业方案支持在产井服务或井内障碍处理，记录设备、工况和授权交接。

en.name: Set and Exhibit Designers
en.summary: Set and exhibit designers translate content goals and spatial constraints into designs, then review materials, dimensions, and practical limits with production teams.

zh.name: 布景与展陈设计师
zh.summary: 布景与展陈设计岗位把内容目标和空间条件变成设计方案，与制作团队核材料、尺寸及落地限制。

en.name: Sewers, Hand
en.summary: Hand sewers stitch, reinforce, and finish products against samples or work orders, then check materials and finish quality.

zh.name: 缝纫工、手工
zh.summary: 手工缝制岗位按样件或工单缝合、加固和整理制品，核材料、针脚和完成质量。

en.name: Sewing Machine Operators
en.summary: Sewing machine operators thread machines, position and guide fabric or other products according to process sheets, and machine sew, reinforce, or decorate them; they monitor broken threads, stitch defects, and equipment irregularities and check dimensions and appearance. Equipment types, materials, and shifts depend on the target position.

zh.name: 缝纫机操作员
zh.summary: 缝纫机操作员按工序单装线、定位并导引面料或其他制品，经机器缝合、加固或装饰；监看断线、线迹缺陷和设备异常，检查尺寸与外观。设备类型、材料及班次以目标岗位为准。

en.name: Shampooers
en.summary: Shampooers prepare and provide hair washing under salon procedures, confirm customer needs, and route questions to the responsible staff member.

zh.name: 洗发师
zh.summary: 洗护服务岗位按门店流程准备洗发服务、与顾客确认需求，并将待确认事项交给负责人员。

en.name: Sheet Metal Workers
en.summary: Sheet metal workers fabricate, assemble, or install sheet metal parts from drawings and check dimensions, interfaces, and delivery scope.

zh.name: 钣金工
zh.summary: 钣金岗位根据图纸加工、装配或安装薄板件，核尺寸、接口和交付范围。

en.name: Ship Engineers
en.summary: Ship engineers coordinate shipboard machinery, electrical systems, and related maintenance. Watches and review responsibilities depend on vessel and rank.

zh.name: 船舶工程师
zh.summary: 船舶轮机岗位协调船上机械、电气及相关设备的运行维护，跟踪值班、缺陷和复核，具体职责随船型和职级而异。

en.name: Shipping, receiving, and inventory clerks
en.summary: Shipping, receiving, and inventory clerks match orders and shipping records to goods on hand, prepare documents and report shortages, damage or lot mismatches. Check who can adjust inventory, release goods after inspection or operate warehouse equipment.

zh.name: 收发货与库存文员
zh.summary: 收发货与库存文员核对订单、运单、实物和库存记录，整理出入库单据，发现少货、破损或批次不符时登记并交接。库存调整、质检放行与设备操作是否由你负责，要看岗位和授权。

en.name: Shoe and Leather Workers and Repairers
en.summary: Shoe and leather workers and repairers make, decorate, or repair leather or leather-like products such as shoes, luggage, and harnesses, handling materials to patterns, stitching or cementing components, assembling and finishing, and inspecting for defects. The finished product's dimensions, connections, appearance, and repair records are the actual deliverables; the materials, tools, and authority for footwear manufacturing, custom work, and repair must be checked separately.

zh.name: 制鞋与皮革制品工及修理工
zh.summary: 制鞋与皮革制品工及修理工制作、装饰或修理鞋、箱包、马具等皮革或类皮革制品，按样板处理材料、缝合或胶合部件、装配和整饰，并检验缺陷。成品的尺寸、连接、外观与修理记录是实际交付；鞋类制造、定制和维修的材料、工具及权限须分别核。

en.name: Shuttle drivers and chauffeurs
en.summary: Shuttle drivers and chauffeurs transport passengers on scheduled or booked trips, checking routes, timing, and handoff requirements. Vehicle and licensing requirements vary.

zh.name: 穿梭车司机专车司机
zh.summary: 接驳及专车驾驶岗位按预约或班次运送乘客，核路线、时间和特殊交接要求。车型、执照和服务范围需按当地及雇主核对。

en.name: Skincare specialists
en.summary: Skincare specialists confirm client needs, prepare services, and document what was provided. Services and equipment permitted depend on local rules and the business.

zh.name: 护肤专家
zh.summary: 皮肤护理服务岗位确认顾客需求、准备项目并记录服务。服务内容、设备和可开展范围随当地规则及机构而异。

en.name: Social and Community Service Managers
en.summary: Social and community service managers coordinate programs, staff, budgets, and participation requirements and review service delivery.

zh.name: 社会与社区服务经理
zh.summary: 社会与社区服务经理协调项目、人员、预算和参与条件，跟踪实际服务交付与改进。

en.name: Social and Human Service Assistants
en.summary: Social and human service assistants organize records, contact clients and resources, document progress, and route eligibility or case decisions to authorized staff.

zh.name: 社会与人类服务助理
zh.summary: 社会及人类服务助理协助整理资料、联系服务对象和资源，记录进展并把资格或个案判断交给有权人员。

en.name: Social Science Research Assistants
en.summary: Social science research assistants support data collection, records, and quality checks, keeping a trace of sources and processing steps.

zh.name: 社会科学研究助理
zh.summary: 社会科学研究助理支持调查或研究记录、资料管理与质量检查，按研究方案保留来源和处理过程。

en.name: Sociologists
en.summary: Sociologists study behavior in groups, organizations, and institutions and use evidence and research design to test explanations.

zh.name: 社会学家
zh.summary: 社会学研究人员分析群体、组织和制度中的行为，用资料和研究设计检验解释。

en.name: Soil and Plant Scientists
en.summary: Soil and plant scientists study soil conditions, plant growth, and management practices, using samples and observations to explain differences.

zh.name: 土壤与植物科学家
zh.summary: 土壤与植物科学人员研究土壤条件、植物生长和管理措施，通过样本与观测解释差异。

en.name: Solar Energy Installation Managers
en.summary: Organize photovoltaic and solar thermal installation crews for residential or commercial projects, estimate personnel and materials, arrange construction and inspections, and coordinate technical issues, safety requirements and handover records. The core is making the plan, site progress, quality evidence and customer handover correspond to one another; a manager title does not replace electrical, structural or inspection authority.

zh.name: 太阳能安装经理
zh.summary: 组织住宅或商业项目的光伏、光热安装班组，估算人员与材料，安排施工和检查，协调技术问题、安全要求及交付记录。核心是让计划、现场进度、质量证据与客户交接相互对应；经理头衔不代替电气、结构或检查机构的专业权限。

en.name: Solar Energy Systems Engineers
en.summary: Analyze sites, energy demand and solar system options, carry out photovoltaic or solar thermal design, performance assessment and technical review, and support installation and commissioning. The core output is an engineering solution with inputs, assumptions, calculations and version bases; design advice, construction implementation, professional signing and project approval each have their own responsibility boundaries.

zh.name: 太阳能系统工程师
zh.summary: 分析场地、能源需求和太阳能系统方案，进行光伏或光热设计、性能评估与技术审查，并支持安装调试。核心产出是有输入、假设、计算和版本依据的工程方案；设计建议、施工实施、专业签署和项目批准各有责任边界。

en.name: Solar photovoltaic installers
en.summary: Based on site assessment, drawings and work requirements, assemble, install or maintain photovoltaic systems on rooftops and other structures, checking components, supports, labeling and installation records, reporting anomalies and handing over inspections. Specific electrical, height-work, commissioning and testing tasks must match training and authorization; completing construction does not equal passing inspection or being cleared for grid connection.

zh.name: 太阳能光伏安装工
zh.summary: 依据场地评估、图纸和作业要求，装配、安装或维护屋顶及其他结构上的光伏系统，核对组件、支撑、标识和安装记录，报告异常并交接检查。具体电气、登高、调试及测试任务须匹配训练和授权；施工完成不等于检查合格或获准并网。

en.name: Solar thermal installers and technicians
en.summary: Solar thermal installers and technicians install or service systems that collect, store, and circulate solar-heated water. Work and signoff follow project assignments.

zh.name: 安装工技术员
zh.summary: 太阳能热利用安装技术岗位安装或维护集热、储热与热水循环系统。任务涉及现场记录与交接，具体操作按项目授权。

en.name: Sound engineering technicians
en.summary: Sound engineering technicians set up equipment, record or edit audio, and prepare handoffs for productions or live events.

zh.name: 音响工程技术员
zh.summary: 声音工程技术人员在录制、演出或制作中组织声音设备、记录、编辑与交接。

en.name: Spa managers
en.summary: Spa managers run the booking schedule, staffing, facilities and daily close. When a room is unavailable, they check staff scope, turnaround time and the handoff before promising a booking. They can oversee quality and budgets; the title itself does not authorize hands-on or medical services.

zh.name: 水疗中心经理
zh.summary: 水疗中心经理管预约、人手、设施和日结。满房或设备待复核时，先核服务范围、房间周转与交接人，再决定能否接单。岗位可负责质量和预算，经理头衔不授予实施按摩、美容或医疗操作的资格。

en.name: Special education teachers (elementary school)
en.summary: Elementary special education teachers adapt foundational literacy, math, and school routines, tracking what students can do under different supports.

zh.name: 特殊教育教师（小学）
zh.summary: 小学特殊教育教师在基础读写、数学和学校生活场景中调整教学支持，记录学生在不同提示下能完成什么。

en.name: Special education teachers (kindergarten)
en.summary: Kindergarten special education teachers embed supports in group activities and daily transitions, observing participation as prompts, materials, or peers change.

zh.name: 特殊教育教师（幼儿园）
zh.summary: 幼儿园阶段特殊教育教师把支持嵌入集体活动和日常转换，观察孩子在提示、材料和同伴变化下怎么参与。

en.name: Special education teachers (middle school)
en.summary: Middle school special education teachers support participation across subjects and track academic, self-management, and social goals with classroom teachers.

zh.name: 特殊教育教师（初中）
zh.summary: 初中特殊教育教师协助学生参与多门学科课程，跟踪课业、自我管理和社会技能目标，与学科教师协调材料与复核。

en.name: Special education teachers (preschool)
en.summary: Preschool special education teachers adapt play and early learning, observe communication and participation, and share records with families and school teams.

zh.name: 特殊教育教师（学前）
zh.summary: 学前特殊教育教师调整游戏和早期学习活动，观察沟通、参与和生活技能，并与家庭和园所团队交换记录。

en.name: Speech-language pathologists
en.summary: Speech-language pathologists assess and treat communication difficulties. Some roles also address swallowing. Schools focus on access to learning, while hospital work emphasizes clinical assessment and handover. Check the job duties, training requirements and supervision in your target setting.

zh.name: 言语语言病理师
zh.summary: 言语语言病理师（招聘也写言语治疗师）评估和干预沟通困难；部分岗位也处理吞咽问题。学校侧重学习参与，医院侧重临床评估和团队交接。入行先核目标机构的岗位、专业背景和带教安排。

en.name: Speech-language pathology assistants
en.summary: Speech-language pathology assistants carry out assigned activities, document performance, and report to the supervising professional. Interpretation and plan changes follow local authority.

zh.name: 言语病理学助理
zh.summary: 言语语言治疗助理按专业人员制定的计划实施获授权活动、记录表现并反馈。评估解释和计划调整由有权角色负责。

en.name: Sports medicine physicians
en.summary: Sports medicine physicians assess activity-related injuries, plan follow-up and rehabilitation, and coordinate return-to-activity decisions within their authority.

zh.name: 运动医学医师
zh.summary: 运动医学医生在执业范围内评估运动相关损伤、制定随访和康复计划，并与相关团队协调恢复活动。

en.name: Stationary engineers and boiler operators
en.summary: Stationary engineers and boiler operators run or maintain equipment that supplies building or process utilities and document conditions across shifts. Credentials vary.

zh.name: 固定设备工程师与锅炉操作员
zh.summary: 固定设备与锅炉运行岗位操作或维护为建筑和生产供能的设备，跟踪班次工况和异常，资质与现场职责须另核。

en.name: Statistical assistants
en.summary: Statistical assistants prepare data, compute summaries under specified rules, and produce tables or charts while recording missing values and units.

zh.name: 统计助理
zh.summary: 统计助理按既定规则整理数据、计算汇总并准备图表，记录缺失值、单位与复核事项。

en.name: Statisticians
en.summary: Statisticians design data collection and analysis around a question, interpret uncertainty, and explain where results apply.

zh.name: 统计师
zh.summary: 统计人员根据问题设计数据收集和分析方法，解释结果及不确定性，并说明结论的适用范围。

en.name: Stockers and order fillers
en.summary: Stockers and order fillers put away, pick, and verify goods against locations or orders. Equipment and handoff duties depend on the employer.

zh.name: 补货与订单拣货员
zh.summary: 补货与拣单岗位把货物按库位或订单要求收放、拣取并复核数量。实际设备与交接按雇主要求。

en.name: Stone Cutters and Carvers, Manufacturing
en.summary: Manufacturing stone cutters and carvers shape stone to drawings or patterns and check dimensions, depth, and finish.

zh.name: 石材切割与雕刻工（制造类）
zh.summary: 制造场景的石材切割与雕刻岗位按图样加工石材，核尺寸、深度及表面完成状态。

en.name: Stonemasons
en.summary: Stonemasons lay stone and build or repair structures on site according to layouts and specifications, documenting sections awaiting review.

zh.name: 石匠
zh.summary: 砌石工在施工现场按布局和规格放置石材、砌筑或修补结构，记录区段和待验收部位。

en.name: Structural iron and steel workers
en.summary: Structural iron and steel workers position, erect, and connect members on site and record connection and inspection status.

zh.name: 钢结构铁工
zh.summary: 结构钢安装岗位在现场定位、架设并连接钢构件，按项目流程记录连接与复核状态。

en.name: Structural metal fabricators and fitters
en.summary: Structural metal fabricators and fitters make, position, and align components from drawings and document fit deviations for review.

zh.name: 结构金属制造工
zh.summary: 结构金属制作与装配岗位按图加工、定位和对齐构件，记录装配偏差并按流程送复核。

en.name: Subway and streetcar operators
en.summary: Subway and streetcar operators drive passenger rail vehicles, watch signals, platforms and crossings, and report delays or equipment issues to dispatch.

zh.name: 地铁与有轨电车司机
zh.summary: 地铁和有轨电车驾驶员按线路要求驾驶载客车辆，监看信号、站台和路口情况，并把延误或设备异常报告给调度。

en.name: Supply chain managers
en.summary: Supply chain managers coordinate purchasing, inventory, warehousing and transport. They compare lead times, stock risks and costs and coordinate responses to shortages or changed arrival dates.

zh.name: 供应链经理
zh.summary: 供应链经理协调采购、库存、仓储与运输，比较交付周期、库存风险和成本，并安排跨部门处理缺货或到货变化。

en.name: Surgical assistants
en.summary: Surgical assistants directly support procedures as part of the operating team and help maintain the sterile field. Their assigned tasks depend on training, authorization and the institution.

zh.name: 手术助理
zh.summary: 手术助理在手术团队分工下直接协助手术，并配合维护无菌环境。实际承担哪些协助任务取决于训练、授权和所在机构。

en.name: Surgical technologists
en.summary: Surgical technologists prepare sterile instruments and supplies, assist with passing items and counts, and refer the resulting records to the team for review.

zh.name: 外科手术技师
zh.summary: 手术技术员准备无菌器械和耗材，配合术中传递与清点，并把清点和器械记录交给团队复核。

en.name: Survey researchers
en.summary: Survey researchers translate research questions into sampling and questionnaire designs, organize data collection and explain the sample, methods and limitations to people using the results.

zh.name: 调查研究员
zh.summary: 调查研究人员把研究问题转成抽样与问卷设计，组织收集资料，并向使用结果的人说明样本、方法和限制。

en.name: Surveying and mapping technicians
en.summary: Surveying and mapping technicians usually collect, organise and check spatial data under the supervision of engineers, surveyors or mapping professionals, calculate survey results and produce or update maps. Field instruments, office data and layer quality checks are connected; the technician's assistance is not the same as obtaining the authority of an independent surveyor to practise or publish results. Use the fictional coordinates first to check the units, layers and delivery limits.

zh.name: 测量与制图技术员
zh.summary: 测量与制图技术员通常在工程师、测量师或制图专业人员指导下采集、整理和核对空间数据，计算测量结果并制作或更新地图。外业仪器、内业数据与图层质检相互连接；技术员的协助工作不等于取得独立测量师执业或发布成果的权限。先用虚构坐标检查单位、图层和交付限制。

en.name: Surveyors
en.summary: Surveyors check survey records, cadastral and ownership material, determine position, elevation and boundaries, compile sketches, maps, reports and boundary descriptions, and carry result review and certification responsibility according to the jurisdiction and duties. The work connects field surveying, office calculation and engineering collaboration; knowing how to use instruments is not the same as being able to certify property boundaries independently.

zh.name: 测量师
zh.summary: 测量师核对测量记录、地籍及权属资料，测定位置、高程和界线，编制草图、地图、报告与界线描述，并按所在法域及职责承担成果复核和认证责任。工作连接外业测量、内业计算与工程协作；会使用仪器不等于可以独立认证产权界线。

en.name: Sustainability specialists
en.summary: Sustainability specialists track measures such as energy, water or waste, assess the feasibility and cost of proposals, and make the basis of comparisons clear to project teams.

zh.name: 可持续发展专员
zh.summary: 可持续发展专员跟踪能源、用水或废弃物等指标，评估改进项目的成本与可行性，并让项目团队理解比较口径。

en.name: Tailors, Dressmakers, and Custom Sewers
en.summary: Tailors and custom sewers design, make, alter, repair, and adjust the fit of garments, taking measurements, making and altering patterns, cutting and sewing, reworking at fittings, and pressing. The core delivery is garments that meet agreed measurements, appearance, and use requirements; drawing or getting seam allowances right cannot replace real materials, fit, and finished-product inspection.

zh.name: 裁缝、定制缝纫工
zh.summary: 裁缝、定制缝纫工设计、制作、修改、修理并调整服装合身度，量取尺寸、制改样板、裁剪缝制、试衣返修与整烫。核心交付是符合约定尺寸、外观和使用需求的衣物；画图或算对缝份不能代替真实材料、合身与成品质检。

en.name: Tax preparers
en.summary: Tax preparers collect filing information from clients, check income and other records and complete the applicable forms. Conflicting information calls for verifying the source.

zh.name: 税务申报服务人员
zh.summary: 报税编制人员向客户收集申报资料，核对收入和其他凭据，再按适用表格要求填报。资料不一致时需先查清来源。

en.name: Teaching assistants (special education)
en.summary: Special education assistants provide individual or small-group learning support under the teacher or team, help students participate and document observable performance. The responsible staff confirm instructional and support plans.

zh.name: 教学助理（特殊教育）
zh.summary: 特殊教育助教在教师或团队安排下提供个人或小组学习支持，协助课堂参与并记录可观察的表现。教学与支持计划由负责人员确认。

en.name: Team assemblers
en.summary: Team assemblers coordinate across stations, build parts to drawings and work orders, and check the output. When rotating stations, they hand off completed work and items awaiting review.

zh.name: 团队装配工
zh.summary: 团队装配工在工位之间协作，按图纸和工单组装部件并检查成品。轮岗时要让接手人员知道已完成项目和待核项。

en.name: Technical writers
en.summary: Technical writers turn engineering or product material into instructions readers can follow and verify. They maintain terminology and revision history and confirm key steps with subject experts before release.

zh.name: 技术写作者
zh.summary: 技术写作者把工程或产品资料整理成用户能执行和复核的说明，统一术语并保留版本变更。发布前会向主题专家核实关键步骤。

en.name: Telecommunications Engineering Specialists
en.summary: Telecommunications engineering specialists specify equipment or networks, diagnose service issues and coordinate upgrades. Design and support both depend on traceable standards and equipment records.

zh.name: 电信工程专员
zh.summary: 电信工程专员制定设备或网络规格，诊断运行问题并协调改造。设计和支持工作都需要可追溯的标准及设备记录。

en.name: Telecommunications Equipment Installers and Repairers, Except Line Installers
en.summary: Telecommunications equipment installers and repairers install, test or service communications equipment and connections at equipment sites. They use diagrams and test records to isolate faults and hand off findings.

zh.name: 电信设备安装与维修人员（不含线路安装人员）
zh.summary: 通信设备安装维修人员在设备站点安装、测试或检修通信设备及连接，凭图纸和测试记录隔离故障并交接。

en.name: Telecommunications Line Installers and Repairers
en.summary: Telecommunications line installers and repairers install, connect and test lines or cables. They record sections and readings to help locate faults and plan follow-up work.

zh.name: 电信线路安装与维修人员
zh.summary: 通信线路安装维修人员布设、连接和测试线路或电缆，记录区段和测量结果，以便定位线路故障和安排后续工作。

en.name: Telemarketers
en.summary: Telemarketers use calls to explain goods, services or fundraising campaigns, answer questions and record responses, orders or follow-up.

zh.name: 电话销售员
zh.summary: 电话营销人员通过来电或外呼介绍商品、服务或募捐项目，回答问题并记录反馈、订单或后续安排。

en.name: Telephone Operators
en.summary: Telephone operators look up directory information, clarify who the caller needs, and record whether a transfer was attempted or completed. They check conflicting listings before routing a call.

zh.name: 电话接线员
zh.summary: 电话接线员查目录、澄清来电要找的单位或部门，再按授权转接并记录结果。同名、旧号码或私人资料不明确时，先标待核。

en.name: Terrazzo workers and finishers
en.summary: Terrazzo workers and finishers lay out dividers and materials to the design, place and finish the surface, and compare the result with an approved sample.

zh.name: 水磨石工与整修工
zh.summary: 水磨石施工与收面人员按设计组织分格和材料，完成铺设、研磨或抛光，并对照样板检查完成面。

en.name: Textile bleaching and dyeing machine operators and tenders
en.summary: Textile bleaching and dyeing machine operators tend washing, bleaching or dyeing equipment, monitor fabric and instrument readings, and record batch or equipment exceptions.

zh.name: 纺织漂染机器操作员与看护员
zh.summary: 纺织漂染机操作人员看管洗涤、漂白或染色设备，观察织物和仪表状态，并记录批次或设备异常。

en.name: Textile cutting machine setters, operators and tenders
en.summary: Textile cutting machine operators set up jobs from patterns or digital layouts, inspect the size and shape of cut pieces, and report pattern discrepancies at handoff.

zh.name: 纺织裁剪设备设定员、操作员与看护员
zh.summary: 纺织裁剪设备操作人员按纸样或数字排料文件设置裁剪作业，检查裁片尺寸和形状，并处理交接中的版型差异。

en.name: Textile knitting and weaving machine setters, operators and tenders
en.summary: Textile knitting and weaving machine operators tend yarn and equipment, watch for fabric defects or stoppages and log their location and timing for the crew.

zh.name: 纺织针织与织造设备设定员、操作员与看护员
zh.summary: 针织与织造设备操作人员看管纱线和机台，观察布面缺陷或停机，并记录发生位置和时间以便班组排查。

en.name: Textile winding, twisting and drawing out machine setters, operators and tenders
en.summary: Textile winding, twisting and drawing-out machine operators monitor yarn movement and machine operation. They record batches, stoppages and issues for maintenance to review.

zh.name: 纺织卷绕、加捻与牵伸设备设定员、操作员与看护员
zh.summary: 纺织卷绕、加捻和牵伸设备操作人员看管纱线走向和设备运行，记录批次、停机或需要维修人员核查的情况。

en.name: Tile and stone setters
en.summary: Tile and stone setters translate a design layout to the wall or floor and check piece dimensions, orientation and joints. A natural stone job may also call for matching the appearance to an approved sample.

zh.name: 瓷砖和石材铺设工
zh.summary: 瓷砖与石材铺贴工把设计排版落实到具体墙地面，核对板材尺寸、方向与接缝。天然石材项目还可能要求对照样板安排外观。

en.name: Timing device assemblers and adjusters
en.summary: Timing device assemblers and adjusters put together small components, observe movements or subassemblies, and measure fit and accuracy. They use records to review irregularities.

zh.name: 计时装置装配与调校工
zh.summary: 计时装置装配与调校人员组装微型零件，观察机芯或组件运行，测量配合和精度，并按记录复核异常。

en.name: Tire builders
en.summary: Tire builders process casings or assemble treads to production requirements and inspect materials and output. Some work in retreading. Batch and process records need to trace back to the casing.

zh.name: 轮胎制造工
zh.summary: 轮胎制造工按生产要求处理胎体或组装胎面，检查材料与成品，部分岗位从事轮胎翻新。批次和工序记录要能追溯到胎体。

en.name: Tire repairers and changers
en.summary: Tire repairers and changers inspect tires and wheels and perform removal, installation or balancing checks according to the work order. Service records identify the wheel position and work completed.

zh.name: 轮胎修理与更换工
zh.summary: 轮胎维修与更换人员检查轮胎和车轮，按工单拆装或做平衡检查。交车记录要对应具体车轮位置和已完成工作。

en.name: Title examiners, abstractors and searchers
en.summary: Title examiners, abstractors and searchers review deeds, mortgages, restrictions and property descriptions. They summarize the document chain and open questions for authorized review.

zh.name: 产权审查、摘要与检索员
zh.summary: 产权检索与审查人员查阅契据、抵押、限制和地块描述，整理文件链和待澄清问题，供有权限的人员审查。

en.name: Tool and die makers
en.summary: Tool and die makers interpret drawings and tolerances, plan machining and fit, and use measuring instruments to check dimensions, alignment or clearance.

zh.name: 工具和模具制造工
zh.summary: 工具与模具制造工解读图纸和公差，规划零件加工与配合，并用量具核查成品尺寸、对准或间隙。

en.name: Tool grinders, filers and sharpeners
en.summary: Tool grinders, filers and sharpeners finish tools, parts or dies to a specified shape and check the profile, surface and dimensions against the work order.

zh.name: 工具磨削、锉削与刃磨工
zh.summary: 工具磨削、锉修和刃磨人员按指定形状修整工具、零件或模具，并检查轮廓、表面及尺寸是否符合工单。

en.name: Tour guides and escorts
en.summary: Tour guides and escorts explain sites, answer questions and lead groups along the visitor route. Group size, meeting points and access information affect how they organize the visit.

zh.name: 导游和陪同人员
zh.summary: 导游与陪同人员向游客介绍景点、回答问题并带领团队通过现场路线。人数、集合地点与开放信息会影响现场安排。

en.name: Traffic technicians
en.summary: Traffic technicians survey traffic volume, speed and traffic facility conditions under the direction of a traffic engineer, organise records, review anomalies and provide charts and handover material. The United States identity is O*NET53-6041.00, and the standalone wage and employment statistics keep their own period. You can first complete the T1—T3 fictional counting exercise to observe data discipline and correction ability; paper works do not authorise field surveys, equipment operation or signal changes.

zh.name: 交通技术员
zh.summary: 交通技术员在交通工程师指导下调查流量、速度和交通设施状况，整理记录、复核异常并提供图表与交接资料。美国身份为O*NET53-6041.00，工资就业单列统计另保留期间。可先完成T1—T3虚构计数练习，观察数据纪律与更正能力；纸面作品不授权现场调查、设备操作或信号更改。

en.name: Training and development managers
en.summary: Plan, organise and evaluate employee learning programmes, coordinating courses, instructors, budgets and implementation; support improvement with needs and result evidence, and confirm professional, data and approval responsibility with the actual organisation.

zh.name: 培训与发展经理
zh.summary: 规划、组织和评价员工学习项目，协调课程、讲师、预算与实施；以需求和结果证据支持改进，专业、数据及审批责任按实际组织确认。

en.name: Training and development specialists
en.summary: Training and development specialists assess employee learning needs, design or select material, deliver training through demonstration, discussion and practice, and record and evaluate learning results; courseware completion is not the same as employees being able to use it, and professional standards, material purpose and actual approval still need organisational confirmation.

zh.name: 培训与发展专员
zh.summary: 培训与发展专员评估员工学习需求，设计或选择材料，以演示、讨论及练习实施培训，并记录和评价学习结果；课件完成不等于员工会用，专业标准、资料用途及实际批准仍需组织确认。

en.name: Transit and railroad police
en.summary: Transit and railroad police patrol or respond to incidents at stations, lines and rail facilities, documenting events that affect passengers, staff or property.

zh.name: 公交与铁路警察
zh.summary: 公共交通与铁路警察在车站、线路和铁路设施开展巡查或事件应对，并记录影响旅客、人员和设施安全的情况。

en.name: Transportation engineers
en.summary: Transportation engineers prepare plans, designs, technical notes and estimates for roads, transportation facilities and systems, and analyse traffic operations and improvement needs. The precise identity on this page is 17-2051.01; United States wages and employment use the civil engineers 17-2051 broad group reference, which cannot serve as transportation specialism statistics or Chinese treatment.

zh.name: 运输工程师
zh.summary: 运输工程师为道路、交通设施及系统编制规划、设计、技术说明和估算，并分析交通运行及改造需求。本页精确身份为17-2051.01；美国工资和就业采用土木工程师17-2051大类参考，不能当交通细分统计或中国待遇。

en.name: Transportation inspectors
en.summary: Transportation inspectors inspect cargo or equipment related to safe transport, check the condition and records and produce an inspection report. This page uses the United States O*NET-SOC 53-6051.00 as the identity baseline, distinguishing the cargo, aviation and non-aviation equipment scopes; Chinese positions and actual authority are checked separately.

zh.name: 运输检查员
zh.summary: 运输检查员检查与安全运输有关的货物或设备，核对状态和记录并形成检查报告。本页以美国O*NET-SOC 53-6051.00为身份基准，区分货物、航空及非航空设备范围；中国岗位和实际权限另核。

en.name: Transportation planners
en.summary: Transportation planners research proposed transportation projects, collect and analyse data and compare transportation scenarios and schemes. This page uses the United States O*NET19-3099.01 task basis, distinguishing the parent group wage and employment proxy, the Chinese project requirements and the actual authority; the fictional commuting prompt can be used to experience the formulas, the budget and the opinion revision.

zh.name: 运输规划师
zh.summary: 运输规划师研究拟议运输项目，收集分析数据并比较交通情景与方案。本页采用美国O*NET19-3099.01任务口径，区分母类工资就业代理、中国项目要求和实际权限；可先用虚构通勤题体验公式、预算与意见修订。

en.name: Transportation security screeners
en.summary: Transportation security screeners check passengers or items under site procedures, document issues and refer cases requiring further judgment to authorized staff.

zh.name: 运输安检员
zh.summary: 交通安检员按站点流程核验旅客或物品并记录待复核情况，将需要进一步判断的事项交给有权限的人员。

en.name: Transportation, storage and distribution managers
en.summary: Transportation, storage and distribution managers coordinate receiving, storage, shipping and staff. They also monitor equipment or warehouse conditions that can affect where goods go and when they arrive.

zh.name: 运输、仓储与配送经理
zh.summary: 运输、仓储与配送经理安排收货、存放、发运及人员协作，并检查设备或仓库运行情况。异常会影响货物去向和后续交付。

en.name: Travel guides
en.summary: Travel guides coordinate trips, interpret sites and adapt plans when weather, transport or group needs change.

zh.name: 旅行导游
zh.summary: 旅行导游组织现场行程、解释地点和服务安排，并在天气、交通或团队需求变化时协调备选。

en.name: Treasurers and controllers
en.summary: Treasurers focus on cash, funding and liquidity; controllers focus on reporting, close and internal controls. Responsibilities vary by organization.

zh.name: 司库与财务控制员
zh.summary: 司库更侧重现金、融资和流动性；财务控制员更侧重财务报告、关账及内部控制。具体分工由组织决定。

en.name: Tutors
en.summary: Tutors examine how learners approach a problem, offer examples or prompts and document progress they can observe.

zh.name: 家教与辅导教师
zh.summary: 辅导教师观察学习者的解题过程，用问题、例子或分步提示帮助对方理解，并记录可见的学习进展。

en.name: Urban and regional planners
en.summary: Urban and regional planners turn land, population, transport, facility, and regulatory materials into discussable spatial plans and implementation recommendations, surveying the current situation, comparing alternatives, coordinating public comments, and keeping drawings and text consistent. It is not just drawing attractive maps: indicators, data versions, statutory procedures, and signing responsibility all have to be checked. US occupational statistics and Chinese territorial spatial planning practice conditions are explained separately.

zh.name: 城市与区域规划师
zh.summary: 城市与区域规划师把土地、人口、交通、设施与法规资料转为可讨论的空间方案和实施建议，调查现状、比较替代选项、协调公众意见并保持图件与文本一致。它不只是画漂亮地图：指标、数据版本、法定程序与签字责任都要核对。美国职业统计和中国国土空间规划执业条件分别解释。

en.name: Urologists
en.summary: Urologists assess urinary and related reproductive conditions using history, examination and tests, and manage treatment within authorized scope.

zh.name: 泌尿科医师
zh.summary: 泌尿科医师结合病史、检查和检验评估泌尿及相关生殖系统问题，按执业和机构授权开展治疗与随访。

en.name: Validation engineers
en.summary: Validation engineers translate requirements into tests and acceptance criteria and document results and deviations for traceability.

zh.name: 验证工程师
zh.summary: 验证工程师把预定要求转为测试与验收标准，记录结果、偏差及复核证据，使结论可追溯。

en.name: Veterinarians
en.summary: Veterinarians evaluate and treat animal health problems and explain monitoring and follow-up to owners. Species and permitted duties vary by role and jurisdiction.

zh.name: 兽医
zh.summary: 兽医检查、诊断并处理动物健康问题，也向饲主说明观察与随访。工作对象和执业范围随岗位及所在地变化。

en.name: Veterinary assistants and laboratory animal caretakers
en.summary: Veterinary assistants and lab animal caretakers feed animals, maintain environments and record observations under supervision.

zh.name: 兽医助理与实验动物照护员
zh.summary: 兽医助理与实验动物照护员按监督安排负责饲喂、环境维护、状态观察与记录，及时交接异常。

en.name: Veterinary technologists and technicians
en.summary: Veterinary technologists and technicians support sampling, testing, care and recordkeeping under supervision and within local scope rules.

zh.name: 兽医技师与技术员
zh.summary: 兽医技师和技术员在监督下承担采样、检验、护理和记录等技术工作，具体操作及执业范围按所在地核对。

en.name: Video game designers
en.summary: Video game designers define mechanics, objectives and levels, communicate them through documents or prototypes and revise them using playtest observations.

zh.name: 电子游戏设计师
zh.summary: 电子游戏设计师定义玩法目标、机制和关卡，用文档与原型和团队验证设计，再依据测试观察修改。

en.name: Waiters and waitresses
en.summary: Servers take orders, relay modifications and timing to the kitchen, check the table and bill, and handle feedback within their assignment.

zh.name: 服务员
zh.summary: 餐桌服务员把顾客点单、加减项和上菜顺序准确交给厨房，核对桌号及账单，按门店分工处理反馈。

en.name: Watch and clock repairers
en.summary: Watch and clock repairers inspect worn parts and timing deviations, then clean, adjust or reassemble the movement and document its condition before return.

zh.name: 钟表维修工
zh.summary: 钟表维修人员检查磨损和走时偏差，按机芯情况拆检、清洁、修整或复装，并记录返还前的状态。

en.name: Water and wastewater treatment plant and system operators
en.summary: Water and wastewater operators monitor equipment, collect samples under site procedures, record instrument and test results, and hand off exceptions. The site assigns process adjustments.

zh.name: 给排水处理厂与系统操作员
zh.summary: 水处理运行人员巡看设备、按流程采样、记录仪表和检测结果，并按班次交接超限或未复核项目。调整工艺由现场规定的岗位负责。

en.name: Water resource specialists
en.summary: Water resource specialists use watershed, supply and water-quality data to assess options. They document model assumptions and raise uncertainties that could change a decision.

zh.name: 水资源专员
zh.summary: 水资源专员用流域、供水和水质资料分析方案，说明模型假设和数据缺口，并把影响决策的不确定性交项目团队核对。

en.name: Water/Wastewater Engineers
en.summary: Water/wastewater engineers design water supply, wastewater treatment facilities and pipe networks. Compare treatment design, hydraulic modeling and plant operations before choosing a role. Real projects require verified inputs, applicable standards and authorized review. U.S. pay and outlook cover the broader civil engineer occupation.

zh.name: 给排水工程师（水与污水处理）
zh.summary: 给排水工程师做供水、污水处理设施和管网设计。选岗位时先分清工艺、管网水力和运行；实际项目需核输入、规范和谁能复核签章。美国工资和就业为土木工程师母类数据。

en.name: Weatherization installers and technicians
en.summary: Weatherization crews check air leakage, ducts and insulation, then carry out the assigned upgrades. Qualified project staff assess combustion equipment and ventilation.

zh.name: 安装工技术员
zh.summary: 建筑节能改造人员检查空气渗漏、风管和保温状况，再按方案施工。涉及燃烧设备和通风的判断由符合项目要求的人员完成。

en.name: Web administrators
en.summary: Web administrators monitor availability, access and backups, respond to or escalate issues, and maintain configurations and recovery plans within their permissions.

zh.name: 网站管理员
zh.summary: 网站管理员看可用性、访问和备份记录，处理或上报异常，并按授权维护配置与恢复计划。

en.name: Web and digital interface designers
en.summary: Web and digital interface designers map user tasks into flows, prototype screens, check feedback and interaction states, and hand specifications to development.

zh.name: 网页与数字界面设计师
zh.summary: 网页与数字界面设计师把用户任务拆成界面流程，制作原型，核对反馈、交互状态及开发交接。

en.name: Web Developers
en.summary: Web developers implement pages and application behavior, maintain code and assets, and verify success, failure and recovery paths in the target environment.

zh.name: 网页开发人员
zh.summary: Web 开发人员实现页面和接口调用，维护代码与资源，按环境验证成功、失败及回退路径。

en.name: Weighers, Measurers, Checkers, and Samplers, Recordkeeping
en.summary: Recordkeeping weighers, measurers, checkers and samplers match lot IDs, labels and readings, keep inspection or shipping records, and refer discrepancies for review.

zh.name: 称重计量工
zh.summary: 称重、测量、检查与取样记录员核对批次、标签和读数，保留检测或收发记录，把不符项交给相应复核人。

en.name: Welders, Cutters, Solderers, and Brazers
en.summary: Welders, cutters, solderers and brazers join or cut materials to workpiece specifications, check dimensions and defects, and report problems within their assignment.

zh.name: 焊接、切割、钎焊与铜焊人员
zh.summary: 焊接、切割、锡焊和钎焊人员按工件规格及工艺要求连接或切割材料，核尺寸与缺陷，按岗位分工报告异常。

en.name: Welding, Soldering, and Brazing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
en.summary: Welding, soldering and brazing machine operators follow the job specification, set up and monitor equipment, check samples and record stoppages. The site assigns changes and restart authority.

zh.name: 机器铺设工、操作员、看护员
zh.summary: 焊接与钎焊机台人员按工单设置和监看设备，检验样件并记录停机或异常。参数变更和复工按分工处理。

en.name: Wellhead Pumpers
en.summary: Wellhead pumpers monitor pumps, flow, pressure and line conditions, record production and exceptions, and hand off servicing, isolation and restart to authorized staff.

zh.name: 井口泵操作员
zh.summary: 井口泵工监看泵、流量、压力和管线状态，记录产量或异常，把维修、隔离和恢复交给有相应权限的岗位。

en.name: Wind Energy Development Managers
en.summary: Wind development managers coordinate project plans, resource assessment, land use, interconnection, budget and schedule. They prepare the dependencies and approvals for project decisions.

zh.name: 风能开发经理
zh.summary: 风电开发经理统筹立项、资源评估、用地、并网、预算和进度，把审批及协议依赖整理成项目决策材料。

en.name: Wind Energy Engineers
en.summary: Wind energy engineers analyze layouts, equipment and infrastructure options, documenting model inputs, design revisions and interfaces that require other disciplines’ review.

zh.name: 风能工程师
zh.summary: 风电工程师做场址布置、设备及基础设施方案的技术分析，记录模型输入、设计版本和需要其他专业确认的接口。

en.name: Wind Energy Operations Managers
en.summary: Wind operations managers coordinate staff and contractors, track downtime, work orders and parts, and schedule reviews and maintenance.

zh.name: 风能运营经理
zh.summary: 风电运营经理协调现场人员和承包商，跟踪停机、工单及备件，安排复核和计划检修。

en.name: Wind Turbine Service Technicians
en.summary: Wind turbine service technicians inspect, maintain and troubleshoot turbines against work orders. They record alarms, readings, actions and open checks. Work at height and isolation follow site authorization.

zh.name: 风力涡轮机服务技术员
zh.summary: 风机服务技师按工单做巡检、维护和故障排查，留存报警、测量、处理和待复核事项。登高和隔离按现场授权。

en.name: Word processors and typists
en.summary: Word processors and typists format incoming material, check revisions, styles and filenames, and archive or send the files through the assigned process.

zh.name: 文字处理员与打字员
zh.summary: 文字处理与打字人员把来稿整理成规定格式，核版本、样式和文件名，并按流程存档或发送。

en.name: Writers and authors
en.summary: Writers and authors gather material, draft and revise for a brief or project, submit to an editor or client, and track open facts and feedback.

zh.name: 作家与作者
zh.summary: 作家和撰稿人根据题材或委托收集材料、写作与修订，向编辑或委托方交稿，并记录待核事实与反馈。

en.name: Zoologists and wildlife biologists
en.summary: Zoologists and wildlife biologists survey populations or habitats under a research design, record observation conditions, analyze results and explain limitations to research or management teams.

zh.name: 动物学家与野生生物学家
zh.summary: 动物学家与野生动物生物学家按研究设计调查种群或栖息地，记录观测条件，分析结果并向研究或管理团队说明限制。
